zh: 生長；增長；發展；種植；逐漸變得
en: To become bigger or develop over time. | To raise plants for food or other purposes. | To gradually become different in condition or feeling.
example_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example_zh: 我們在廚房窗邊的花盆裡種新鮮香草。

zh: 空氣；神態；氣氛；使通風；公開表達
en: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth that people breathe. | A particular quality that someone or something seems to have. | To let fresh air in, or express views publicly.
example_en: I opened the window to let fresh air in.
example_zh: 我開啟窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

zh: 死亡；枯死；停止運轉；逐漸消失；骰子
en: Stop living. | Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear. | A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.
example_en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
example_zh: 如果忘了澆水，這些植物就會枯死。

zh: 殺死；使死亡；使終止；扼殺
en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die | To cause something to stop or fail
example_en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
example_zh: 這種肥皂有助於殺滅手上的病菌。

zh: 田地；牧場；領域；專業；運動場
en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals | a particular area of study or work | an area of ground used for playing a sport
example_en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
example_zh: 我們看著羊群在小屋後面的牧場上吃草。

zh: 石油；原油；油；食用油；潤滑油；給…加潤滑油
en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals. | A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes. | To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.
example_en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
example_zh: 卡車把原油從油井運往煉油廠。

zh: 大自然；自然界；性質；本質；天性；性格
en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes. | The basic qualities that make something what it is. | The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.
example_en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
example_zh: 露營讓我們遠離繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.
example_en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
example_zh: 我們可以利用剩飯剩菜來減少浪費。

en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.
example_en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥在我們家的樹上築了巢。

en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example_en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
example_zh: 小睡一會兒後，我有精力做飯了。

en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.
example_en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
example_zh: 夏天傍晚很長，我們常在戶外吃飯。

zh: 植物；種植；栽種；工廠；工業設施
en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves | to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow | a factory or facility where industrial processes take place
example_en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
example_zh: 這株小植物需要更多陽光和更少的水。

en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures | relating to animals rather than plants
example_en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
example_zh: 我妹妹喜歡在當地農場看動物。

zh: 自然環境；生活或工作環境
en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things. | The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.
example_en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
example_zh: 我們騎車上學，為保護環境出一份力。

zh: 天然的；自然界的；天生的；正常的；合乎常理的
en: existing in nature rather than made by people | having an ability from birth rather than through training | normal and expected in a particular situation
example_en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
example_zh: 這塊肥皂完全由天然原料製成。

en: an area of a country or the world | a particular area of the body
example_en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
example_zh: 這個地區以蘋果和乳酪聞名。

en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth | a large mass of similar things seen together
example_en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
example_zh: 孩子們看著小船在海上航行。

zh: 死的；枯死的；沒電的；無法運作的；完全地；正好
en: No longer alive | No longer working, often because power has run out | Completely or exactly, used for emphasis
example_en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
example_zh: 我們清除了陽臺花盆裡枯死的花。

en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
example_en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
example_zh: 戴上厚手套，保護雙手不被刺扎傷。

en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work. | To cause persistent problems for someone or something.
example_en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
example_zh: 我們的狗每天下午都守在門邊。

zh: 資源；財力；人力；資料；學習資源；為…提供資源
en: Something useful that people or organisations can draw on. | Material that provides information or support for learning. | To supply an organisation or activity with necessary support.
example_en: Our village shares its water resources during dry summers.
example_zh: 在乾旱的夏季，我們村會共享水資源。

en: A large animal used for riding, racing, or pulling loads.
example_en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
example_zh: 那匹棕色的馬輕輕地吃走了我手裡的蘋果。

zh: 自然環境的；環保的；周圍環境的
en: relating to nature or efforts to protect it | relating to the surroundings in which people or organisms live
example_en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
example_zh: 我們學校組織了一項清理河流的環保活動。

en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body
example_en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，我們看著鴨子游過河面。

en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it. | A hard mass that forms inside an organ. | The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.
example_en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
example_zh: 她在湖邊撿起了一塊光滑的石頭。

zh: 春天；春季；彈簧；發條；泉；泉水
en: the season between winter and summer | a coiled piece of metal that stretches or compresses | a place where water flows naturally out of the ground
example_en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
example_zh: 我們每年春天都在花園裡種花。

en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh | to try to catch fish
example_en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
example_zh: 我們看著小魚在木橋下游動。

en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.
example_en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們乘小船去了那座島。

en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
example_en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
example_zh: 春雨過後，花園看起來很美。

en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist | the loose material on the ground in which plants grow
example_en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
example_zh: 孩子們用小鏟子挖開溼潤的泥土。

en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.
example_en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
example_zh: 每年夏天都有幾種蝴蝶來到我們的花園。

zh: 威脅；潛在危險；恐嚇；威脅的話
en: Something that could cause harm or damage. | A statement expressing an intention to cause harm.
example_en: The rising river poses a threat to our village.
example_zh: 不斷上漲的河水對我們村莊構成威脅。

en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs
example_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥在我們窗戶上方築了巢。

en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy. | Harm something or make it less effective.
example_en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
example_zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了我們花園裡的棚屋。

zh: 風；纏繞；卷繞；蜿蜒；曲折延伸
en: Air moving naturally outdoors. | To wrap something around an object or itself. | To follow a route with many bends and turns.
example_en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
example_zh: 突然一陣風把我的帽子吹走了。

en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees
example_en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
example_zh: 我們沿著一條狹窄的小路走進森林深處。

zh: 全球的；世界性的；整體的；全面的
en: Involving or affecting the whole world. | Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.
example_en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
example_zh: 老師給我們看了一張全球氣溫分佈圖。

zh: 樹枝；分店；分支機構；分支；分岔；分支
en: a woody part growing from a tree's trunk | a local office or division of a larger organization or subject | to divide into separate routes or parts
example_en: A small bird landed on the lowest branch.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥落在了最低的樹枝上。

en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm
example_en: This thick coat offers protection against the cold wind.
example_zh: 這件厚外套能抵禦寒風。

en: water that has frozen solid | to cover a cake or biscuit with icing
example_en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.
example_zh: 她往果汁裡放了幾塊冰。

en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches | an area of land covered with trees
example_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
example_zh: 這把小椅子完全由實木製成。

en: a very high area of land with steep sides | a very large amount of something
example_en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
example_zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆蓋。

en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring. | To spend the winter in a particular place.
example_en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
example_zh: 冬天寒風來襲時，我們會穿上厚外套。

en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds. | To produce flowers.
example_en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
example_zh: 她把鮮花插進窗邊的花瓶裡。

zh: 野生的；野長的；狂熱的；失控的；野外；自然環境
en: living or growing naturally, without human care | showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour | natural places where animals and plants live freely
example_en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
example_zh: 我們看見野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。

zh: 倖存；存活；繼續存在；挺過；比…活得長
en: stay alive despite danger, illness, or hardship | continue to exist after difficulties or changes | live longer than another person
example_en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
example_zh: 我們的小仙人掌三個星期沒澆水也活下來了。

zh: 海浪；波浪；波；揮手；揮舞；浪潮；一陣
en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance. | To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal. | A sudden increase or spread of something.
example_en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
example_zh: 一個大浪衝過了我們的小沙堡。

zh: 摧毀；毀滅；徹底破壞；使喪失
en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used. | To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.
example_en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
example_zh: 一場突如其來的暴風雨摧毀了我們屋後的舊棚子。

en: In, from, or relating to the north.
example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
example_zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一個安靜的村莊。

en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes | made of plastic | able to be shaped or changed easily
example_en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
example_zh: 這個午餐盒由結實的再生塑膠製成。

zh: 活著的；充滿活力的；熱鬧的
en: Living rather than dead | Full of energy, activity, or excitement
example_en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
example_zh: 我們度假回來後，那株小植物還活著。

zh: 燃料；給……加燃料；加劇；推動
en: material burned or used to produce heat or power | to supply something with fuel | to make a feeling or situation stronger
example_en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
example_zh: 我們開車進山前停下來加了油。

zh: 圍繞；包圍；與……密切相關；圍繞
en: be or move into positions on every side of something | be closely connected with an event, situation, or subject
example_en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
example_zh: 高大的樹木環繞著小屋，為窗戶遮陰。

en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results. | Unwanted material left after something has been used or made. | An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.
example_en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
example_zh: 別讓水龍頭一直開著，白白浪費水。

zh: 小徑；路線；蹤跡；一串痕跡；拖；落在後面
en: A path through countryside, forests, or mountains. | A series of marks or objects left by something moving. | To drag behind something or move slowly behind others.
example_en: We followed a narrow trail through the pine forest.
example_zh: 我們沿著一條狹窄的小徑穿過鬆林。

en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted
example_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
example_zh: 外面的噪音在鬧鐘響之前就把我吵醒了。

zh: 生物；生命個體；存在；本質
en: a living creature, especially a person | existence or the essential nature of a person or thing
example_en: Every living being in this pond needs clean water.
example_zh: 這個池塘裡的每一個生物都需要乾淨的水。

en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet. | An animal belonging to the same family as lions.
example_en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
example_zh: 我們家的貓睡在窗邊陽光照得到的地方。

zh: 捕獲；俘獲；拍攝；錄製；捕捉；捕獲；俘獲
en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape | to record an image, sound, or particular quality | the act of catching someone or something
example_en: Rescuers captured the injured bird and gently examined its wing.
example_zh: 救援人員捉住那隻受傷的鳥，輕輕檢查了它的翅膀。

en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience. | A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.
example_en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
example_zh: 我們停下來欣賞湖泊的美景。

zh: 植物的根；根源；起因；生根；使生根
en: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil | the basic cause or origin of something | to grow roots or cause a plant to grow roots
example_en: Thick roots from the oak have cracked our garden path.
example_zh: 橡樹粗壯的根把我們花園的小路撐裂了。

zh: 翅膀；機翼；建築物的側翼；組織內的派別
en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight. | A section extending from the main part of a building. | A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.
example_en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
example_zh: 那隻鳥飛離樹枝前展開了翅膀。

en: To move continuously, like water through a channel. | Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.
example_en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
example_zh: 雨水沿著小路流進了花園。

en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.
example_en: The old stove still burns coal during winter.
example_zh: 這個舊爐子冬天仍然燒煤取暖。

en: The earth in which plants grow. | To make something dirty.
example_en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
example_zh: 她往花盆裡填了土，然後種下種子。

en: A large area of water surrounded by land.
example_en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
example_zh: 我們租了一條小船，劃到了湖對岸。

zh: 風景；地貌；局面；格局；對……進行景觀美化
en: The visible features of an area of land. | The overall conditions and features of a particular field. | To improve land by arranging plants and other outdoor features.
example_en: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
example_zh: 白雪覆蓋了我們小木屋外的山野。

zh: 稀有的；罕見的；肉煎得嫩生的
en: not common or not happening often | cooked briefly so the inside remains red
example_en: We spotted a rare bird beside the lake yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在湖邊發現了一隻罕見的鳥。

zh: 雲；一團煙塵等；使判斷模糊；使困惑
en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky | a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air | to make thoughts or judgment less clear
example_en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
example_zh: 一朵烏雲緩緩飄過午後的天空。

en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another. | Put seeds into soil so that plants will grow.
example_en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
example_zh: 她把每一粒種子種進一個小陶盆裡。

zh: 嚴重的；劇烈的；嚴厲的；苛刻的
en: Very bad, intense, or damaging. | Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.
example_en: Severe storms knocked down several trees near our house.
example_zh: 猛烈的暴風雨刮倒了我們家附近的幾棵樹。

en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.
example_en: A vast desert stretched beyond the small village.
example_zh: 小村莊外是一片綿延的廣闊沙漠。

en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.
example_en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
example_zh: 我們在河邊的草地上鋪了一條毯子。

en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food
example_en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
example_zh: 早飯前，我們去湖邊釣魚了。

zh: 自然地；天然地；當然；自然會；天生地
en: Through natural processes rather than human action | As would normally be expected | Because of qualities someone or something has from birth
example_en: Let your hair dry naturally after you wash it.
example_zh: 洗完頭後，讓頭髮自然晾乾。

en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy
example_en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
example_zh: 空氣汙染讓遠處的山丘難以看清。

en: The distance from a surface to the bottom. | The degree of detail, understanding, or seriousness.
example_en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
example_zh: 跳進泳池前先確認水深。

zh: 玫瑰；薔薇；上升；增加（rise過去式）
en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems | past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased
example_en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
example_zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插進了玻璃花瓶。

en: relating to farming, including growing crops and raising animals
example_en: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
example_zh: 博物館展出了當地農民使用過的農具。

en: a very dry area with little rain and few plants | to leave someone or somewhere you should stay with
example_en: We crossed the desert before the afternoon heat arrived.
example_zh: 我們在午後的酷熱到來之前穿過了沙漠。

zh: 迴圈；週期；騎腳踏車；腳踏車
en: a series of events or stages that repeats | to travel by bicycle | a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling
example_en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
example_zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常騎腳踏車去公園。

zh: 保護；儲存；維持；保藏食物；保護區
en: Keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition | Treat food so it stays safe to eat longer | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected
example_en: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
example_zh: 我們把家裡的老照片儲存在一本專用相簿裡。

zh: 恢復；使復原；修復；整修；歸還；交還
en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation. | To repair something old or damaged to its earlier condition. | To return something to its rightful owner or place.
example_en: The engineers restored power before our food went bad.
example_zh: 工程師們在我們的食物變質之前恢復了供電。

en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms
example_en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
example_zh: 我們週末在寧靜的鄉間騎車遊玩。

en: The season between summer and winter
example_en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
example_zh: 我們每年秋天都在公園裡收集落葉。

zh: 動物；生物；虛構生物；怪物
en: a living being, especially an animal | an imaginary being with unusual physical features
example_en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
example_zh: 一隻小生物從葉子底下爬了出來。

en: The activity of growing crops and raising animals for food.
example_en: Many families here earn their living through agriculture.
example_zh: 這裡許多家庭靠農業謀生。

zh: 災難；災禍；徹底的失敗；糟糕的事
en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss. | Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.
example_en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
example_zh: 晚餐糟透了，因為我把米飯燒焦了。

en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds | grain crops such as wheat or barley, especially in British English
example_en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
example_zh: 我們烤了新鮮玉米，配著黃油一起吃。

zh: 莊稼；農作物；一季的收成；裁剪；剪短
en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses | the amount of a plant harvested at one time | to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short
example_en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨過後，農民檢視了自己的小麥。

zh: 極度的；極端的；偏激的；過激的；極端；極限
en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual | far beyond what most people consider reasonable or acceptable | either end of a range of conditions or behaviour
example_en: We kept the curtains closed during the extreme heat.
example_zh: 酷熱期間，我們一直拉著窗簾。

en: A hard outer covering protecting an animal, egg, or nut. | To remove the hard outer covering of something. | An explosive object fired from a large gun.
example_en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
example_zh: 她在空貝殼裡發現了一隻小螃蟹。

zh: 消耗；消費；食用；飲用；攝入量
en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services | the act or amount of eating or drinking something
example_en: Our electricity consumption rises when we use the heater.
example_zh: 使用暖氣時，我們的用電量就會上升。

en: the state of remaining alive or continuing to exist
example_en: The lost hikers carried blankets and other survival equipment.
example_zh: 迷路的徒步者帶著毯子和其他求生裝備。

en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft | to follow someone closely and watch where they go
example_en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
example_zh: 我回家時，那隻狗搖起了尾巴。

en: Damage so severe that something no longer exists or works.
example_en: The storm left a trail of destruction along the coast.
example_zh: 風暴沿海岸留下了一片破壞的痕跡。

en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk
example_en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
example_zh: 幾隻綿羊正在農場附近的一棵樹下休息。

en: The activity of chasing and catching or killing wild animals. | The activity of trying to find something.
example_en: We spotted fresh animal tracks during our hunting trip.
example_zh: 我們在狩獵途中發現了新鮮的動物足跡。

zh: 杆；柱；竿；地極；磁極；電極；對立的極端
en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support. | Either of two opposite ends of Earth, a magnet, or battery. | Either of two completely opposite positions or qualities.
example_en: We used a long pole to support the tent.
example_zh: 我們用一根長杆撐起帳篷。

zh: 灌木；灌木叢；荒野；叢林地帶
en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground. | Wild, uncultivated land, especially in Australia or Africa.
example_en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥躲在玫瑰叢裡。

zh: 自然環境保護；節約；資源保護；文物保護；儲存
en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments | careful use of resources to avoid waste | the protection and repair of valuable old objects or buildings
example_en: Our class joined a conservation project to protect local frogs.
example_zh: 我們班參加了一個保護當地青蛙的自然保護專案。

en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail. | A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.
example_en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
example_zh: 早飯前，一隻小老鼠溜到了櫥櫃後面。

zh: 坑；深洞；賽車維修區；果核
en: A large hole in the ground | An area where racing cars stop for servicing | The hard central part of certain fruits
example_en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
example_zh: 我們挖了一個淺坑，準備栽這棵新樹。

en: a hoofed wild animal whose males usually have branching antlers
example_en: A deer stood quietly beside the forest path.
example_zh: 一隻鹿靜靜地站在林間小路旁。

zh: 排放物；排放量；排放；發出
en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas. | The process of releasing gas, heat, light, or other energy.
example_en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，修理工檢查了我汽車的尾氣排放。

en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk | to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance
example_en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example_zh: 一頭棕色母牛靜靜地站在農場門旁。

zh: 木材；建築用木料；用材林；用材樹木
en: wood prepared for building or making things | trees grown for wood used in construction or manufacturing
example_en: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
example_zh: 木匠把木料堆在了工坊旁邊。

en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.
example_en: The cattle gathered under a tree during the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨中，牛群聚集在一棵樹下。

zh: 陰涼處；背陰；色調；顏色深淺；遮陽；遮蔽
en: an area protected from direct sunlight | a particular form of a colour | to protect something from direct light
example_en: We rested in the shade beneath a large tree.
example_zh: 我們在一棵大樹下的陰涼處休息。

zh: 消耗；耗費；吃；喝；充滿內心；吞噬
en: to use resources, energy, or time | to eat food or drink liquids | to fill someone's mind or destroy something completely
example_en: Our old heater consumes too much electricity in winter.
example_zh: 我們那臺舊取暖器冬天太耗電了。

en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.
example_en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
example_zh: 一頭粉色的豬正睡在木柵欄旁。

en: The soft tissue between the skin and bones. | The soft inner part of a fruit or vegetable.
example_en: The ripe peach had sweet flesh and a small stone.
example_zh: 這顆熟桃果肉香甜，果核很小。

en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs
example_en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
example_zh: 一隻白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿過草地，朝我們跑來。

zh: 有機種植的；有機的；有機物的；生物體的；自然發展的
en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides | relating to living things or carbon-based substances | developing gradually and naturally rather than through outside intervention
example_en: She buys organic carrots from a nearby farm.
example_zh: 她從附近的農場購買有機胡蘿蔔。

en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse
example_en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
example_zh: 一隻大鼠鑽到大門附近的垃圾桶後面，不見了。

zh: 漂浮；浮動；提出供考慮；遊行彩車
en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air. | To suggest an idea for others to consider. | A decorated vehicle used in a parade.
example_en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
example_zh: 一片黃葉輕輕漂過花園裡的池塘。

zh: 松樹；松木；苦苦思念；憔悴
en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces. | Long deeply for someone or something, sometimes becoming weak.
example_en: We rested beneath a tall pine after lunch.
example_zh: 午飯後，我們在一棵高大的松樹下休息。

en: Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition. | To injure someone or damage something.
example_en: Too much sunlight can harm the leaves of this plant.
example_zh: 陽光過強會損傷這種植物的葉子。

zh: 簇；群；聚集體；聚集；使聚集
en: a group of similar things positioned or occurring close together | to gather closely together or make things gather together
example_en: A cluster of purple flowers grew beside the gate.
example_zh: 大門旁長著一簇紫色的花。

en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them. | Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.
example_en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
example_zh: 請把垃圾放進外面的垃圾桶。

zh: 清除；處置；供支配；供使用
en: The process of getting rid of unwanted things | The state of being available for someone's use
example_en: The council provides bins for the disposal of batteries.
example_zh: 市政部門提供專門的回收箱，用於處理廢舊電池。

en: the natural environment where an animal or plant lives
example_en: This pond provides a perfect habitat for frogs.
example_zh: 這個池塘為青蛙提供了理想的棲息地。

zh: 穀物；糧食；顆粒；細粒；木材紋理
en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food | a very small hard piece of a substance | the natural pattern of lines in wood
example_en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
example_zh: 農民把糧食存放在乾燥的穀倉裡。

en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres
example_en: Their vegetable garden covers almost an acre behind the house.
example_zh: 他們屋後的菜園佔地近一英畝。

en: Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products
example_en: My grandparents earn their living from sheep farming.
example_zh: 我的祖父母以養羊為生。

en: A large bird often raised for its meat | Meat from a turkey, eaten as food | Something that fails badly, especially a film or play
example_en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
example_zh: 一隻火雞在農場大門旁展開了尾羽。

en: a small area of still water surrounded by land
example_en: A green frog jumped into the pond beside our house.
example_zh: 一隻綠青蛙跳進了我們屋旁的池塘。

en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.
example_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
example_zh: 那頭獅子在樹蔭下休息。

en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.
example_en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
example_zh: 一隻綠色的小昆蟲落在了我的袖子上。

zh: 鮭魚；三文魚；其魚肉；鮭肉粉紅色的
en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food | having a pink colour with a slight orange shade
example_en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
example_zh: 我們看著一條鮭魚在多石的溪流中躍向上遊。

zh: 莖；梗；源於；由…造成；遏制；阻止
en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit | originate or result from something | stop or reduce an unwanted flow or increase
example_en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
example_zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花莖，再給花瓶加水。

zh: 狩獵；獵捕；搜尋；尋找；搜尋；狩獵
en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them | to search carefully for someone or something | an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals
example_en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
example_zh: 我們在沙發底下找我的鑰匙。

zh: 原木；木柴；日誌；記錄；記錄
en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree | a detailed record of events or activities | to record information about events, activities, or measurements
example_en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
example_zh: 我們坐在湖邊一段倒下的樹幹上。

en: a long reptile without legs | to move or extend along a winding path
example_en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
example_zh: 一條小蛇悄悄滑過乾草叢。

en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.
example_en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
example_zh: 散步回來後，我們的靴子上沾滿了泥。

zh: 鴨；鴨肉；低頭躲閃；彎身避開；逃避；迴避
en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat | Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something | Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation
example_en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
example_zh: 一隻鴨子帶著幾隻小鴨從我們身旁遊過。

zh: 漂流；飄移；逐漸偏離；無目的移動；大意；主旨
en: To move slowly, carried by water or air. | To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control. | The general meaning of what someone says or writes.
example_en: We watched a fallen leaf drift across the pond.
example_zh: 我們看著一片落葉緩緩漂過池塘。

zh: 樹幹；象鼻；汽車後備箱（美式）
en: The thick main stem of a tree. | An elephant's long nose, used for breathing and holding things. | The enclosed space in a car for carrying luggage.
example_en: We rested against the trunk of an old oak.
example_zh: 我們靠著一棵老橡樹的樹幹休息。

en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.
example_en: She grows fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example_zh: 她在廚房窗邊的花盆裡種了新鮮香草。

zh: 海洋的；海生的；海運的；船舶的；海軍陸戰隊員
en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it | Relating to ships and transport by sea | A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea
example_en: We watched a documentary about marine life last night.
example_zh: 我們昨晚看了一部關于海洋生物的紀錄片。

zh: 洪水；水災；淹沒；被水淹；大量湧來的人或事物
en: Water covering land that is normally dry. | To cover with water or become covered with water. | A large amount of something arriving at once.
example_en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
example_zh: 洪水退去後，我們的花園覆滿了厚厚的淤泥。

en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.
example_en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
example_zh: 我們躲在樹後，靜靜地觀察野生動物。

zh: 壯觀的；引人注目的；驚人的；顯著的
en: extremely impressive to see or experience | unusually great or impressive in degree
example_en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
example_zh: 我們在山頂看了一場壯觀的日落。

en: a large tree that produces acorns | the strong, hard wood of an oak tree
example_en: We spread our picnic blanket beneath a huge oak.
example_zh: 我們在一棵巨大的橡樹下鋪開野餐毯。

zh: 動物的角；車輛喇叭；圓號；號角
en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals. | A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound. | A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.
example_en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
example_zh: 那隻山羊的角卡在了柵欄裡。

en: Originating or living naturally in a place, rather than arriving later.
example_en: These flowers are indigenous to the valley near our village.
example_zh: 這些花原產於我們村莊附近的山谷。

zh: 蝙蝠；球棒；球拍；用球棒擊球
en: A flying mammal usually active at night. | An object used to hit the ball in certain sports. | To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.
example_en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
example_zh: 黃昏時，一隻蝙蝠從我們花園上方飛過。

en: Animal reproduction, or controlled reproduction of animals and plants. | Polite behaviour learned through someone's upbringing.
example_en: We avoid disturbing the birds during the breeding season.
example_zh: 我們在繁殖季節避免打擾鳥類。

zh: 繁殖；培育；品種；滋生；導致
en: To produce young, or keep animals to produce young. | A group of domestic animals sharing particular inherited characteristics. | To cause something, especially something harmful, to develop.
example_en: These birds usually breed here during the warmer months.
example_zh: 這些鳥通常在天氣較暖的月份在這裡繁殖。

zh: 陡峭的；急劇的；價格過高的；浸泡
en: rising or falling at a sharp angle | describing a sharp change or an unusually high price | to leave something in liquid to release flavour or soften it
example_en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
example_zh: 我們推著腳踏車爬上了陡坡。

en: A natural tendency to behave without learning or conscious thought. | A feeling about something that does not involve conscious reasoning.
example_en: By instinct, the newborn kitten searched for its mother.
example_zh: 剛出生的小貓本能地尋找媽媽。

en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight
example_en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
example_zh: 一隻鷹在岩石遍佈的山谷上方緩緩盤旋。

zh: 鳥巢；窩；築巢；在巢中棲居
en: A structure animals build to hold eggs or raise their young. | Build or occupy a nest.
example_en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥把細樹枝銜回巢裡。

en: the natural light that comes from the sun
example_en: Warm sunlight streamed through the window onto my desk.
example_zh: 溫暖的陽光透過窗戶灑在我的書桌上。

zh: 垃圾；廢棄物；廢話；無價值的東西
en: waste material that people throw away | something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality
example_en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
example_zh: 請在垃圾發臭之前把它拿出去。

zh: 黎明；拂曉；開端；萌芽；開始明白；破曉
en: the early morning when daylight first appears | the beginning of a new period or development | to become understood, or to begin growing light
example_en: We left at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic.
example_zh: 我們黎明時就出發了，以避開擁堵的交通。

zh: 處理；丟棄；使傾向於；使願意
en: to get rid of something, used with of | to make someone likely or willing to do something
example_en: Where can I dispose of these old batteries safely?
example_zh: 我可以在哪裡安全地處理這些舊電池？

en: a large farm building for storing crops or keeping animals
example_en: We stacked the hay inside the barn before sunset.
example_zh: 我們在日落前把乾草堆進了穀倉。

zh: 樹籬；防範損失的手段；迴避明確表態；含糊其辭
en: a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary | something that reduces the risk of financial loss | to avoid giving a clear or definite answer
example_en: A thick hedge separates our garden from the pavement.
example_zh: 一道茂密的樹籬將我們的花園與人行道隔開。

zh: 淺的；膚淺的；淺薄的；呼吸淺的
en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom | Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth | Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs
example_en: The children splashed happily in the shallow end of the pool.
example_zh: 孩子們在泳池淺水區開心地戲水。

en: a container with bars or wire for keeping animals inside | to put or keep an animal in a cage
example_en: The rabbit's cage has fresh hay and clean water.
example_zh: 兔籠裡有新鮮的乾草和乾淨的水。

en: a wild animal related to dogs, often living in packs | to eat food very quickly and eagerly
example_en: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
example_zh: 一隻灰狼靜靜地站在森林邊緣。

en: a young sheep | meat from a young sheep, eaten as food
example_en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
example_zh: 一隻小羊跟著媽媽穿過田野。

zh: 獵物；受害者；受騙者；捕食；欺凌；坑害
en: An animal hunted and eaten by another animal. | Someone targeted for harm or exploitation. | To hunt animals or exploit vulnerable people, usually with on.
example_en: The owl watched its prey from a low branch.
example_zh: 貓頭鷹從一根低矮的樹枝上注視著獵物。

zh: 異國情調的；奇異的；外來的；非本土的
en: Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries. | Originating outside the region where something is now found.
example_en: The market sells exotic fruits I have never tasted.
example_zh: 市場裡賣著我從未嘗過的異國水果。

en: an adult male animal of the cattle family | an investor who expects market prices to rise
example_en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example_zh: 一頭大公牛靜靜地站在農場門旁。

en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.
example_en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
example_zh: 今天一大早，一隻海豚在我們的船邊躍出水面。

en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.
example_en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
example_zh: 一頭鯨在我們船旁浮出水面，噴出了水霧。

en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey
example_en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
example_zh: 一隻蜜蜂輕輕落在那朵黃花上。

zh: 蘑菇；迅速增長；迅速湧現
en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible. | Grow or increase very quickly.
example_en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
example_zh: 我在午餐的湯里加了切片蘑菇。

en: Dried cereal stems used for animal bedding and other purposes. | A narrow tube used for drinking liquids.
example_en: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
example_zh: 農民在穀倉地上鋪了一層新鮮的麥稈。

en: A very large animal with a long trunk and large ears.
example_en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
example_zh: 大象用鼻子把水噴到自己的背上。

en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth. | Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.
example_en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
example_zh: 我們看著一條鯊魚在水族館的玻璃後緩緩遊動。

zh: 香味；氣味；氣味蹤跡；嗅到；聞出
en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one. | A smell left behind that an animal can follow. | To detect something by its smell.
example_en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
example_zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整個廚房。

en: a cereal crop whose grain is commonly ground into flour
example_en: Golden wheat swayed in the field behind our house.
example_zh: 我們屋後的田野裡，金黃的小麥隨風搖曳。

zh: 熱帶叢林；競爭殘酷的環境
en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees | A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition
example_en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
example_zh: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狹窄的叢林小路上方。

en: Living things and their environment interacting as a connected system.
example_en: This small pond supports a surprisingly rich ecosystem.
example_zh: 這個小池塘維繫著一個豐富得令人驚訝的生態系統。

en: One of the light, soft structures covering a bird's body.
example_en: A white feather floated gently onto the garden path.
example_zh: 一根白色羽毛輕輕飄落在花園小徑上。

en: A plant growing where it is not wanted. | To remove unwanted plants from an area.
example_en: A stubborn weed has grown between the paving stones.
example_zh: 鋪路石的縫隙間長出了一株頑強的雜草。

en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.
example_en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
example_zh: 一隻小猴子在我們頭頂的樹枝間盪來盪去。

en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail. | To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.
example_en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
example_zh: 日出前，一隻狐狸悄悄穿過花園。

en: To grow strongly or become successful.
example_en: These herbs thrive on our sunny kitchen windowsill.
example_zh: 這些香草在我們廚房陽光充足的窗臺上長得很旺。

en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.
example_en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，我們廚房窗邊的一朵白百合開了。

en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.
example_en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
example_zh: 一隻好奇的山羊把頭探出了圍欄。

zh: 捕食者；食肉動物；掠奪者；剝削者
en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals. | A person or organisation that exploits others for personal gain.
example_en: The rabbit froze when it noticed a predator nearby.
example_zh: 兔子發現附近有捕食者時，一動也不敢動。

en: the thick soft hair covering some animals | animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing
example_en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
example_zh: 貓溼漉漉的毛在陽光下很快就幹了。

zh: 陽光；歡樂；帶來快樂的人或事
en: light and warmth coming from the sun | happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness
example_en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
example_zh: 我們在外面溫暖的陽光下吃了早餐。

en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur
example_en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
example_zh: 那隻老虎在水池旁的陰涼處休息。

en: tiny water drops in the air that reduce visibility | to become or make something covered with tiny water drops
example_en: A thin mist floated above the lake this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，湖面上飄著一層薄霧。

en: small stones used to cover paths or make concrete
example_en: Gravel crunched beneath our shoes as we approached the cottage.
example_zh: 我們走近小屋時，腳下的碎石發出嘎吱聲。

zh: 採石場；開採石料；獵物；追捕物件
en: A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground. | To dig stone out of the ground. | An animal or person being hunted or pursued.
example_en: Huge trucks carried pale stone out of the quarry.
example_zh: 巨型卡車把淺色石料運出了採石場。

zh: 毀滅性的；破壞極大的；令人極度悲痛的
en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction. | Causing overwhelming sadness or emotional shock.
example_en: A devastating storm tore the roof off our garage.
example_zh: 一場破壞力極強的暴風雨掀掉了我們車庫的屋頂。

en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered | to gather crops when they are ready
example_en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
example_zh: 我們做了一個自制蘋果派，慶祝蘋果豐收。

zh: 密集的；濃密的；晦澀難懂的；愚鈍的
en: Containing many things packed closely together | Difficult to understand because information is tightly packed | Slow to understand things
example_en: Dense fog hid the bridge from our kitchen window.
example_zh: 濃霧遮住了從我們廚房視窗能看到的那座橋。

zh: 陽光充足的；晴朗的；開朗的；樂觀的
en: having plenty of bright sunlight | cheerful and positive in character or mood
example_en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，我們在陽光充足的陽臺上吃了早餐。

zh: 不破壞環境的；可持續的；可長期維持的
en: Using resources without exhausting them or causing lasting environmental damage. | Able to continue over a long period.
example_en: She chooses sustainable products with little or no plastic packaging.
example_zh: 她選擇塑膠包裝很少或不用塑膠包裝的環保產品。

en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.
example_en: High ozone levels kept us from jogging outside today.
example_zh: 今天臭氧濃度高，我們沒有到戶外慢跑。

en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body. | A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.
example_en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
example_zh: 一隻黃色蝴蝶輕輕落在我的袖子上。

en: a small animal with a long, soft body and no legs | a harmful computer program that copies itself across networks
example_en: A worm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
example_zh: 一條蚯蚓從花園溼潤的泥土裡蠕動著鑽了出來。

en: The places, objects, and conditions around a person or thing.
example_en: We ate lunch in the peaceful surroundings of the garden.
example_zh: 我們在花園寧靜的環境中吃了午飯。

en: Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.
example_en: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
example_zh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們的渡輪航班取消了。

en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm
example_en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
example_zh: 整個冬天，我們都在溫室裡種番茄。

en: a group of large animals living or moving together | to guide animals or people together in a particular direction
example_en: A herd of cows blocked the narrow country road.
example_zh: 一群奶牛堵住了狹窄的鄉間道路。

zh: 適應；適應性變化；改編作品；改裝；調整
en: The process of changing to suit new conditions. | A work changed into another form, such as a film. | A change made to something to suit a particular purpose.
example_en: Our adaptation to the colder weather took several weeks.
example_zh: 我們花了幾個星期才適應較冷的天氣。

en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.
example_en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
example_zh: 海豚雖然生活在水下，卻是哺乳動物。

en: A substance used to kill pests that damage crops.
example_en: The farmer wore protective clothing while spraying pesticide on crops.
example_zh: 農民向作物噴灑農藥時穿著防護服。

en: to make a very loud, deep sound | a very loud, deep sound
example_en: The lion roared, and its cubs huddled closer together.
example_zh: 獅子吼了一聲，幼獅們擠得更緊了。

en: Impressive beauty, grandeur, or dignity that inspires admiration. | A title used when addressing or referring to a monarch.
example_en: We stood silently, amazed by the majesty of the mountains.
example_zh: 我們靜靜地站著，為群山的雄偉所震撼。

en: to cause someone or something to suffer harm
example_en: The storm inflicted serious damage on our garden fence.
example_zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了我們花園的圍欄。

en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils | a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change
example_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example_zh: 我們在博物館看到了一具巨大的恐龍骨架。

zh: 鳥群；羊群；蜂擁；成群聚集
en: A group of birds, sheep, or goats | Go or gather somewhere in large numbers
example_en: A flock of geese landed beside the quiet lake.
example_zh: 一群鵝落在了寧靜的湖邊。

en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.
example_en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
example_zh: 一隻綠色的青蛙從石頭上跳進了我們的池塘。

en: A horse of a small breed.
example_en: The little pony gently ate a carrot from my hand.
example_zh: 那匹小矮種馬輕輕地吃著我手裡的胡蘿蔔。

en: a very large quantity of something
example_en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
example_zh: 我們的花園每年夏天都結出大量番茄。

zh: 小牛；某些大型動物的幼崽；小腿肚
en: A young cow or another large mammal, such as an elephant. | The fleshy back part of the leg below the knee.
example_en: The calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
example_zh: 那頭小牛在田野裡緊緊跟著媽媽。

en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet. | Meat from a goose, eaten as food.
example_en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
example_zh: 一隻白鵝搖搖擺擺地穿過小路，朝我們走來。

zh: 繁榮；茁壯成長；揮舞以引人注意；誇張動作；華麗裝飾
en: To grow strongly or develop successfully. | To wave something in a way that attracts attention. | A showy movement or decorative detail.
example_en: These herbs flourish on our warm, sunny kitchen windowsill.
example_zh: 這些香草在我們廚房溫暖、陽光充足的窗臺上長得很旺。

en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs
example_en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
example_zh: 一隻小蜘蛛在我們窗邊結了網。

en: To prepare land for crops or grow plants | To deliberately develop a skill, quality, interest, or relationship
example_en: My grandparents cultivate vegetables in a small garden behind their house.
example_zh: 我的祖父母在屋後的小菜園裡種菜。

en: a field of grass, often containing wildflowers
example_en: We spread our picnic blanket in a sunny meadow.
example_zh: 我們在陽光明媚的草地上鋪開了野餐毯。

en: Very strong, powerful, or large. | Very; used informally to make a description stronger.
example_en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
example_zh: 田野中央矗立著一棵高大的橡樹。

en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.
example_en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯時，一隻蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。

en: a safe or peaceful place away from danger or trouble
example_en: Our little garden is a haven from city noise.
example_zh: 我們的小花園是遠離城市喧囂的一片寧靜之地。

en: to balance or reduce the effect of something
example_en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
example_zh: 通勤時間縮短彌補了這裡租金較高的不足。

en: Materials used to wrap and protect products.
example_en: This toy comes with far too much plastic packaging.
example_zh: 這個玩具用了太多塑膠包裝。

en: The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.
example_en: The mother duck led her offspring safely across the path.
example_zh: 鴨媽媽帶著小鴨們安全地穿過小路。

en: A large farm growing crops such as tea, coffee, or cotton. | An area where trees are planted together, often for timber.
example_en: We walked past a tea plantation on the hillside.
example_zh: 我們從山坡上的一片茶園旁走過。

zh: 日落；日落時分；落日景象；晚霞
en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon | the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down
example_en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在日落前剛好趕到了海灘。

en: Land covered with grass where farm animals feed. | To put animals on grassland so they can feed.
example_en: The cows wandered across the green pasture after sunrise.
example_zh: 日出後，牛群在綠色的牧草地上漫步。

en: tiny sea animals, or the hard structures they build | having a pinkish-orange colour
example_en: Bright fish swam between branches of coral beneath us.
example_zh: 色彩鮮豔的魚在我們下方的珊瑚枝間遊動。

en: to process used materials so they can be used again
example_en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
example_zh: 我們把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.
example_en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
example_zh: 一隻螞蟻叼著麵包屑爬過廚房地板。

en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.
example_en: An accumulation of dust covered the old wooden shelves.
example_zh: 一層積灰覆蓋了那些舊木架。

en: plants growing together in a particular area
example_en: Thick vegetation hid the narrow path beside the river.
example_zh: 茂密的植被遮住了河邊的狹窄小路。

en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog | a short, loud sound made by a dog | the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch
example_en: Our dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
example_zh: 每當有人敲門，我們的狗就會叫。

en: a unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres
example_en: Their vegetable farm covers just over a hectare.
example_zh: 他們的蔬菜農場佔地略多於一公頃。

en: A water-filled container for keeping fish and other aquatic animals | A public building where people can see aquatic animals
example_en: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
example_zh: 兩條橙色的魚在我們魚缸裡的水草間遊動。

en: become stronger or more extreme, or make something so
example_en: The rain intensified as we hurried towards the station.
example_zh: 我們匆忙趕往車站時，雨下得更大了。

zh: 脆弱性；易受傷害性；弱點；安全漏洞
en: The state of being easily harmed, affected, or attacked. | A weakness that allows damage or an attack.
example_en: The storm exposed the vulnerability of our old roof.
example_zh: 暴風雨暴露了我們舊屋頂的脆弱。

en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food
example_en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
example_zh: 我今天做了一個金槍魚三明治當午餐。

en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again | waste materials collected to be processed and used again
example_en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
example_zh: 我們這棟樓分別設有回收物桶和廚餘垃圾桶。

zh: 腐爛；腐朽；腐爛；腐朽；衰敗；衰退
en: to gradually break down through natural processes | the natural process of rotting or breaking down | a gradual loss of strength, quality, or importance
example_en: Fallen leaves decay slowly beneath the trees each winter.
example_zh: 每到冬天，落葉都會在樹下慢慢腐爛。

en: To live in a particular place or environment
example_en: Tiny crabs inhabit the rock pools near our house.
example_zh: 我們家附近的岩石潮池裡棲息著小螃蟹。

en: A plump bird with short legs, commonly seen in cities
example_en: A grey pigeon landed on the bench beside me.
example_zh: 一隻灰鴿子落在了我身旁的長椅上。

zh: 果實成熟的；時機成熟的；適宜的
en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest | Ready for a particular action or development
example_en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
example_zh: 這些熟桃子聞起來很香，吃起來很甜。

zh: 大片土地；地帶；道；束等身體結構；宣教或政論小冊子
en: a large area of land | a connected system of organs or tissues with a shared function | a short publication expressing religious or political ideas
example_en: They bought a small cottage beside a vast tract of woodland.
example_zh: 他們在一大片林地旁買了一棟小屋。

en: a small, usually round fruit, often growing in clusters
example_en: She dropped a ripe berry into her bowl of yoghurt.
example_zh: 她把一顆熟透的莓果放進酸奶碗裡。

zh: 北極的；極寒的；北極地區
en: Relating to the region around the North Pole. | Extremely cold. | The region surrounding the North Pole.
example_en: An arctic fox curled up beside a snowy rock.
example_zh: 一隻北極狐蜷縮在一塊覆雪的岩石旁。

en: A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree
example_en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥躲在開花的灌木下面。

en: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work
example_en: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
example_zh: 農民把牲畜趕進了一塊有遮蔽的田地。

zh: 橄欖；油橄欖樹；橄欖綠的；淺褐色的
en: A small bitter fruit used for oil, or its tree | Yellowish green in colour, or describing light brown skin
example_en: She added a few olives to the fresh salad.
example_zh: 她在新鮮沙拉里加了幾顆橄欖。

zh: 旋轉；使打旋；旋渦；螺旋狀圖案
en: To move, or make something move, in flowing circles. | A circular movement or a shape that curves around itself.
example_en: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
example_zh: 乾枯的樹葉在風中繞著我的腳打轉。

en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.
example_en: We watched a lobster crawl across the rocky seabed.
example_zh: 我們看著一隻龍蝦爬過多石的海床。

en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.
example_en: Fresh fruit is abundant here during the summer.
example_zh: 這裡夏天有充足的新鮮水果。

zh: 多沙的；鋪滿沙的；沙色的；淺黃褐色的
en: covered with sand or containing a lot of sand | light yellowish brown in colour, especially describing hair
example_en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
example_zh: 我們把鞋放在了沙地小路旁。

en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound
example_en: These small lamps emit a soft, warm light.
example_zh: 這些小燈發出柔和溫暖的光。

en: A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.
example_en: The oyster shell felt rough against my fingers.
example_zh: 牡蠣殼摸起來很粗糙。

en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow
example_en: We added fertilizer to help the tomato plants grow.
example_zh: 我們施了肥，幫助番茄植株生長。

en: A person who looks after sheep | To guide people carefully in a particular direction
example_en: The shepherd led the sheep home before sunset.
example_zh: 牧羊人在日落前把羊群領回了家。

en: Expected to happen very soon.
example_en: The dark clouds made a heavy downpour seem imminent.
example_zh: 烏雲密佈，眼看就要下大雨了。

zh: 嚴重破壞；摧毀；使極度悲痛；使震驚
en: To cause very severe damage to a place or thing | To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked
example_en: The storm devastated the village, leaving many homes damaged.
example_zh: 暴風雨重創了村莊，許多房屋受損。

en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment. | The relationships between living things and their environment.
example_en: My sister studies ecology and often visits local wetlands.
example_zh: 我姐姐學習生態學，經常去當地溼地考察。

zh: 樹木的花；花簇；開花；發展；興盛
en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush | to produce flowers | to develop successfully or become more confident
example_en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
example_zh: 廚房外的櫻桃樹開滿了粉紅色的花。

en: a small growth that develops into a leaf or flower | to produce new buds
example_en: A tiny green bud appeared on the bare branch.
example_zh: 光禿禿的樹枝上冒出了一個小小的綠芽。

en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty. | Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.
example_en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
example_zh: 我們在湖邊停下來欣賞風景。

en: a small group of trees, often planted together
example_en: We spread our picnic blanket in a shady grove.
example_zh: 我們在一片綠蔭濃密的小樹林裡鋪開了野餐毯。

en: A reptile with a protective shell, often living in water.
example_en: We watched a turtle swimming slowly over the reef.
example_zh: 我們看著一隻海龜在珊瑚礁上方緩緩遊動。

zh: 亂扔的垃圾；亂扔垃圾；使雜亂；一窩幼崽
en: Waste left scattered in public places. | To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place. | A group of young animals born to one mother together.
example_en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
example_zh: 午飯前，我們沿著海灘撿垃圾。

zh: 遷徙；移居；遷移資料或系統
en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there | to move data or software to a different computer system
example_en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
example_zh: 天氣轉冷時，這些鳥會向南遷徙。

en: Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains
example_en: Untreated sewage flowed into the river after the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨過後，未經處理的汙水流入了河裡。

en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning | Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise
example_en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
example_zh: 一聲突如其來的雷鳴震得窗戶直晃。

en: Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.
example_en: Keep the soil moist until the first leaves appear.
example_zh: 在第一批葉子長出之前，保持土壤溼潤。

en: A smooth, usually pale gem formed inside certain shellfish.
example_en: A single pearl hung from her silver necklace.
example_zh: 她的銀項鍊上掛著一顆珍珠。

zh: 開花；花朵；開花；蓬勃發展；煥發光彩
en: To produce flowers. | A flower, or the state of producing flowers. | To develop successfully or become more confident and attractive.
example_en: The roses bloom beside our kitchen window every summer.
example_zh: 每年夏天，玫瑰都在我們的廚房窗邊盛開。

zh: 圍場；圍起來的區域；信函附件；圍住；圈地
en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier. | Something placed inside an envelope together with a letter. | The act of surrounding land with a boundary.
example_en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
example_zh: 山羊在穀倉旁的圍欄裡休息。

zh: 害蟲；有害動物；討厭的人；煩人精
en: An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property. | Someone who annoys others, especially repeatedly.
example_en: These tiny pests have eaten holes in my cabbage leaves.
example_zh: 這些小害蟲把我的捲心菜葉咬出了洞。

en: All the plants naturally growing in a particular area.
example_en: Our guide pointed out the island's unusual flora.
example_zh: 導遊向我們介紹了島上不同尋常的植物。

en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering
example_en: The flood was a catastrophe for our small village.
example_zh: 那場洪水給我們的小村莊帶來了一場災難。

en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white
example_en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
example_zh: 一隻白天鵝悄無聲息地遊過湖面。

en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand
example_en: Fresh vegetables became scarce after snow blocked the roads.
example_zh: 大雪封路後，新鮮蔬菜變得緊缺。

en: A young dog.
example_en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example_zh: 小狗鑽進我的空鞋子裡睡著了。

en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh. | The white flesh of a coconut, used as food.
example_en: We shared a fresh coconut beside the beach.
example_zh: 我們在海灘邊分著吃了一個新鮮椰子。

en: A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America
example_en: We watched tall grass ripple across the open prairie.
example_zh: 我們看著高高的草在開闊的大草原上起伏。

en: A place where waste is buried in the ground. | The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.
example_en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
example_zh: 卡車把我們的垃圾運到了附近的填埋場。

en: To put seeds in soil so they can grow. | To cause feelings or problems to begin and spread.
example_en: We sowed carrot seeds in the garden this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，我們在花園裡播下了胡蘿蔔種子。

zh: 暮色；晨昏微光；衰落時期；暮年
en: The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise | The final stage of something as its strength or importance fades
example_en: We walked home through the park in the twilight.
example_zh: 我們在暮色中穿過公園走回家。

en: A small rodent with a bushy tail, often living in trees. | To store something secretly for later use, usually with away.
example_en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
example_zh: 一隻松鼠在我們花園門旁埋了一顆堅果。

en: A farm tool that turns soil before crops are planted | To turn soil with a plough before planting
example_en: The farmer pulled an old plough from the shed.
example_zh: 農民從棚裡拖出了一把舊犁。

zh: 爪；爪子；螯；鉗；用爪抓；用力抓撓
en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot | a jointed gripping part on a crab or similar animal | to scratch or pull at something with claws or fingers
example_en: The cat caught my sleeve with one sharp claw.
example_zh: 貓用一隻尖爪鉤住了我的袖子。

en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.
example_en: The farm's irrigation system keeps these vegetables growing.
example_zh: 農場的灌溉系統讓這些蔬菜持續生長。

en: the complete disappearance of a species or type of thing
example_en: These rare birds face extinction if their forest disappears.
example_zh: 如果這片森林消失，這些珍稀鳥類就會面臨滅絕。

zh: 木材；鋸好的木料；笨重地緩慢移動
en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English. | To move slowly and awkwardly because of weight or size.
example_en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
example_zh: 我們買了些木料，準備做一張花園長椅。

en: an animal like a small horse with long ears
example_en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
example_zh: 一頭灰驢馱著籃子走在狹窄的山路上。

en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast
example_en: A strange orange fungus was growing on the fallen tree.
example_zh: 倒下的樹上長著一種奇怪的橙色真菌。

zh: 吃草；放牧；擦傷；擦過；擦傷
en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it | to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing | a small injury where skin has been scraped off
example_en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
example_zh: 每個夏日清晨，羊群都在河邊安靜地吃草。

zh: 平穩滑行；輕盈移動；滑翔
en: To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise. | To fly without engine power or without moving the wings.
example_en: The swan glided across the pond towards the reeds.
example_zh: 天鵝平穩地遊過池塘，朝蘆葦叢靠近。

zh: 大火；烈火；熊熊燃燒；強烈照耀
en: a large, strong fire | to burn fiercely or shine very brightly
example_en: Firefighters rescued the family from the blaze last night.
example_zh: 昨晚，消防員從大火中救出了這家人。

en: A path intended for walking rather than driving.
example_en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
example_zh: 一條狹窄的小徑從我們村通向湖邊。

en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.
example_en: A shiny beetle crawled slowly across the garden path.
example_zh: 一隻發亮的甲蟲緩緩爬過花園小徑。

en: The time when daylight fades before night.
example_en: We reached the campsite at dusk and lit a lantern.
example_zh: 我們在黃昏時到達營地，點亮了一盞燈。

en: A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water | A thin strip that vibrates to produce sound in certain instruments
example_en: A small bird balanced on a reed beside the pond.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥穩穩地停在池塘邊的一根蘆葦上。

en: To move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction. | A small pointed object thrown at a target.
example_en: A squirrel darted across the path ahead of us.
example_zh: 一隻松鼠在我們前方飛快地穿過小路。

en: A baby bird, especially a young chicken.
example_en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the yard.
example_zh: 一隻黃色小雞跟著母雞穿過院子。

zh: （能源、資源）可再生的；可續期的
en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use. | Able to be extended for another period of time.
example_en: Our new solar panels provide renewable energy for the house.
example_zh: 我們新裝的太陽能板為房子提供可再生能源。

en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.
example_en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
example_zh: 我們早早醒來，觀看湖上的日出。

zh: 樹樁；殘餘根部；難倒；使困惑
en: the base remaining after a tree or object is cut | to leave someone unable to answer or solve something
example_en: We sat on a tree stump to eat lunch.
example_zh: 我們坐在一個樹樁上吃午飯。

en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary | the removal of a competitor from a competition
example_en: Regular cleaning helps with the elimination of unpleasant kitchen smells.
example_zh: 定期清潔有助於消除廚房裡的難聞氣味。

en: A substance that makes air, water, or soil dirty or harmful.
example_en: This filter removes harmful pollutants from our drinking water.
example_zh: 這個過濾器能去除我們飲用水中的有害汙染物。

zh: 孵化；孵出；艙口；小開口；秘密策劃
en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen | an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall | to develop a plan, often secretly
example_en: We watched three chicks hatch on the farm yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在農場看著三隻小雞破殼而出。

en: make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances
example_en: Dirty hands can contaminate food while you cook.
example_zh: 做飯時，不乾淨的手可能會汙染食物。

en: A black material made by heating wood with little air. | Charcoal sticks used for drawing.
example_en: We cooked the vegetables over glowing charcoal in the garden.
example_zh: 我們在花園裡用燒得通紅的木炭烤蔬菜。

en: a dense forest in an area receiving very heavy rainfall
example_en: We spotted colourful birds high in the rainforest canopy.
example_zh: 我們在雨林高高的樹冠層中發現了色彩鮮豔的鳥兒。

zh: 取回；收回；開墾；使土地可用；回收利用
en: Get back something that belongs or previously belonged to you | Make damaged or submerged land suitable for use | Recover useful materials from waste for reuse
example_en: I returned to the station to reclaim my suitcase.
example_zh: 我回到車站取回自己的行李箱。

en: a long flexible animal part used for touching or grasping
example_en: The octopus wrapped a tentacle around a small shell.
example_zh: 章魚用一條觸手纏住了一枚小貝殼。

zh: 在戶外；向戶外；野外；戶外環境
en: outside a building, in the open air | the natural world away from buildings
example_en: The weather is warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
example_zh: 今晚天氣夠暖和，可以在戶外吃飯。

en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger
example_en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
example_zh: 突如其來的暴風雨使小船陷入險境。

en: Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs. | Meat from farmed birds such as chickens and turkeys.
example_en: My aunt keeps poultry in a spacious backyard enclosure.
example_zh: 我阿姨在後院一個寬敞的圍欄裡養家禽。

zh: 節約；避免浪費；保護；儲存
en: Use resources carefully to avoid wasting them. | Protect something valuable from damage, loss, or destruction.
example_en: We collect rainwater to conserve water in the garden.
example_zh: 我們收集雨水，以節約花園用水。

en: To exist in large quantities or be very common
example_en: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
example_zh: 每年春天，我們屋後的田野裡都開滿野花。

en: a bird often associated with peace | someone who favours peaceful solutions rather than military action
example_en: A white dove landed gently on our garden wall.
example_zh: 一隻白鴿輕輕落在我們花園的圍牆上。

en: Land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.
example_en: We cycled around the peninsula and stopped at a beach.
example_zh: 我們騎車繞著半島遊覽，在一處海灘停了下來。

zh: 惡化；退化；降解；受辱；尊嚴喪失
en: The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality. | The breakdown of a substance into simpler substances. | The loss of dignity caused by humiliating treatment.
example_en: The farmer noticed soil degradation across his dry fields.
example_zh: 農民發現他乾燥的田地普遍出現了土壤退化。

en: extremely large in size or amount
example_en: A gigantic pumpkin filled the entire kitchen table.
example_zh: 一個巨大的南瓜佔滿了整張餐桌。

en: a reptile with a long tail, usually with four legs
example_en: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
example_zh: 一隻小蜥蜴趴在花園裡溫暖的牆上。

en: An edible nut with a wrinkled kernel and hard shell. | A tree producing walnuts, or its wood used for furniture.
example_en: She cracked a walnut and shared the kernel with me.
example_zh: 她敲開一個核桃，把核桃仁分給了我一些。

zh: 鷹；鷹派人物；強硬派；沿街叫賣；兜售
en: a hunting bird with sharp claws and a curved beak | someone who supports forceful policies, especially military action | to sell goods by offering them in public places
example_en: A hawk circled slowly above the open field.
example_zh: 一隻鷹在空曠的田野上方緩緩盤旋。

en: An adult male chicken or another male bird. | To raise or tilt a body part, especially the head.
example_en: A red cock crowed loudly beside the wooden gate.
example_zh: 一隻紅色公雞在木門旁大聲啼叫。

en: A small, smooth stone, often found near water.
example_en: A smooth grey pebble lay beside my wet shoes.
example_zh: 我的溼鞋旁躺著一顆光滑的灰色卵石。

zh: 動物的爪；腳掌；用爪抓撓；用蹄刨
en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog | to scratch or touch something repeatedly with a paw or hoof
example_en: The puppy rested one muddy paw on my knee.
example_zh: 小狗把一隻沾滿泥的爪子搭在我的膝蓋上。

zh: 隔熱；隔音；絕緣；隔熱或絕緣材料
en: protection that reduces the passage of heat, sound, or electricity | material used to limit heat, sound, or electricity passing through
example_en: The new roof insulation keeps our bedroom warm.
example_zh: 新裝的屋頂隔熱層讓我們的臥室保持溫暖。

zh: 飄動；振翅；顫動；顫動；心悸
en: Move with quick, light movements, especially through air | A quick, light movement or brief uneven heartbeat
example_en: The curtains fluttered gently beside the open kitchen window.
example_zh: 窗簾在敞開的廚房窗邊輕輕飄動。

zh: 有限的；限定的（動詞形式）
en: Having a limit in size, amount, or duration | Having tense and sometimes showing person or number
example_en: Our holiday budget is finite, so choose carefully.
example_zh: 我們的度假預算有限，所以要仔細選擇。

en: A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight. | To repeatedly bother or pursue someone.
example_en: The hound followed a scent through the wet grass.
example_zh: 那隻獵犬循著氣味穿過溼漉漉的草地。

zh: 拍打；振翅；飄動；蓋片；垂片；慌亂；緊張
en: To move up and down repeatedly, or make something move. | A flat piece attached along one edge, often covering something. | A state of worry or unnecessary excitement.
example_en: The ducks flapped their wings and splashed across the pond.
example_zh: 鴨子們拍打著翅膀，濺著水花遊過池塘。

zh: 攀登；上升；地位提升；崛起；上坡路
en: the act of climbing or moving upwards | a rise to a higher position, rank, or level | a path or slope that leads upwards
example_en: We began our ascent just as the sun rose.
example_zh: 太陽剛升起，我們就開始攀登。

zh: 漣漪；細小波紋；泛起漣漪；使起波紋；逐漸擴散的反應或影響
en: A small wave on the surface of water. | To move in small waves or make something do so. | A reaction or effect that spreads through people or places.
example_en: A falling leaf sent ripples across the pond.
example_zh: 一片落葉在池塘水面上激起了圈圈漣漪。

zh: 蜇；刺痛；蜇傷；刺痛；刺傷感情；使難受
en: Cause sharp pain with a pointed body part or irritating substance | A painful insect injury or a sudden sharp pain | Make someone feel suddenly upset or hurt
example_en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
example_zh: 我澆花時，一隻蜜蜂蜇了我的腳踝。

en: A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.
example_en: A wasp landed on the edge of my glass.
example_zh: 一隻黃蜂落在了我的杯口上。

en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability | a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming
example_en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
example_zh: 我們看見一個鯊魚鰭剛剛露出水面。

en: A tall plant with hollow woody stems, or its strong material.
example_en: She planted bamboo along the fence for extra privacy.
example_zh: 她沿著圍欄種了竹子，讓院子更私密。

zh: 高原；平臺期；穩定水平；進入平臺期；趨於穩定
en: A large area of flat land higher than surrounding land. | A period when growth or progress stops after an increase. | To stop increasing or improving and remain at a steady level.
example_en: We camped on a grassy plateau above the valley.
example_zh: 我們在山谷上方一片長滿青草的高原上露營。

en: The amount of water vapour in the air
example_en: The high humidity made my shirt feel damp.
example_zh: 空氣溼度很高，我的襯衫摸起來潮潮的。

zh: 嚎叫；呼嘯；嚎叫聲；怒吼聲
en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound. | A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.
example_en: Our dog howled when the ambulance passed the house.
example_zh: 救護車經過家門時，我們的狗嚎叫起來。

zh: 烏鴉；雞啼；打鳴；得意地誇耀
en: A large black bird with a loud, rough call. | Make the loud call typical of a male chicken. | Talk proudly and annoyingly about your own success.
example_en: A crow landed on the fence beside our garden.
example_zh: 一隻烏鴉落在我們花園旁的圍欄上。

zh: 使惡化；降低質量；降解；分解；貶低；侮辱人格
en: To reduce the quality or condition of something | To break down chemically into simpler substances | To treat someone as though they deserve no respect
example_en: Strong sunlight can degrade the fabric of outdoor chairs.
example_zh: 強烈的陽光會損壞戶外椅子的面料。

zh: 猛烈抽打；猛烈衝擊；捆紮；綁牢；睫毛；鞭打
en: To strike forcefully, especially with a whip or like one. | To fasten things tightly together using rope or cord. | An eyelash, or a stroke delivered with a whip.
example_en: Heavy rain lashed the windows throughout the night.
example_zh: 大雨整夜猛烈地拍打著窗戶。

zh: 變暗；使變黑；臉色變陰沉；使憂鬱
en: to become darker or make something darker | to become or make someone look unhappy or angry
example_en: Heavy clouds darkened the sky before we reached home.
example_zh: 我們還沒到家，厚重的雲層就讓天空暗了下來。

zh: 鸚鵡；機械地重複；鸚鵡學舌
en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech | to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them
example_en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
example_zh: 那隻綠色鸚鵡用喙啄開了一粒種子。

en: A small green plant growing in soft patches on damp surfaces.
example_en: Thick green moss covered the stones beside the stream.
example_zh: 溪邊的石頭上覆蓋著厚厚的綠色苔蘚。

en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful
example_en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
example_zh: 請不要往小溪裡扔垃圾，汙染溪水。

zh: 貧瘠的；不毛的；無成果的；缺乏的
en: Unable to support much plant growth. | Producing nothing useful or lacking something important.
example_en: Only a few bushes grew on the barren hillside.
example_zh: 貧瘠的山坡上只長著幾叢灌木。

zh: 細枝；嫩枝；突然明白；察覺
en: a small, thin branch of a tree or bush | to suddenly understand or notice something
example_en: A sparrow carried a twig back to its nest.
example_zh: 一隻麻雀銜著一根細枝飛回了巢裡。

en: made from waste materials processed for use again
example_en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
example_zh: 這本筆記本完全由再生紙製成。

en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light | bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality
example_en: The tiny crystals sparkle whenever sunlight enters the room.
example_zh: 每當陽光照進房間，那些小水晶就閃閃發亮。

zh: 搶救；打撈；挽救；挽回；搶救；打撈；獲救財物
en: To save useful things from damage, loss, or destruction. | To prevent a situation or effort from failing completely. | The recovery of damaged property, or the property recovered.
example_en: We managed to salvage some books after the flood.
example_zh: 洪水過後，我們設法搶救出了一些書。

zh: 柑橘類果樹；柑橘類水果；柑橘類的
en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits. | Relating to fruits such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruit.
example_en: We squeezed fresh citrus juice over the salad.
example_zh: 我們在沙拉上擠了一些新鮮的柑橘類果汁。

zh: 蜂群；成群的昆蟲；蜂擁；成群移動
en: A large group of insects moving or gathering together. | Move or gather somewhere in large numbers.
example_en: A swarm of bees gathered on the apple tree.
example_zh: 一群蜜蜂聚集在蘋果樹上。

en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe
example_en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
example_zh: 厚窗簾幫助減輕了街上傳來的噪聲。

zh: 被俘的；受圈養的；俘虜；被囚禁者；無法自由離開的
en: kept somewhere and not allowed to leave | a person held prisoner | unable to leave or choose an alternative
example_en: The captive bird spread its wings inside the cage.
example_zh: 那隻被關著的鳥在籠子裡展開了翅膀。

en: The quality of containing many varied or valuable elements. | A deep, strong, or full quality of flavour or colour.
example_en: The richness of local wildlife amazed us during our walk.
example_zh: 散步時，當地野生生物的豐富多樣讓我們驚歎。

en: A large African ape with dark hair and powerful arms.
example_en: The young gorilla clung tightly to its mother's back.
example_zh: 那隻年幼的大猩猩緊緊趴在媽媽背上。

zh: 背陰的；成蔭的；可疑的；不正當的
en: Protected from direct sunlight by trees or other objects. | Seeming dishonest or possibly involved in illegal activities.
example_en: We found a shady spot beneath the old oak.
example_zh: 我們在老橡樹下找到了一處陰涼的地方。

zh: 大羽毛；羽飾；柱狀煙霧或水流
en: a large feather, especially one used for decoration | a rising mass of smoke, water, or dust
example_en: A bright plume decorated the dancer's tall hat.
example_zh: 舞者的高帽上裝飾著一根鮮豔的大羽毛。

en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions. | To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.
example_en: These delicate plants will perish if left outside tonight.
example_zh: 這些嬌嫩的植物如果今晚放在外面，就會凍死。

zh: 有毒的；惡毒的；充滿惡意的
en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death. | Extremely unkind or harmful to relationships.
example_en: Some colourful berries are poisonous, so leave them alone.
example_zh: 有些顏色鮮豔的漿果有毒，所以不要碰。

zh: 吞沒；完全籠罩；使陷入；壓倒
en: to surround or cover something completely | to overwhelm someone or something with a powerful situation
example_en: A sudden wave engulfed our sandcastle on the beach.
example_zh: 一個突如其來的浪頭吞沒了我們在沙灘上堆的沙堡。

en: to break down naturally, or cause something to do so | the process or condition of decaying
example_en: The peaches will rot if you leave them outside.
example_zh: 如果把桃子放在外面，它們會爛掉。

en: Available in large amounts or numbers.
example_en: Fresh berries are plentiful at the market this summer.
example_zh: 今年夏天，市場上的新鮮漿果供應充足。

zh: 一次性的；用後丟棄的；稅後可支配的
en: intended to be thrown away after use | available for spending or saving after taxes are paid
example_en: We packed disposable plates for the picnic by the lake.
example_zh: 我們為湖邊野餐帶上了一次性盤子。

zh: 受威脅的；瀕危的；感到受威脅的
en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction. | Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.
example_en: The rescue centre cares for several threatened bird species.
example_zh: 這家救助中心照料著幾種受威脅的鳥類。

en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow. | To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.
example_en: The farmer spread manure around the young apple trees.
example_zh: 農民在幼小的蘋果樹周圍撒上糞肥。

en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail
example_en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
example_zh: 我們看著一條鱷魚滑入河中。

en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.
example_en: We baked the cod with lemon and fresh herbs.
example_zh: 我們用檸檬和新鮮香草烤了鱈魚。

en: A severe snowstorm with strong winds.
example_en: We stayed indoors while the blizzard shook our windows.
example_zh: 暴風雪吹得窗戶直響，我們一直待在屋裡。

en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously
example_en: A small rodent was nibbling seeds beside the shed.
example_zh: 一隻小齧齒動物正在棚屋旁啃食種子。

en: Covered with small round marks or patches.
example_en: A spotted dog was sleeping beside the garden gate.
example_zh: 一隻帶斑點的狗正睡在花園門旁。

en: the hard covering of a horse's or similar animal's foot
example_en: The farmer gently lifted the horse's hoof for inspection.
example_zh: 農夫輕輕抬起馬蹄進行檢查。

en: A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.
example_en: We found a clam buried in the wet sand.
example_zh: 我們在溼沙裡發現了一隻蛤蜊。

en: An evergreen tree with needle-shaped leaves, or its wood.
example_en: A tall fir shaded the path behind our cottage.
example_zh: 一棵高大的冷杉為我們小屋後的路遮陰。

en: to greatly reduce the amount of something available
example_en: Running several apps at once can deplete your battery.
example_zh: 同時執行多個應用程式會大量消耗電池電量。

en: a flightless seabird with black and white feathers, found mainly south
example_en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
example_zh: 那隻企鵝搖搖擺擺地走過岩石，朝大海走去。

en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out
example_en: The peacock spread its brilliant feathers beside the pond.
example_zh: 那隻雄孔雀在池塘邊展開了鮮豔的羽毛。

en: a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak
example_en: A falcon circled above the cliffs this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，一隻隼在懸崖上方盤旋。

en: A place in a desert where water and plants are found. | A peaceful, pleasant place surrounded by something difficult or unpleasant.
example_en: After hours of walking, we reached a small oasis.
example_zh: 步行數小時後，我們到達了一片小綠洲。

en: The hard, pointed mouth of a bird.
example_en: The sparrow carried a tiny seed in its beak.
example_zh: 那隻麻雀嘴裡銜著一粒小小的種子。

en: Destroy or remove something completely, leaving little or no trace.
example_en: Heavy snowfall had obliterated every footprint on the garden path.
example_zh: 大雪已將花園小路上的所有腳印徹底覆蓋。

en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.
example_en: A hedgehog shuffled through the leaves beside our fence.
example_zh: 一隻刺蝟在我們圍欄旁的落葉間緩緩爬行。

en: a cold-blooded animal with scaly skin, such as a snake
example_en: The reptile lay perfectly still on a warm rock.
example_zh: 那隻爬行動物一動不動地趴在一塊溫熱的岩石上。

en: To form a circle around someone or something.
example_en: Tall trees encircle the small pond behind our house.
example_zh: 高大的樹木環繞著我們屋後的小池塘。

en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.
example_en: The family grows potatoes on a small arable field.
example_zh: 這家人在一小塊耕地上種土豆。

en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.
example_en: A small toad was hiding beneath the garden pot.
example_zh: 一隻小蟾蜍躲在花園的花盆下面。

en: A small ornamental fish, often orange, kept in ponds or tanks.
example_en: Our goldfish swims between the plants in its large tank.
example_zh: 我們的金魚在大魚缸裡的水草間游來游去。

en: containing a lot of moisture in the air
example_en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
example_zh: 天氣溼熱得我的襯衫都貼在身上了。

en: A reduction in the amount of something available
example_en: The garden's poor growth suggested depletion of soil nutrients.
example_zh: 花園裡的植物長勢不佳，說明土壤養分可能已大量流失。

en: The act of giving or taking food.
example_en: The puppies always get excited around feeding time.
example_zh: 小狗們每到餵食時間就特別興奮。

en: Gradually become smaller in amount, size, or number.
example_en: Our savings dwindled while we searched for new jobs.
example_zh: 我們找新工作期間，積蓄逐漸減少了。

en: a mammal belonging to the group including humans, monkeys, and apes
example_en: The guide pointed to a primate swinging between branches.
example_zh: 導遊指著一隻在樹枝間盪來盪去的靈長類動物。

en: Relating to the region around the South Pole. | The region surrounding the South Pole, including Antarctica.
example_en: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
example_zh: 我們看了一部關於南極冰面上企鵝的影片。

zh: 馴服的；不怕人的；馴服；控制；平淡乏味的
en: Used to people and not wild or dangerous. | To train a wild animal or bring something under control. | Not exciting, adventurous, or impressive.
example_en: The tame rabbit ate directly from my hand.
example_zh: 那隻溫順的兔子直接吃我手裡的食物。

zh: 枝葉繁茂的；綠樹成蔭的；多葉的；葉用的
en: Having many leaves or many trees with abundant leaves. | Having leaves as the main edible part of a vegetable.
example_en: We ate our sandwiches beneath a large leafy tree.
example_zh: 我們在一棵枝葉繁茂的大樹下吃了三明治。

zh: 動物挖的地洞；挖洞；鑽入
en: A hole or tunnel dug by an animal for shelter | To dig a tunnel or push into something
example_en: A rabbit disappeared into its burrow beneath the hedge.
