example_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
example_zh: 我喜歡在下雨的午後坐在窗邊讀書。

zh: 更多的；額外的；更；更加；更多；額外的數量
en: A greater or additional amount or number of something. | To a greater degree or extent. | A greater or additional amount or number.
example_en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
example_zh: 請再給我的碗裡添點米飯，好嗎？

en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things. | Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.
example_en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
example_zh: 這些草莓聞起來很香，我們買一籃吧。

en: in addition to something already mentioned
example_en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
example_zh: 我姐姐打網球，也喜歡游泳。

zh: 一些；任何一個；一些；任何一個；絲毫；一點
en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction. | Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things. | At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.
example_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
example_zh: 這個書架上的書，你想借哪本都可以。

en: coming before all others in order or time | before anything or anyone else
example_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
example_zh: 這是我第一次到海邊來。

en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and other people.
example_en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
example_zh: 爸爸烤新鮮麵包時，我們的廚房裡香氣四溢。

en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger. | Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.
example_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
example_zh: 湯很燙，先讓它涼一涼。

zh: 新的；新近出現的；新買的；新接觸的；不熟悉的；初來乍到的
en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun. | Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing. | Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.
example_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
example_zh: 我們的新鄰居送來了一籃蘋果。

zh: 看；注視；看起來；顯得；看；神情；外觀
en: direct your eyes towards someone or something | appear to have a particular quality or condition | an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance
example_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
example_zh: 看窗邊那隻小鳥。

en: To desire something or wish for something to happen. | A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.
example_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
example_zh: 我想在我們的陽臺上種番茄。

zh: 方法；方式；路線；方向；遠遠地；大大地
en: A method of doing something. | A route or direction leading somewhere. | By a large amount or distance.
example_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
example_zh: 教我一個更簡單的疊床單方法吧。

zh: 應該；應當；按理會；應該會；本應該
en: used to give advice or say what is right | used to say something is expected or likely | used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation
example_en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
example_zh: 你應該帶把傘，因為天看起來陰沉沉的。

zh: 使用；運用；使用；利用；用途；用處
en: To do something with a tool, resource, or method. | The act of employing something for a purpose. | A purpose something serves or a way it can help.
example_en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
example_zh: 我可以用你的剪刀開啟這個包裹嗎？

en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.
example_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
example_zh: 我關上了窗戶，因為房間裡有點冷。

zh: 一天；一日；白天；白晝；時期；年代
en: a period of twenty-four hours | the part of each day when there is natural light | a particular period in the past or present
example_en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
example_zh: 我們一整天都在海灘上堆沙堡。

zh: 找到；發現；覺得；認為；發現物
en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for. | To have a particular opinion or experience of something. | Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.
example_en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
example_zh: 我終於在外套口袋裡找到了鑰匙。

zh: 在……之後；在……之後；在……後面；追趕
en: later than an event or time | following the time when something happens | behind or following someone or something
example_en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
example_zh: 我們通常在晚飯後散一小會兒步。

zh: 在……之間；涉及雙方或多方；由…共享；在中間；在其間
en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events. | Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them. | In the space or interval separating things.
example_en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
example_zh: 貓從沙發和牆之間擠了過去。

zh: 東西；物品；事情；情況；個人物品
en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified | an action, event, fact, or situation | possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural
example_en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
example_zh: 你能把那個沉東西從我的椅子上搬走嗎？

zh: 許多的；許多；許多人或物
en: a large number of, used with plural countable nouns | a large number of people or things
example_en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
example_zh: 做這個派需要多少個蘋果？

zh: 向下；在下面；沿著；向下；情緒低落的
en: Towards or in a lower place or position. | Along something, or from a higher to a lower point. | Feeling unhappy or discouraged.
example_en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
example_zh: 貓從廚房的桌子上跳了下來。

zh: 告訴；講述；吩咐；命令；辨別；看出
en: Give someone information or describe something in words. | Instruct someone to do something. | Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.
example_en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
example_zh: 請告訴我今天在學校發生了什麼。

zh: 背部；後部；向後；回原處；支援；資助
en: The rear part of your body or of something else. | Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state. | To support a person, plan, or organization.
example_en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
example_zh: 坐了一上午後，我感覺背部僵硬。

zh: 甚至；連……都；平坦的；均勻的；相等的；偶數的
en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected. | Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level. | Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.
example_en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
example_zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，連我們害羞的叔叔也不例外。

zh: 這樣的；這類的；如此的；這麼的
en: of the kind already mentioned or being described | used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun
example_en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
example_zh: 天氣如此宜人，我們就在外面吃了飯。

zh: 穿過；貫穿；透過；憑藉；從頭到尾；透過
en: From one side or end to the other, within something. | By using a particular method, person, or process. | From beginning to end, or from one side to another.
example_en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
example_zh: 陽光透過窗簾灑進來，讓房間暖和起來。

en: above something or from one side to the other | more than a particular amount, age, or level | finished or no longer happening
example_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥飛過了花園的圍牆。

zh: 必須；一定；想必；必需的事物
en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement | used to express a confident conclusion | something considered essential
example_en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
example_zh: 在這裡騎車必須戴頭盔。

zh: 仍然；還；靜止的；不動的；儘管如此；不過
en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing. | Not moving. | Despite what has just been said.
example_en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
example_zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐還醒著。

zh: 生活；人生；生命；生存；壽命；使用期限
en: the experiences and activities of being alive | the state of being alive | the period during which someone lives or something works
example_en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
example_zh: 自從搬到鄉下，我們的生活感覺更安靜了。

en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable | in addition; also
example_en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
example_zh: 這湯現在太燙，還不能喝。

zh: 放；安置；表達；措辭；使處於某種狀態
en: to move something into a particular place or position | to express something in a particular way | to cause someone or something to enter a particular state
example_en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
example_zh: 請把你的溼雨傘放在門旁邊。

en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else. | To have something that legally belongs to you.
example_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
example_zh: 在我們的新公寓裡，我終於有了自己的房間。

zh: 最後的；最近過去的；持續；夠用；耐用；最後；上次
en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present. | To continue for a period or remain usable. | After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.
example_en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
example_zh: 我在午夜前剛好趕上了回家的末班車。

en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality
example_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
example_zh: 商店關門後，街道變得安靜起來。

zh: 打電話；呼叫；稱呼；把…叫作；電話；呼籲
en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention. | To give someone or something a particular name. | A telephone conversation or a public request for action.
example_en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
example_zh: 今晚到家後我會給你打電話。

zh: 年老的；古老的；舊的；……歲的；有……年曆史的；以前的；原來的
en: Having lived or existed for a long time. | Having a particular age. | Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.
example_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
example_zh: 我們家的老狗睡在溫暖的廚房爐子旁。

zh: 離開；出發；留下；忘帶；休假；假期
en: To go away from a person or place. | To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally. | An officially allowed period away from work.
example_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
example_zh: 我們得在交通變得更擁堵之前出發。

zh: 嘗試；試圖；試用；試驗；嘗試
en: make an effort to do something | use or do something to see whether it works | an attempt to do something
example_en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
example_zh: 我會試著在晚飯前把燈修好。

zh: 極好的；出色的；巨大的；程度很高的；偉大的；傑出的
en: Very good or enjoyable. | Very large in amount, size, or degree. | Highly important, admired, or successful.
example_en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
example_zh: 我們在湖裡游泳，度過了一個愉快的下午。

en: say something to get information or an answer | say that you want someone to do or give something | invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity
example_en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
example_zh: 我問司機公交車在哪裡停。

zh: 需要；必須；需要；需求；貧困；困境
en: To require something because it is necessary or important | Something necessary or the condition of requiring it | A situation in which essential things are lacking
example_en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
example_zh: 天氣炎熱時，這些植物需要更多的水。

zh: 相同的；同一個的；同樣的事物
en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another. | The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.
example_en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
example_zh: 我們每天早上乘同一班公交車上學。

en: Not at any time. | Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.
example_en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
example_zh: 我出門從來都帶著水瓶。

zh: 情況；事例；病例；盒；箱；套；案件；論據
en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness. | A container that holds or protects something. | A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.
example_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
example_zh: 帶把傘吧，以防待會兒下雨。

zh: 高的；高處的；大量的；高水平的；在高處；向高處
en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground | greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality | at or to a position far above the ground
example_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example_zh: 架子太高了，我夠不著。

en: A thing that is not named or specified.
example_en: There is something soft inside this little box.
example_zh: 這個小盒子裡有個柔軟的東西。

zh: 數；數字；號碼；數量；給…編號；總計
en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something | the total amount of people or things | to assign identifying figures or add up to a total
example_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
example_zh: 我把你的電話號碼存到了新手機裡。

zh: 很；非常；真正地；實際上；真的嗎
en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger. | In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly. | Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.
example_en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
example_zh: 這湯非常燙，先讓它涼一涼吧。

zh: 大多數的；最多的；大多數；最大部分；最；非常
en: the majority of something, or the greatest amount or number | the majority or greatest part of a group or amount | to the greatest degree; sometimes used to mean very
example_en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
example_zh: 這裡大多數商店在我們下班前就關門了。

zh: 又一；另一；另一個；再一個
en: one more, or a different one | one more person or thing, or a different one
example_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
example_zh: 這個杯子裂了，請再給我拿一個。

zh: 許多；大量；很多；大量；很；非常；更為
en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns. | A large amount, without naming what is being discussed. | To a great degree, especially with comparisons and certain verbs.
example_en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
example_zh: 我們剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。

zh: 家庭；家人；親屬；科；語族；同類群
en: a group of people related to one another | a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things
example_en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
example_zh: 我的家人每週日都會圍坐在廚房的餐桌旁。

zh: 展示；給……看；表明；證明；演出；節目；展覽
en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works. | To provide information or evidence that something is true. | A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.
example_en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
example_zh: 請教我怎麼折這隻紙鳥。

zh: 問題；困難；習題；待解答的問題
en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution | a question requiring thought or calculation to answer
example_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
example_zh: 廚房的水龍頭有問題：它一直滴水。

en: One more time, or on another occasion.
example_en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
example_zh: 你能再說一遍，稍微慢一點嗎？

zh: 保留；儲存；保持；使保持；繼續；反覆做
en: To continue having something rather than giving it away. | To stay, or make something stay, in a particular state. | To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.
example_en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
example_zh: 雨停之前，你可以繼續留著這把傘用。

zh: 在…下面；少於；低於；在…狀態或控制下
en: in or into a position below something | less than a particular amount, age, or level | experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something
example_en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
example_zh: 貓蜷縮在廚房的桌子下面。

en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen. | To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.
example_en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
example_zh: 你平安到家後請告訴我。

zh: 服務；公共服務；檢修；保養；宗教儀式
en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers. | Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working. | A formal religious ceremony.
example_en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
example_zh: 咖啡館裡熱情的服務讓我們感到賓至如歸。

zh: 大的；大量的；重要的；影響大的
en: Large in size, amount, or degree. | Important or likely to have a strong effect.
example_en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
example_zh: 我們需要一個大袋子來裝所有這些毛巾。

zh: 地方；地點；放置；座位；名額
en: A particular area, position, or location. | To put something in a particular position. | A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.
example_en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
example_zh: 這處陰涼的地方很適合野餐。

en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb. | Help with doing a task. | To give something to someone by holding it out.
example_en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
example_zh: 她用左手握著溫熱的杯子。

en: to start happening or start doing something
example_en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
example_zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好後，我們開始吃晚飯。

en: Make something easier or better for someone. | Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.
example_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
example_zh: 你能幫我把這些袋子提上樓嗎？

zh: 小的；少的；年幼的；不重要的；輕微的
en: Limited in size, amount, or degree. | Young and not yet fully grown. | Not very important or serious.
example_en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
example_zh: 我們的小廚房只能放下兩把椅子。

zh: 說話；交談；談論；談話；會談；演講；講座
en: to speak to someone or discuss something | a conversation or discussion between people | a speech given to an audience about a subject
example_en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
example_zh: 我們吃早飯時聊了聊週末的計劃。

zh: 每個；各個；每一個；各自；每人；每個
en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately. | Every person or thing in a group, taken separately. | For every individual person or thing.
example_en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
example_zh: 每個孩子都提著一個小籃子走進花園。

zh: 轉動；轉向；變得；變成；輪到的機會；輪次
en: Move around a centre or change direction. | Change to a different state, colour, or condition. | An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.
example_en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
example_zh: 輕輕轉動把手，然後朝自己這邊拉門。

zh: 每個；每一；每隔；每逢；一切可能的；充分的
en: referring to all members of a group individually | used to show how regularly something happens | used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree
example_en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
example_zh: 每個孩子都帶了一件最喜歡的玩具去野餐。

zh: 開始；著手；啟動；發動；開始；起點
en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin. | To make a machine operate, or begin operating. | The moment or place where something begins.
example_en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
example_zh: 我們一到家就開始做晚飯。

zh: 離開；脫離；從……離開；離開……表面；關閉的；不工作的
en: away from a place or position | away from or no longer touching something | not operating or not working at a particular time
example_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
example_zh: 門一開，那隻狗就跑走了。

zh: 不同的；不一樣的；各不相同的；各種的
en: not the same as someone or something else | used to describe several separate people, things, or types
example_en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
example_zh: 這些手套看起來相似，但尺碼不同。

zh: 握住；拿著；舉行；召開；容納；裝得下
en: to keep something in your hands or arms | to organise an event or meeting | to have enough space for something or someone
example_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
example_zh: 我繫鞋帶時，你能幫我拿一下包嗎？

en: a period of seven days | the days or hours normally spent working each week
example_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
example_zh: 我上週從圖書館借了這本書。

en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number
example_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
example_zh: 一隻大狗正睡在廚房門旁。

en: the number after three and before five
example_en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
example_zh: 我們在廚房桌子周圍放了四把椅子。

en: every time or on every occasion | throughout all time or for ever
example_en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
example_zh: 我的鄰居每次看見我都會揮手。

zh: 很少的；幾個；很少的人或事物
en: Not many; a small number of countable things. | A small number of people or things.
example_en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
example_zh: 今天上午店裡的顧客很少。

zh: 跟隨；沿著走；遵循；聽從；理解；聽懂
en: To move behind someone or along a route. | To act according to instructions, rules, or advice. | To understand what someone says or explains.
example_en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
example_zh: 沿著這條小路走，直到到達木橋。

zh: 結束；末尾；盡頭；結束；終止；目的；目標
en: the final part or furthest point of something | to stop, or cause something to stop | a purpose that someone wants to achieve
example_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
example_zh: 我們這條街的盡頭有一家小麵包店。

zh: 沒有；不帶；不與……一起；未做某事
en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something | not doing the action mentioned
example_en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上我出門時沒帶鑰匙。

en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit. | Inside something rather than outside it.
example_en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
example_zh: 你的包裹應該會在接下來的三天內送達。

en: at some point within, or throughout, a particular period
example_en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
example_zh: 音樂會期間請將手機調為靜音。

zh: 正確的；合適的；權利；右邊的；右側的
en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose. | Something you are legally or morally entitled to. | On the side opposite to the left.
example_en: You picked the right key to open the door.
example_zh: 你選對了開門的鑰匙。

en: to carry someone or something to a place | to cause a situation, feeling, or result
example_en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
example_zh: 你來時請帶一件暖和的外套。

zh: 聽見；聽到；聽說；得知；審理；聽取
en: notice a sound through your ears | receive information about something | listen formally to evidence or arguments
example_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
example_zh: 我能聽見臥室窗外的鳥鳴聲。

zh: 在……之前；在……以前；以前；先前
en: Earlier than a particular time or event. | Earlier than the time when something happens. | At an earlier time.
example_en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
example_zh: 請在晚飯前把鞋放到門邊。

zh: 下一個的；緊接著的；接下來；下次
en: coming immediately after the present one | immediately after this; on the following occasion
example_en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
example_zh: 我們要坐的下一班公交車大約十分鐘後發車。

zh: 玩耍；參加遊戲或運動；演奏；播放；扮演；戲劇；劇本
en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game | Perform music or a role, or make a recording run | A story written for actors to perform
example_en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
example_zh: 孩子們在地板上玩木製積木。

zh: 跑；奔跑；經營；管理；運轉；執行
en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps | manage a business, organisation, or activity | operate, or make a machine or program operate
example_en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
example_zh: 今天早飯前，我們跑步穿過了公園。

en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely. | Completely or to the greatest possible degree.
example_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
example_zh: 這湯挺辣的，不過我喜歡。

zh: 移動；搬家；使感動；行動；舉措
en: To change position or go to live somewhere else. | To make someone feel a strong emotion. | An action taken to achieve a particular result.
example_en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
example_zh: 你能把這把椅子挪到靠窗一點的位置嗎？

zh: 頭；頭部；負責人；領導；朝某方向行進
en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth | the person in charge of a group or organisation | to move or travel in a particular direction
example_en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
example_zh: 我問她要不要再來點湯，她搖了搖頭。

en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.
example_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
example_zh: 昨晚，我們在陽臺上看星星。

zh: 居住；生活；活著；現場直播的；現場的；活的
en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive | broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded | alive rather than dead
example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
example_zh: 我的祖父母住在海邊一個安靜的村莊裡。

zh: 側面；邊；旁邊；方面；一方；支援；站在某方
en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it. | One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement. | To support one person or group in a disagreement.
example_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
example_zh: 請把沾滿泥的靴子放在側門旁。

zh: 放置；設定；確定；一套；一組；固定的；事先確定的
en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule. | A group of related things that belong together. | Fixed or arranged in advance.
example_en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
example_zh: 她把碗輕輕放在廚房的桌子上。

en: one of twelve yearly divisions, or roughly four weeks
example_en: I put aside a little money every month.
example_zh: 我每個月都會存下一點錢。

en: on this day, or during the present period | the current day or the present period
example_en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
example_zh: 今天天氣暖和，我們到外面吃飯吧。

en: to take place, often without being planned | to do or be something by chance
example_en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
example_zh: 你窗邊那盆植物怎麼了？

zh: 長的；長時間的；長時間地；很久；渴望；盼望
en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time. | For a great amount of time. | To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.
example_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
example_zh: 她的長圍巾差點碰到溼漉漉的人行道。

zh: 重要的；重大的；有影響力的；有地位的
en: Having great value or a significant effect. | Having considerable power, influence, or status.
example_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
example_zh: 把你的重要檔案放在這個防水資料夾裡。

zh: 家；住所；家鄉；在家；回家；家庭的；國內的
en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong. | At or towards the place where you live. | Relating to your house or your own country.
example_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
example_zh: 在咖啡館吃過晚飯後，我們一起走回家。

zh: 改變；更換；兌換；變化；改變；零錢；找零
en: to become different, replace something, or exchange money | an instance or process of becoming different | coins, or money returned when you pay more than the price
example_en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
example_zh: 開始下雨時，我們改變了計劃。

en: The clear liquid people drink and plants need to grow. | To give water to plants or soil.
example_en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
example_zh: 今天出門前請給植物澆水。

zh: 支付；付工資；工資；薪酬；值得；划算
en: To give money for something or for someone's work | Money received regularly for doing a job | To bring a benefit or be worth doing
example_en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
example_zh: 這些蘋果可以刷卡付款嗎？

en: A part of a building separated by walls and doors. | Available space or opportunity for something.
example_en: My room has a desk beside the window.
example_zh: 我的房間裡，窗邊有一張書桌。

zh: 年輕的；幼小的；幼崽；幼鳥
en: Having lived or existed for only a short time | The babies of an animal
example_en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example_zh: 一隻小貓在我空著的鞋子裡睡著了。

en: referring to two people or things together | the two people or things already mentioned
example_en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
example_zh: 兩扇窗戶都開著，涼風吹了進來。

zh: 母親；媽媽；像母親般照顧
en: A female parent. | Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.
example_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example_zh: 我媽媽教會了我騎腳踏車。

en: many times or on many occasions
example_en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
example_zh: 我們經常在晚飯後沿河散步。

en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something. | Not at home or at the usual place.
example_en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
example_zh: 我開啟窗戶時，小鳥飛走了。

zh: 大量；許多；很；經常；一塊地；場地
en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots | very much or often, in the phrase a lot | an area of land used for a particular purpose
example_en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
example_zh: 我們今天買了很多新鮮水果。

zh: 型別；形式；形狀；表格；形成；組成；建立
en: a type, arrangement, or shape of something | a document with spaces for providing requested information | to develop, create, or combine into something
example_en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
example_zh: 那些雲呈現出一隻巨兔的形狀。

zh: 水平；程度；高度；平坦的；同高的；使平坦；使相等
en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something. | Flat and even, or at the same height. | To make a surface flat or things equal.
example_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
example_zh: 昨晚的大雨過後，水位上升了。

zh: 第二；秒；片刻；附議；支援提議
en: Coming immediately after the first in an order. | A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute. | To formally support a proposal made by someone else.
example_en: This is my second cup of tea today.
example_zh: 這是我今天喝的第二杯茶。

zh: 早期的；較早的；提前；在早期
en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time | Before the expected time or near the beginning
example_en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
example_zh: 我們趕上了一班早車，在早餐前就到了。

en: Despite the fact that something is true. | Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.
example_en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
example_zh: 雖然下著雨，我們還是步行去了麵包店。

zh: 包括；包含；使加入；把…列入
en: have someone or something as part of a whole | make someone or something part of a group or activity
example_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
example_zh: 這個價格包含早餐和一條幹淨毛巾嗎？

zh: 遠；遙遠地；很；大大地；遠處的；較遠的
en: At, to, or over a great distance. | To a much greater degree. | More distant from you or a particular point.
example_en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
example_zh: 我們走了很遠，走得腳都開始疼了。

en: having the darkest colour, like coal | the darkest colour | relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa
example_en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
example_zh: 她穿著黑色外套和亮黃色靴子。

en: before now or earlier than expected
example_en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
example_zh: 我已經收拾好明天要用的包了。

zh: 小的；年幼的；很少的；幾乎沒有的；很少；略微
en: Small in size or young in age. | Not much; almost no amount of something. | Only slightly or not very much.
example_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
example_zh: 一隻小鳥落在我們廚房的窗臺上。

zh: 允許；准許；使可能；容許；留出；預留
en: to let someone do something | to make something possible | to provide enough time or resources for something
example_en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
example_zh: 圖書館允許訪客一次借五本書。

zh: 沒有任何東西；毫無；毫不；一點也不
en: not anything; no thing at all | not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons
example_en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
example_zh: 我開啟冰箱，裡面卻什麼也沒有。

zh: 遇見；會面；結識；滿足；達到
en: come together with someone, by arrangement or chance | fulfil a need or reach a required standard
example_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
example_zh: 我們今天午飯後在圖書館外見吧。

zh: 自……以來；自……以來；因為；此後；從那時起
en: from a past time until a later time, usually now | from when something happened; because something is true | at a time or throughout the period after that
example_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
example_zh: 我從小就住在這個街區。

zh: 還；尚；已經；然而；可是；更；還要
en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements. | But, despite what has just been stated. | Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.
example_en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
example_zh: 我還沒吃完晚飯，請等一下。

zh: 圍繞；在…周圍；大約；左右；四處；到處
en: On different sides of something or surrounding it. | Approximately, rather than exactly. | In or to various places within an area.
example_en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
example_zh: 我們圍坐在火堆旁看星星。

zh: 父親；爸爸；奠基人；創始人；成為…的生父
en: A male parent. | A man who established or greatly influenced a field. | To become the biological father of a child.
example_en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
example_zh: 她爸爸教她騎腳踏車。

zh: 坐；坐下；位於；坐落於；參加考試
en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom | to be in a particular place or position | to take an examination
example_en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
example_zh: 過來坐在花園長椅上，坐我旁邊。

en: Up to a particular time or event. | Up to the time when something happens.
example_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
example_zh: 我們在外面一直等到雨終於停了。

zh: 名字；名稱；命名；說出名稱；名聲；聲譽
en: a word or words used to identify someone or something | to give a name or say what someone is called | the reputation someone or something has
example_en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
example_zh: 你給新來的小貓取了什麼名字？

en: a period of sixty minutes | the times when someone works or a service operates
example_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
example_zh: 我們走到湖邊花了一個小時。

zh: 遊戲；比賽；獵物；野味；願意嘗試的；有膽量的
en: an activity or contest played according to rules | wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat | willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar
example_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天晚飯後我們玩了一個桌遊。

zh: 站立；起立；忍受；容忍；立場；堅決的態度
en: To be upright on your feet, or get into this position. | To accept something unpleasant without becoming too upset. | A firm opinion or action supporting or opposing something.
example_en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
example_zh: 請站在車門附近，等公交車停穩。

zh: 線；線條；一排；隊伍；線路；路線
en: a long, thin mark on a surface | people or things arranged one behind or beside another | a route or connection for transport or communication
example_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
example_zh: 用尺子在紙上畫一條直線。

en: surrounded by people or things | within or shared by a group
example_en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
example_zh: 我們在樹林中發現了一座小木屋。

zh: 後來；稍後；較晚的；後期的
en: at a time after now or another mentioned time | happening or existing after another time or stage
example_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
example_zh: 等我們吃完飯，我稍後再洗碗。

en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.
example_en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
example_zh: 我繫鞋帶時差點錯過了公交車。

zh: 曾經；在任何時候；始終；不斷地；究竟；到底
en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements. | Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change. | Used to emphasize surprise in a question.
example_en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
example_zh: 你曾經在山上看過日出嗎？

zh: 差的；劣質的；嚴重的；有害的；不道德的；不守規矩的
en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory. | Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm. | Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.
example_en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
example_zh: 這湯太難喝了，我便不再喝了。

zh: 臉；面部；面臨；面對；面向；朝向
en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth. | To encounter or deal with a difficult situation. | To look or point in a particular direction.
example_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
example_zh: 他洗了臉才坐下來吃早餐。

zh: 拿；提；搬運；隨身攜帶；傳播；攜帶病菌
en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere | Have something with you wherever you go | Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection
example_en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
example_zh: 你能幫我把這個沉重的袋子拿上樓嗎？

zh: 丟失；遺失；失去；減少；輸掉；失敗
en: to become unable to find something you had | to stop having something or have less of it | to fail to win a game or competition
example_en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
example_zh: 我總是在這個大包裡找不到鑰匙。

zh: 出現；顯現；似乎；顯得；登場；出庭
en: To become visible or come into view. | To seem to be a certain way. | To take part in a performance or attend court formally.
example_en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
example_zh: 天空漸漸變暗，星星開始出現。

zh: 繼續；持續；重新開始；接著說
en: To keep doing something or keep happening. | To start again after a pause or interruption.
example_en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
example_zh: 儘管下著雨，我們還是繼續沿著海灘走。

zh: 能夠的；能幹的；有才幹的
en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something | skilled and effective at doing things
example_en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
example_zh: 我終於能夠游到泳池的另一端了。

zh: 遲到的；晚期的；遲；晚；已故的
en: after the expected time or near the end of a period | after the expected time or towards a period's end | used before mentioning a person who has died
example_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
example_zh: 我遲到了，因為我的腳踏車輪胎沒氣了。

en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.
example_en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
example_zh: 請關上門，別讓貓跑出去。

zh: 一次；曾經；從前；一旦；當……之後
en: on one occasion only | at a time in the past | as soon as something happens or becomes true
example_en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
example_zh: 我每兩週給這株小仙人掌澆一次水。

en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk | the colour of fresh snow or milk | the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked
example_en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
example_zh: 她穿著一件白色棉襯衫去野餐。

zh: 最少的；最小量的；最少；程度最低；最少量；最小程度
en: the smallest amount of something | to the smallest degree or extent | the smallest amount or degree
example_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
example_zh: 這些湯裡，這道湯需要的鹽最少。

zh: 真實的；實際存在的；真的；非仿製的；實際的；扣除通脹的
en: existing in fact rather than being imagined | genuine rather than copied or artificial | measured after allowing for changes in prices
example_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
example_zh: 我以為那隻鳥是塑膠的，沒想到是真的。

zh: 主動提供；提議；提議；錄用或錄取通知；出價
en: Say you are willing to give something or do something. | A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place. | Say how much you are willing to pay.
example_en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
example_zh: 鄰居主動提出幫我們把沉重的袋子搬上樓。

zh: 分鐘；片刻；會議記錄；極小的；微細的
en: A period of sixty seconds, or a very short time | A written record of what happened at a meeting | Extremely small in size or amount
example_en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
example_zh: 等一下，我找找鑰匙。

zh: 最好的；最佳的；最好地；最；最佳表現；最好事物
en: Better than all others in quality or suitability. | In the most successful way or to the greatest degree. | The finest performance, effort, or thing available.
example_en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
example_zh: 這家麵包店做的麵包是我們街區最好的。

zh: 滿的；裝滿的；完整的；全部的；吃飽的
en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left. | Including everything, with nothing missing. | Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.
example_en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
example_zh: 籃子已經滿了，我們得再拿一個。

en: More than two but not many | A few people or things already mentioned or understood
example_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
example_zh: 我試了幾件夾克後，選中了藍色的那件。

zh: 小孩；孩子；開玩笑；戲弄；小山羊
en: A child or young person, in informal language. | Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed. | A young goat.
example_en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
example_zh: 孩子們在小溪上搭了一座小橋。

zh: 任何事物；某事物；什麼東西
en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice | Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements
example_en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
example_zh: 你可以從這籃玩具裡隨便挑一件。

en: Before the present time, following an expression of time
example_en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
example_zh: 一小時前，我把雨傘落在了公交車上。

zh: 朝；向；對；對於；用於；有助於
en: In the direction of someone or something. | In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude. | Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.
example_en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
example_zh: 小狗搖著尾巴朝我跑來。

zh: 低的；少的；情緒低落的；在低處；低聲地
en: Not high in position, amount, level, or degree. | Feeling sad or lacking confidence. | At a small height, level, or volume.
example_en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
example_zh: 這個低矮的架子很方便孩子們取東西。

en: To need something for a particular purpose | To make something necessary through a rule or instruction
example_en: These plants require plenty of sunlight and regular watering.
example_zh: 這些植物需要充足的陽光和定期澆水。

zh: 觀看；注視；手錶；照看；留意
en: To look at something attentively for a period of time. | A small clock worn on the wrist or carried. | To take care of someone or look for possible danger.
example_en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
example_zh: 我們看著鴨子游過平靜的池塘。

zh: 一段時間；時期；課時；一節課；月經；經期
en: A length of time or a stage in history. | A scheduled length of time for a school lesson. | The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.
example_en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
example_zh: 在那陣短暫的大雨期間，我們一直待在室內。

zh: 停止；阻止；車站；停靠點；停止；停留
en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening. | A place where buses or other vehicles regularly collect passengers. | An interruption of movement or a brief stay somewhere.
example_en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
example_zh: 雨越下越大，我們便停下了腳步。

zh: 新增；增加；相加；做加法；補充說
en: to put something with something else or increase an amount | to combine numbers to find their total | to say something more after an earlier statement
example_en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
example_zh: 如果湯太稠，就加一點牛奶。

zh: 落下；跌倒；下降；跌落；下降；秋天（美式）
en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease. | An act of falling or a decrease in amount. | The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.
example_en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
example_zh: 金黃的葉子落在我們屋外的小路上。

zh: 可獲得的；可使用的；有空的
en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use. | Not busy and able to meet or help someone.
example_en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
example_zh: 下午那場演出的門票還有餘票。

zh: 說話；交談；會說；使用某種語言；發言；演講
en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone. | Be able to communicate in a particular language. | Address an audience about a subject.
example_en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
example_zh: 下課後我能和你談談嗎？

zh: 控制；管理；控制；管理；抑制；操縱裝置
en: The power to direct or limit someone or something. | To direct, manage, or limit someone or something. | A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.
example_en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
example_zh: 抓緊風箏線，控制好風箏。

zh: 仍然是；保持；留下；停留；剩下；餘留
en: to continue to be in the same state | to stay in a place rather than leave | to still exist after other things have gone
example_en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
example_zh: 請留在座位上，直到公交車完全停穩。

zh: 位置；姿勢；職位；地位；立場；放置；安置
en: where something is or how a body is arranged | a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue | to put someone or something in a particular place
example_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
example_zh: 你能把燈挪到一個更合適的位置嗎？

zh: 購買；相信；接受；買到的東西；合算的購買
en: to obtain something by paying money for it | to believe an explanation or accept an idea | something bought, especially something offering good value
example_en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
example_zh: 我需要在吃早飯前買些麵包。

en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected
example_en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
example_zh: 我以為這湯很辣，其實是甜的。

zh: 敞開的；營業的；開啟；開辦；開始營業；坦誠的；願意接受的
en: Not closed, or available for people to enter and use. | To make something accessible or start operating a business. | Honest about your thoughts, or willing to consider new ideas.
example_en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
example_zh: 讓窗戶開著，好讓新鮮空氣進來。

en: a group of things sharing particular features | to enter words using a keyboard
example_en: What type of bread would you like today?
example_zh: 你今天想要哪種麵包？

en: The part of the day between midnight and noon
example_en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
example_zh: 我每天早晨拉開窗簾，給植物澆水。

en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running | A journey made on foot, often for pleasure
example_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
example_zh: 我們每個星期天早上都步行去麵包店。

en: A very short period of time. | A particular point in time, sometimes especially important.
example_en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
example_zh: 等一會兒，我穿上鞋就好。

zh: 獲勝；贏得；爭取到；獲得；勝利
en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize. | To gain something through effort or personal qualities. | A successful result in a competition or contest.
example_en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
example_zh: 儘管下著大雨，我們隊還是贏得了比賽。

en: An informal word for a man.
example_en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
example_zh: 隔壁那位小夥子幫我提了買回來的東西。

en: the United Kingdom, or the island containing England, Scotland and Wales
example_en: My cousin moved to Britain to study nursing.
example_zh: 我的表親搬到英國學習護理。

en: To make something go or be delivered to another place. | To arrange for someone to go somewhere.
example_en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
example_zh: 請發一張你家新養的小狗的照片給我。

zh: 順序；秩序；訂購；點餐；命令；訂單；命令
en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation | to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do | a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed
example_en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
example_zh: 請把這些照片按正確順序排列。

zh: 事情；問題；要緊；有關係；物質
en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention | to be important or make a difference | physical substance that occupies space and has mass
example_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
example_zh: 我們可以今天午飯後討論這件事。

en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides. | To welcome someone arriving at a place.
example_en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
example_zh: 你收到我昨天發的照片了嗎？

zh: 足夠的；足夠地；足夠的數量
en: as much or as many as needed | to the degree that is needed | an amount that meets a need
example_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
example_zh: 我們的米夠今晚所有人吃。

zh: 主要的；最重要的；主管道；幹線
en: Most important or largest among others. | A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.
example_en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
example_zh: 正門就在那家小咖啡館旁邊。

zh: 穿過；橫過；在……對面；遍及；從一邊到另一邊；在對面
en: From one side of something to the other. | On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area. | From one side to another, or on the opposite side.
example_en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
example_zh: 下雨前，我們走過了那座橋。

zh: 更少的；較少地；更不；更少的量
en: a smaller amount of something | to a smaller degree or extent | a smaller amount
example_en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
example_zh: 這次請在我的茶裡少放點糖。

en: the body part below the ankle used for standing and walking | a unit of length equal to twelve inches | the lowest part of something tall or sloping
example_en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
example_zh: 鞋裡的一顆小石子硌疼了我的腳。

en: a male child or young male person
example_en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
example_zh: 那個男孩小心地抱著小狗跨過水坑。

zh: 朝；向；對於；對待；用於；有助於
en: In the direction of someone or something | In relation to someone or something, especially attitudes or behaviour | Helping to achieve or pay for something
example_en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
example_zh: 小狗叼著一個沾滿泥的球向我跑來。

zh: 一切；所有事物；最重要的東西
en: All things or all the things in a particular situation. | The most important thing in someone's life or situation.
example_en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨把我包裡的東西全弄溼了。

zh: 清楚的；明確的；清澈的；晴朗的；清除；清空
en: Easy to understand, see, or hear | Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light | To remove unwanted things from a place
example_en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
example_zh: 說明很清楚，所以我輕鬆地組裝好了架子。

en: With someone or something as part of a larger group.
example_en: Everyone came to the picnic, including our new neighbours.
example_zh: 大家都來野餐了，包括我們的新鄰居。

zh: 狀況；狀態；條件；環境；疾病；健康問題
en: The physical state of someone or something | A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity | A medical problem affecting someone's health
example_en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
example_zh: 這輛腳踏車雖然年頭已久，但狀況極佳。

zh: 等待；等候；暫緩；推遲；等待；等候時間
en: To let time pass until something happens or someone arrives. | To be left until a later time. | A period spent expecting something to happen.
example_en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
example_zh: 請在這裡等一下，我去找鑰匙。

zh: 端上；供應；接待；為……服務；履行職責；用作；起……作用
en: To give food or drink, or assist customers. | To work for people, an organisation, or your country. | To be used for a particular purpose.
example_en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
example_zh: 這家小咖啡館供應新鮮的湯和溫熱的麵包。

zh: 到達；達到；伸手；夠到；可及範圍；影響範圍
en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level | to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it | the distance or extent over which something can act
example_en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
example_zh: 我們剛到車站，雨就下起來了。

en: on something, especially in formal or literary language | immediately after or at the time of an event
example_en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
example_zh: 貓趴在窗邊的墊子上休息。

zh: 停留；暫住；保持某種狀態；停留；暫住期間
en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily. | To continue being in a particular condition. | A period spent living or visiting somewhere.
example_en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
example_zh: 我們住在湖邊的一家小旅館裡。

en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs | information arranged in rows and columns
example_en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
example_zh: 我們圍坐在桌邊，一起吃新鮮麵包。

en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose. | The state of being busy or doing things.
example_en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
example_zh: 下雨的午後，我最喜歡的活動是畫畫。

zh: 切；剪；割；削減；刪減；傷口；切口；削減
en: divide or remove something using a sharp tool | reduce the amount, size, or length of something | an opening made by something sharp, or a reduction
example_en: She cut the apple into slices for her brother.
example_zh: 她把蘋果切成片給弟弟吃。

en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example_en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example_zh: 有人把一把藍色雨傘落在了前門旁邊。

zh: 在……後面；在後面；落後；是……的幕後原因
en: at or towards the back of someone or something | at the back or making less progress than expected | responsible for causing or supporting something
example_en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
example_zh: 你的傘在廚房的門後面。

zh: 種類；型別；分類；整理；排序；處理妥當；解決
en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics | to arrange things in groups or a particular order | to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter
example_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
example_zh: 你在家聽哪種音樂？

zh: 返回；歸還；返回；歸來；收益；回報
en: To go back, or give something back. | The act of coming or going back. | Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.
example_en: Please return these library books before you go away.
example_zh: 請在離開之前歸還這些圖書館的書。

zh: 提高；舉起；籌集；養育；飼養
en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level | to collect money for a particular purpose | to care for children or animals as they grow
example_en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
example_zh: 如果你還需要一支鉛筆，請舉手。

zh: 兩者任一；兩邊各一；兩者中的任何一個；也不
en: One or the other of two; each of two sides. | One or the other of two people or things. | Also not, used after a negative statement.
example_en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
example_zh: 兩把傘你隨便借哪把都行，都是乾的。

zh: 堅硬的；困難的；艱苦的；努力地；猛烈地
en: Firm and not easily bent, cut, or pressed | Requiring considerable effort or being difficult to endure | With great effort, force, or intensity
example_en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
example_zh: 這塊麵包太硬了，咬不動。

zh: 特別的；特殊的；專門的；專用的；特價品；特色菜
en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way. | Intended for a particular purpose or person. | A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.
example_en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
example_zh: 我們把這個特別的蛋糕留到了你生日時享用。

zh: 困難的；費力的；難相處的；難應付的
en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand. | Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.
example_en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
example_zh: 這個沉重的行李箱很難搬上樓。

en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned | Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence
example_en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
example_zh: 除了湯，你還想要點別的嗎？

zh: 經過；透過；傳遞；遞給；透過考試；及格
en: To move past something or through a place. | To give something to another person. | To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.
example_en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
example_zh: 我們回家的路上會經過一家小麵包店。

en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly
example_en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
example_zh: 我有時會繞遠路穿過公園回家。

zh: 沿著；順著；向前；一起；隨同
en: following the length or direction of something | forward from one place towards another | with someone when they go somewhere
example_en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
example_zh: 我們沿著河邊散步，看著水裡的鴨子。

zh: 更好的；更合適的；更好地；身體好轉的
en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else. | In a more effective or satisfactory way. | Less ill than before.
example_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
example_zh: 這個揹包比我原來的那個好。

zh: 整個的；完整的；整體；全部
en: Complete, with no part missing or left out. | A complete thing made up of connected parts.
example_en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
example_zh: 我們整個下午都在一起烤麵包。

en: a written message sent to a person or organisation | a written symbol representing a sound in an alphabet
example_en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄來的信。

zh: 強壯的；有力的；牢固的；結實的；強烈的；充分的
en: having great physical power or force | not easily broken or damaged | great in intensity, influence, or convincing power
example_en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
example_zh: 我哥哥力氣很大，能抬起這張沙發。

zh: 相當；頗；寧願；更願意；更確切地說
en: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected. | Used with would to express a preference. | Used to correct or make a previous statement more accurate.
example_en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
example_zh: 這湯有點鹹，不過麵包很好吃。

zh: 光；光線；燈；輕的；明亮的；淺色的；點燃；照亮
en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it | not heavy, bright, or pale in colour | make something burn or provide brightness
example_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
example_zh: 溫暖的光線透過窗簾照進了我們的臥室。

en: Coming after the second and before the fourth. | One of three equal parts of something.
example_en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
example_zh: 我們的公寓在三樓，電梯旁邊。

en: After a long wait, delay, or effort. | Used to introduce the last point or action.
example_en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
example_zh: 找了一上午後，我終於找到了鑰匙。

zh: 一半；半場；一半的；半；部分地
en: one of two equal parts of something | equal to one of two equal parts of something | to an extent that is not complete
example_en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
example_zh: 我留了一半三明治，準備晚點吃。

zh: 拉；拖；拔；拉；拉力；拉傷肌肉
en: to move something towards you or along by holding it | an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer | to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
example_en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
example_zh: 請輕輕拉門，不要推。

zh: 免費的；自由的；不受限制的；釋放；使擺脫
en: Costing no money. | Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted. | To release someone or something from control or confinement.
example_en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
example_zh: 這家咖啡館每賣一杯熱飲都會贈送餅乾。

zh: 要不要；好嗎；將會；必將；必須；應當
en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something. | Used with I or we to express future intentions formally. | Used in formal rules to state a requirement.
example_en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
example_zh: 我們晚飯後去散一會兒步好嗎？

zh: 階段；時期；舞臺；上演；舉辦；組織
en: A particular period or step in a process. | A raised area where performers appear before an audience. | To organise and present a performance or public event.
example_en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
example_zh: 製作進行到這個階段，蛋糕正在冷卻。

en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position | Say something you know is not true | Something untrue that someone says deliberately
example_en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
example_zh: 我喜歡午飯後躺在草地上。

zh: 範圍；幅度；一系列；在一定範圍內變化；山脈
en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits. | To vary between particular limits. | A connected group of mountains.
example_en: This shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit.
example_zh: 這家商店出售種類繁多的新鮮水果。

zh: 接受；同意；承認；認可；承擔；接受現實
en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer | Recognize that something is true or valid | Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation
example_en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
example_zh: 我欣然接受了她週六共進晚餐的邀請。

zh: 手臂；扶手；臂狀部件；武裝；提供裝備
en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand. | A projecting part of an object, especially a chair. | To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.
example_en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
example_zh: 她輕輕地把熟睡的寶寶抱在懷裡。

zh: 打破；折斷；破裂；休息；暫停；違反；違背
en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working. | A short period when an activity stops. | To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.
example_en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
example_zh: 小心別打碎那個玻璃碗。

zh: 材料；原料；布料；資料；素材；物質的；實質性的
en: A substance used to make things, including cloth. | Information or ideas used for study or creative work. | Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.
example_en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
example_zh: 這個包用結實的防水材料製成。

zh: 短的；短暫的；矮的；不足的；短缺的；未達到；突然停止
en: Having little length, height, or duration. | Not having as much of something as is needed. | Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.
example_en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
example_zh: 今晚晚飯前，我們散了一小會兒步。

en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something | used to ask who something belongs to
example_en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
example_zh: 誰的雨傘把水滴得滿地都是？

zh: 容易的；不費力的；輕鬆的；自在的
en: Not difficult and requiring little effort. | Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.
example_en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
example_zh: 用新鮮蔬菜做這道湯很容易。

en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.
example_en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
example_zh: 汽車拋錨時，我們陷入了困境。

zh: 記錄；檔案；記錄；錄音；錄影；最高紀錄
en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history. | To store information, sounds, or images for future use. | The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.
example_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
example_zh: 我把每一筆花費都記下來。

zh: 歐洲的；歐洲人的；歐洲人
en: Relating to Europe or its people. | A person from Europe.
example_en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
example_zh: 暑假期間，我們遊覽了幾座歐洲城市。

zh: 運動員；比賽參加者；演奏者；播放器
en: someone who takes part in a sport or game | someone who plays a musical instrument | a device or program that plays recorded sound or video
example_en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
example_zh: 足球比賽開始前，每位球員都握了手。

en: On the day before today. | The day immediately before today.
example_en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
example_zh: 我昨天把雨傘落在公交車上了。

zh: 底部；基礎；基地；總部；以…為依據
en: The lowest supporting part or underlying foundation of something. | A place from which people work or organise activities. | To use something as the foundation for a decision or idea.
example_en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
example_zh: 沉重的底座讓燈不易倒下。

en: more than usual, or more than other people or things
example_en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
example_zh: 我喜歡做飯，尤其是在朋友來吃晚飯的時候。

zh: 挑選；選擇；採摘；鎬；鶴嘴鋤
en: to choose someone or something from available options | to remove fruit or flowers from a plant | a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground
example_en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
example_zh: 新窗簾的顏色你可以隨便選。

zh: 窗；窗戶；電腦視窗；可利用的短暫時機
en: An opening with glass that lets light into a building | An area on a screen displaying a program or document | A limited period when something can be done
example_en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
example_zh: 請開啟窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

zh: 穿；戴；磨損；用舊；磨損；損耗
en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body | to damage or become damaged through repeated use | damage caused by regular use over time
example_en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
example_zh: 地板涼的時候，我總會穿上厚襪子。

zh: 覆蓋；遮蓋；包括；涉及；足以支付；蓋子；封面；保護套
en: To put something over a surface or object. | To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost. | An outer layer that protects or encloses something.
example_en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
example_zh: 麵包冷卻時，用一塊布蓋住它。

en: On most occasions, but not always.
example_en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
example_zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。

zh: 先生；老師（尊稱）；爵士（姓名前的頭銜）
en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher. | A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.
example_en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
example_zh: 打擾一下，先生，您忘拿傘了。

zh: 擊打；碰撞；嚴重影響；打擊；大獲成功的人或事物
en: Strike someone or something with force. | Affect someone or something badly, often suddenly. | Someone or something that becomes very popular or successful.
example_en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
example_zh: 球撞上圍欄，又朝我彈了過來。

zh: 質量；品質；特質；品德；優質的
en: How good or bad something is. | A characteristic of a person or thing. | Of a high standard.
example_en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
example_zh: 以這個價格來說，這雙鞋的質量讓我感到驚喜。

en: Used to express that something is definitely true. | Used to agree politely to a request.
example_en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
example_zh: 這件暖和的大衣肯定能讓你在外面也舒舒服服的。

en: To put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow
example_en: We usually eat breakfast together before leaving the house.
example_zh: 我們通常一起吃完早飯再出門。

zh: 常見的；普遍的；共同的；共有的
en: happening often or found in many places | shared by two or more people or groups
example_en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
example_zh: 這裡夏天經常下大雨。

en: needed for a particular purpose or situation
example_en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
example_zh: 如果你覺得有必要，就帶上一件暖和的外套。

en: to have something inside or as a part | to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger
example_en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
example_zh: 這個小盒子裡裝著我所有的縫紉用品。

zh: 床；河床；海底；湖底；花壇；苗床
en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping | The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake | An area of soil prepared for growing plants
example_en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
example_zh: 午飯後，貓蜷縮在我的床上。

zh: 塊；片；件；文章；藝術作品；拼合；拼湊
en: a part of something or a single item | a work of writing, music, or art | to join separate parts to make something complete
example_en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
example_zh: 她把最後一塊蛋糕留給了弟弟。

zh: 細節；具體資訊；詳盡程度；詳細說明
en: a small fact or feature of something | the amount of specific information provided | to describe something fully, including specific facts
example_en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
example_zh: 傳送邀請前，請核對每一處細節。

en: having happened or started a short time ago
example_en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
example_zh: 你看過我們家小狗最近的照片嗎？

zh: 僅僅；只不過；簡單地；樸素地；簡直；實在
en: only, with nothing more involved | in an uncomplicated or plain way | used to emphasise how strongly something is true
example_en: I simply want a quiet evening at home.
example_zh: 我只想在家安安靜靜地過個晚上。

zh: 單個的；僅一個的；單身的；未婚的；單程的
en: Only one, rather than several or many. | Not married or not in a romantic relationship. | For travel to a destination without a return journey.
example_en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
example_zh: 停電時，房間裡只有一支蠟燭照明。

zh: 日期；約會；確定年代；始於
en: A particular day of a month or year. | An arranged meeting, especially with someone you find romantically attractive. | To establish something's age, or originate in a particular period.
example_en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
example_zh: 你選好野餐的日期了嗎？

zh: 牆；圍牆；用牆圍住；用牆隔開
en: An upright structure enclosing, dividing, or supporting a space. | To surround or separate an area with a wall.
example_en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
example_zh: 我們在廚房牆上掛了一幅色彩鮮豔的畫。

zh: 個人的；本人的；私人的；隱私的；針對個人的；人身攻擊的
en: Belonging or relating to one particular person. | Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters. | Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.
example_en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
example_zh: 上火車時，請將個人物品放在身邊。

zh: 北；北方；北部；北部的；朝北的；向北；在北方
en: the direction opposite south, or an area's northern part | in the north or facing towards it | towards or in the north
example_en: The north of the island gets snow every winter.
example_zh: 這座島的北部每年冬天都會下雪。

en: How much of something there is. | To total something or be equivalent to it.
example_en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
example_zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。

zh: 一點；少量；小塊；位元；二進位制位
en: A small amount or piece of something. | The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.
example_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
example_zh: 還給你留了一點蛋糕。

zh: 接住；抓住；趕上；搭乘；感染；患上
en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone | to reach a bus, train, or plane in time | to become ill with an infectious disease
example_en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
example_zh: 你能只用一隻手接住球嗎？

zh: 一步；臺階；步驟；措施；邁步；踏；踩
en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface | one action in a process or towards a goal | to move by lifting and placing your foot
example_en: Take one step forward and close the door.
example_zh: 向前邁一步，把門關上。

zh: 嬰兒；幼崽；幼小的；嬰兒用的；嬌慣；把…當嬰兒對待
en: a very young child or animal | very young, or intended for babies | treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care
example_en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
example_zh: 爸爸輕聲唱歌時，寶寶睡著了。

en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes | the colour of ripe tomatoes
example_en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
example_zh: 她穿著一件紅色外套去了冬季集市。

en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.
example_en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
example_zh: 我睡過了頭，差點沒趕上公交車。

zh: 寬的；寬闊的；廣泛的；種類多的；充分地張開
en: measuring a large distance from one side to the other | including many different people, things, or possibilities | as far open as possible
example_en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
example_zh: 即使門口這麼寬，這張沙發也搬不進去。

zh: 南；南方；南部的；朝南的；向南；在南方
en: the direction opposite north | in, towards, or facing the south | towards or in the south
example_en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
example_zh: 我們的陽臺朝南，陽光很充足。

zh: 頭髮；毛髮；一根頭髮；一根毛
en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals. | A single strand growing from skin.
example_en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
example_zh: 她做午飯前把頭髮紮了起來。

en: to pay attention to sounds or what someone is saying | to take someone's advice or warnings seriously
example_en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
example_zh: 每天晚上做飯時，我都會聽音樂。

en: After a short time from now or another stated time.
example_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
example_zh: 晚飯很快就好了，去洗手吧。

zh: 木板；板；董事會；委員會；登上交通工具
en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material. | A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions. | Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.
example_en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
example_zh: 她在泥濘的小路上橫放了一塊木板。

en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.
example_en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
example_zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的腳踏車。

zh: 失敗；未能做到；不及格；使不及格；失靈；衰退
en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required | to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade | to stop working properly or become weaker
example_en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
example_zh: 儘管多加了一個雞蛋，蛋糕還是沒發起來。

zh: 外國的；來自國外的；異物的；外來的；陌生的；不相符的
en: From or relating to a country other than your own. | Present where it does not naturally belong. | Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.
example_en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
example_zh: 我姐姐喜歡在空閒時間學習外語。

zh: 簡單的；容易的；樸素的；不加修飾的
en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated. | Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.
example_en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
example_zh: 這道簡單的菜只需十分鐘就能做好。

en: The number equal to ten hundreds. | A very large quantity, expressed as thousands.
example_en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
example_zh: 維修費總共將近一千美元。

zh: 發生；存在；出現；被想到；浮現於腦海
en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place. | Exist or be found in a particular place or situation. | Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.
example_en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
example_zh: 冬季強風暴來襲時，這裡經常停電。

zh: 地板；室內地面；樓層；海底；谷底
en: The surface inside a building that people walk on. | A level of a building. | The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.
example_en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
example_zh: 我的鑰匙又掉到廚房地板上了。

en: The appearance of something as red, blue, green, and so on. | To give something a colour using pencils, paint, or dye.
example_en: What colour should we paint the kitchen walls?
example_zh: 我們該把廚房的牆刷成什麼顏色？

en: Of several different kinds.
example_en: We tried various dishes at the weekend market.
example_zh: 我們在週末集市上嚐了各種菜餚。

zh: 關上；關閉；結束；近的；親密的；靠近；接近
en: Shut something or bring an activity to an end | Near in distance or connected by a strong personal relationship | At a short distance from someone or something
example_en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
example_zh: 請在雨飄進來之前關上窗戶。

en: A place where people buy goods or services. | To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.
example_en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example_zh: 我們家附近的小店賣新鮮麵包。

zh: 清楚地；清晰地；顯然；明顯地
en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand. | In a way that shows something is obviously true.
example_en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
example_zh: 請說清楚些，讓大家都能聽清。

en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.
example_en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
example_zh: 我們做飯、聽音樂，度過了這個晚上。

zh: 火；火災；解僱；開除；開槍；發射
en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage. | To make someone leave their job. | To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.
example_en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後，我們在爐火旁暖手。

zh: 錯誤的；不合適的；不道德的；不正當的；錯誤地；出差錯地
en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable. | Not morally acceptable or fair. | In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.
example_en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
example_zh: 我坐錯了公交車，結果到了機場附近。

zh: 好的；健康的；優質的；細小的；纖細的；罰款
en: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality. | Made of very small particles or having little thickness. | Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.
example_en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
example_zh: 我現在感覺挺好的，我們去散步吧。

en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving. | Used to emphasize that I personally do something.
example_en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
example_zh: 散步前，我給自己做了個三明治。

zh: 西；西方；西部；西部的；朝西的；向西；在西方
en: the direction where the sun sets, opposite east | in or facing the direction where the sun sets | towards or in the west
example_en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
example_zh: 我們廚房的窗戶朝西，能照到傍晚的陽光。

zh: 體育運動；顯眼地穿戴；展示
en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition | To wear or display something in a noticeable way
example_en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
example_zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜歡的運動。

zh: 休息；休息；讓…休息；其餘部分；其他人
en: a period of relaxing without working or being active | to relax or allow someone or something to recover | the people or things that remain
example_en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
example_zh: 我們在那棵樹蔭下休息一下吧。

zh: 扔；投；擲；舉辦聚會；投擲；投擲距離
en: To send something through the air using your hand | To organise and host a party | An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown
example_en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
example_zh: 趁狗還沒搶到球，快把球扔給我。

zh: 在場的；目前的；展示；提出；頒發；禮物；現在
en: being in a place; existing or happening now | to show, explain or formally give something | something given to someone; the time happening now
example_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
example_zh: 拍班級合照時，所有孩子都在場。

zh: 頂部；頂端；最高的；最好的；位居……之首；超過
en: the highest part or surface of something | highest in position, rank, or quality | to rank highest or be greater than something
example_en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
example_zh: 她把那顆星星放在樹頂上。

en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.
example_en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
example_zh: 計程車一到，我們就迅速收拾好了行李。

en: The fourth month of the year.
example_en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
example_zh: 我們將在四月搬進新公寓。

en: get pleasure from an activity or experience | have something good, such as a right or advantage
example_en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
example_zh: 我們喜歡晚飯後在河邊散步。

en: Without being prevented or affected by something.
example_en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
example_zh: 儘管寒風吹拂，我們還是散步散得很開心。

en: Make or become full | Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need
example_en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
example_zh: 請把水壺裝滿水，給客人們喝。

zh: 落下；使掉落；下降；滴；少量液體；停止；放棄
en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower | a very small, rounded amount of liquid | to stop doing or considering something
example_en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
example_zh: 我伸手拿手機時，鑰匙掉了。

en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.
example_en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
example_zh: 我姐姐今年六月要結婚了。

zh: 推；按；敦促；迫使；推動；大力爭取
en: to press something or move it away by applying force | to strongly encourage or force someone to act | an act of pushing or a determined effort
example_en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
example_zh: 我來拿這些袋子，你能推一下手推車嗎？

zh: 大小；規模；尺碼；號；按大小分類；確定尺寸
en: How big or small someone or something is. | A standard measurement used for clothes and other products. | To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.
example_en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
example_zh: 這個行李箱的大小正適合週末出行。

en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.
example_en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
example_zh: 我們最近搬進了河邊的一套公寓。

en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown | to grow and care for plants in a garden
example_en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
example_zh: 午飯前，我們從菜園裡摘了新鮮的豆角。

zh: 商店；儲存；貯藏；儲備；儲存物
en: a place where people buy goods | to keep something somewhere for future use | a supply of something kept for future use
example_en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
example_zh: 我們家附近的商店賣新鮮麵包。

zh: 聲音；聲響；聽起來；發出聲音；合理的；可靠的；完好的
en: something you hear | to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise | sensible, reliable, or in good condition
example_en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
example_zh: 天還沒亮，雨聲就把我吵醒了。

zh: 進入；參加；加入；輸入；錄入
en: To go or come into a place. | To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation. | To put information into a computer or official record.
example_en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
example_zh: 進入廚房前，請把鞋底擦乾淨。

zh: 在附近；接近；在附近；臨近；近的；不久的
en: close to a place, time, or state | at or towards a short distance away in space or time | not far away in distance or time
example_en: We found a quiet café near the station.
example_zh: 我們在車站附近找到了一家安靜的咖啡館。

en: To reach the place you were travelling to. | For an event or a particular time to come.
example_en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
example_zh: 我們的客人恰好在晚飯準備好時到了。

en: Related items or names written one below another. | To write or state items one after another.
example_en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
example_zh: 出門前，我列了一張購物清單。

zh: 速度比賽；賽跑；種族；競速；飛奔
en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest. | A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics. | To compete in speed or move very quickly.
example_en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
example_zh: 我們在橋上觀看了划船比賽。

zh: 熱的；溫度高的；辣的；熱門的；備受關注的
en: Having a high temperature. | Having a strong taste that burns your mouth. | Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.
example_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
example_zh: 小心，湯還很燙。

en: Something said or written as an answer. | An action or change caused by an event or situation.
example_en: I sent an invitation but haven't received a response yet.
example_zh: 我發出了邀請，但還沒有收到答覆。

zh: 圓形的；球形的；一輪；一回合；圍繞；繞過
en: shaped like a circle or ball | one stage in a repeated series of activities | around something or on all sides of it
example_en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
example_zh: 我們在廚房窗邊放了一張圓桌。

en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms
example_en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
example_zh: 我們住的酒店房間可以俯瞰一片寧靜的沙灘。

zh: 射擊；射中；拍攝；嫩芽；新枝
en: Fire a gun or another weapon; hit with a bullet | Take photographs or record a film | A new part growing from a plant
example_en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
example_zh: 她在當地一傢俱樂部學會了射箭。

zh: 在……上方；超過；高於；在上方；在上文
en: In a higher position than something else. | Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard. | In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.
example_en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
example_zh: 廚房水槽上方掛著一個小木架。

zh: 東方；東部；東部的；向東的；向東；在東方
en: the direction where the sun rises, opposite west | in the east or facing towards it | towards or in the east
example_en: Our kitchen window faces east and catches the morning sun.
example_zh: 我們廚房的窗戶朝東，能照到早晨的陽光。

zh: 向前；向將來；轉寄；轉發；前鋒
en: towards the front or a later time | to send something received to another person or place | an attacking player in sports such as football
example_en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
example_zh: 前面有空位時，請向前走一步。

zh: 挽救；救助；節省；儲蓄；儲存；保留
en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost. | To use less of something or keep money for later. | To keep something for future use, especially computer data.
example_en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
example_zh: 救生員從深水中救起了一個孩子。

en: The number after eight and before ten.
example_en: We packed nine apples for our picnic today.
example_zh: 我們為今天的野餐裝了九個蘋果。

zh: 特點；特色；以…為特色；重點展示；面部特徵；五官之一
en: a noticeable or important part of something | to include or present someone or something prominently | a part of the face, such as the nose
example_en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
example_zh: 這個揹包最讓我喜歡的特點是它的隱藏口袋。

zh: 在……更遠處；在另一邊；超出；超過；在更遠處
en: on the farther side of something | outside a particular limit, range, or ability | at or towards a place farther away
example_en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
example_zh: 一條狹窄的小路通向沙丘另一邊的海灘。

zh: 精確地；恰好；正是；完全正確
en: Precisely, with no difference or error. | Used to confirm that something is completely correct.
example_en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
example_zh: 這件夾克正是我想要的顏色。

zh: 杯子；一杯的量；獎盃；使呈杯狀；捧住
en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds. | A decorative container awarded for winning a competition. | To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.
example_en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
example_zh: 我雙手捧著一杯茶取暖。

zh: 令人愉快的；美好的；友善的；體貼的
en: pleasant or enjoyable | kind and friendly towards other people
example_en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
example_zh: 我們在湖邊愉快地野餐了一次。

zh: 嚴重的；重大的；認真的；嚴肅的
en: causing harm or requiring careful attention | not joking, or thinking carefully about something
example_en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
example_zh: 漏水的管道給我們的廚房造成了嚴重損壞。

en: Used to make a request or offer more polite. | To make someone feel happy or satisfied.
example_en: Could you please hold the door for me?
example_zh: 你能幫我扶一下門嗎？

zh: 準備好的；可用的；願意的；即將做某事的
en: Prepared or available for use or action. | Willing to do something. | About to do something very soon.
example_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
example_zh: 晚飯好了，請把你的盤子拿來。

zh: 跡象；徵兆；標牌；符號；手勢；簽名；簽署
en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop | An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information | Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement
example_en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
example_zh: 那些烏雲預示著雨就要來了。

zh: 無論什麼；任何事物；無論哪種；任何的
en: anything that; no matter what | any kind of something, without restriction
example_en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
example_zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什麼都可以選。

en: The state of being hard to do or understand. | A problem that makes progress or success harder.
example_en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
example_zh: 我手溼著，很難開啟那個罐子。

zh: 左邊的；左側的；向左；在左邊；剩下的
en: On the side opposite the right. | Towards or on the side opposite the right. | Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.
example_en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
example_zh: 我用左手提購物袋。

en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.
example_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
example_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里遠。

zh: 準備；做好準備；製作；擬訂
en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation | Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use
example_en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上出門前都會準備好午餐。

zh: 最後的；最終的；不可更改的；決定性的；決賽；期末考試
en: coming last in a series or process | settled and not open to further change or discussion | a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course
example_en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
example_zh: 我們裝好最後一個箱子，鎖上了門。

zh: 盒子；箱子；把…裝箱；打拳擊
