en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid | to put something into a box | to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves
example_en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
example_zh: 小貓在一個空紙箱裡睡著了。

en: Attractive and pleasant to look at. | To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.
example_en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
example_zh: 我們在一條安靜的小溪邊發現了一座漂亮的小屋。

zh: 放置；鋪設；產卵；下蛋；非專業的；非神職的
en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat | to produce eggs from the body | not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion
example_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
example_zh: 請把乾淨毛巾放在浴室架子上。

zh: 在外面；向外面；在…外；超出…範圍；外面的；外部的
en: In or towards a place that is not inside. | Beyond the boundaries or limits of something. | Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.
example_en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
example_zh: 父母準備午飯時，孩子們在外面玩耍。

en: used to add another negative statement or alternative
example_en: I could neither find my keys nor remember where I parked.
example_zh: 我既找不到鑰匙，也記不起把車停在哪裡了。

zh: 正常的；通常的；常態；正常水平
en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation | the usual state or level of something
example_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
example_zh: 面試前感到緊張是正常的。

zh: 玻璃；玻璃杯；一杯的量；眼鏡
en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers. | A drinking container, or the amount it holds. | Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.
example_en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
example_zh: 球砸中了窗戶，把玻璃打碎了。

en: a female sibling | a woman who belongs to a religious community
example_en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
example_zh: 我妹妹總是借穿我最喜歡的藍色毛衣。

zh: 錯過；未趕上；想念；未擊中；未察覺
en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something | to feel sad because someone or something is absent | to fail to hit a target or notice something
example_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
example_zh: 快點，否則我們會錯過末班公交車。

zh: 即使如此；無論如何；再說；總之
en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said. | Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.
example_en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
example_zh: 雖然開始下雨了，但我們還是去散步了。

en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something | to stay away from someone or something
example_en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
example_zh: 我們很早就出發了，以避開早高峰的車流。

en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services | a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body | a piece of paper money, especially in American English
example_en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
example_zh: 吃完午飯後，我們請服務員拿來賬單。

zh: 藍色的；藍色；憂鬱的；沮喪的
en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky | the colour of a clear daytime sky | feeling sad or unhappy
example_en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
example_zh: 他穿了一件藍色夾克去野餐。

zh: 完成；結束；吃完；結尾；終點；表面處理；光潔度
en: to complete something or reach its end | the final part or end of something | the appearance or texture of a completed surface
example_en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
example_zh: 我們出門前，我會把碗洗完。

en: The seventh month of the year, following June
example_en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
example_zh: 我們通常在七月去表親家住一週。

zh: 往往會；傾向於；照料；護理
en: To usually behave in a particular way. | To look after someone or something.
example_en: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
example_zh: 我午飯吃得多之後往往會犯困。

zh: 腿；傢俱的腿；支腳；一段行程
en: a body part used for standing and walking | a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object | one stage of a journey or race
example_en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
example_zh: 走了很長一段路回家後，我的雙腿很累。

en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.
example_en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
example_zh: 我們做飯時，燈突然滅了。

zh: 黑暗的；昏暗的；深色的；黑暗；夜色
en: having little or no light | having a colour closer to black than white | the absence of light, especially at night
example_en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
example_zh: 走廊太暗了，我找不到自己的鞋。

zh: 遍及；貫穿整個時期；到處；自始至終
en: In every part of a place or during an entire period. | In every part or for the whole time.
example_en: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
example_zh: 新鮮麵包的香味飄滿了整棟房子。

zh: 通常；一般地；普遍地；廣泛地
en: In most cases or at most times. | By most people or across most places.
example_en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
example_zh: 除非下雨，否則我通常步行上班。

zh: 移走；取下；脫去；清除；消除；免職；撤職
en: to take something away from where it is | to get rid of something unwanted | to make someone leave a job or position
example_en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
example_zh: 踩上新地毯前，請先脫鞋。

en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended | fall or bend downwards loosely
example_en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
example_zh: 請把你的溼外套掛在前門旁邊。

zh: 拜訪；參觀；遊覽；拜訪；參觀；逗留
en: To go to see a person or place. | An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.
example_en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
example_zh: 我們去拜訪鄰居，和他們分享了一些自制的湯。

zh: 冷的；寒冷的；感冒；冷淡的；不友好的
en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth. | A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose. | Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.
example_en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
example_zh: 我的手很冷，於是戴上了手套。

en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves. | Causing little harm to the environment. | The colour of grass and most leaves.
example_en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
example_zh: 她穿了一件綠色夾克來搭配鞋子。

zh: 卡；卡片；證件；賀卡；明信片；紙牌
en: A small stiff rectangle used for payment, identification, or information. | A decorated card sent with a greeting or personal message. | One of a set of small rectangles used in games.
example_en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
example_zh: 我刷卡支付了買食品雜貨的錢。

zh: 替換；取代；更換；把……放回原處
en: To take something's place or put something else in its place. | To put something back where it was before.
example_en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
example_zh: 我們需要換掉廚房裡那把壞椅子。

zh: 座位；使就座；容納……就座；議席；席位
en: A place or object for someone to sit on. | To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people. | A position as a member of an elected body.
example_en: She saved me a seat near the front.
example_zh: 她在靠前的位置給我留了一個座位。

zh: 郵件；郵政；郵寄；釋出；職位；崗位
en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them. | To send something by mail or share it publicly. | A job or position in an organisation.
example_en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上寄來了一個包裹。

en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue
example_en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
example_zh: 除非開始下雨，否則我們就在外面吃飯。

en: to refer to someone or something briefly | a brief reference to someone or something
example_en: Did you mention the broken window to the landlord?
example_zh: 你向房東提過那扇壞了的窗戶嗎？

zh: 方向；發展趨勢；路線指引；使用說明；指導；管理
en: the way something points, moves, or develops | instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something | the control or guidance of an activity or group
example_en: The dog suddenly ran in the opposite direction.
example_zh: 那隻狗突然朝相反的方向跑去。

en: during the evening or night of today | the evening or night of today
example_en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
example_zh: 我們今晚要做蔬菜湯當晚餐。

en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example_en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
example_zh: 一隻大狗正睡在那隻小貓旁邊。

en: A round object used in games or shaped like one. | A formal social event where people dance.
example_en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
example_zh: 那隻狗追著球跑過草地。

zh: 你自己；您自己；你親自；你本人
en: Used when you are both the subject and object. | Used to emphasize the person being addressed.
example_en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
example_zh: 用那把刀時要小心，別割傷自己。

zh: 回答；回覆；作出反應；響應
en: To say or write something in reply. | To react to something through actions or physical changes.
example_en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
example_zh: 我發訊息問晚飯怎麼安排，卻沒人回覆。

en: Moving to a position on a surface.
example_en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
example_zh: 貓跳到我旁邊的沙發上。

en: to say that you will not do or accept something | unwanted waste material that people throw away
example_en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
example_zh: 不帶上她最喜歡的藍色雨傘，她就不肯走。

en: The tenth month of the year, between September and November.
example_en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
example_zh: 我們當地的游泳池將在十月重新開放。

zh: 搖動；抖動；顫抖；使震驚；動搖；搖動；抖動
en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement | to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence | a quick movement back and forth
example_en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
example_zh: 把果汁倒進杯子前，先充分搖勻瓶子。

zh: 沉重的；大量的；強烈的；繁重的；難以承受的
en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift | Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity | Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty
example_en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
example_zh: 這個行李箱太重了，我提不起來。

zh: 椅子；會議主席；負責人；主持會議
en: a seat for one person, usually with a back | the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee | to lead a meeting and manage its discussion
example_en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
example_zh: 她把一把椅子拉到離窗戶更近的地方。

zh: 假期；度假；節日；法定假日；度假
en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel. | An officially recognised day when many people do not work. | To spend time away from home for pleasure.
example_en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
example_zh: 我們假期裡游泳，還探訪了寧靜的村莊。

zh: 一件物品；一件商品；專案；條目；一則訊息
en: A single object, especially one in a collection. | One part of a list, programme, or news report.
example_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
example_zh: 請把每件商品小心地放進購物袋。

en: Between small and large, or between low and high. | A means of communicating information or expressing ideas.
example_en: Cook the vegetables over medium heat until soft.
example_zh: 用中火把蔬菜煮軟。

zh: 直接的；直達的；指導；指揮；導演；指路；將……指向
en: Without anything or anyone coming between. | To guide or control an activity, performance, or group. | To show the way or aim something towards a place.
example_en: There is a direct train from here to the airport.
example_zh: 這裡有直達機場的火車。

zh: 按；壓；新聞界；報刊；催促；敦促
en: Push firmly against something. | Newspapers, magazines, and the journalists who produce them. | Try firmly to persuade someone to do something.
example_en: Press this button to open the garage door.
example_zh: 按這個按鈕就能開啟車庫門。

en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation
example_en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
example_zh: 你的建議幫我選到了一輛騎著舒服的腳踏車。

en: a journey to a place and usually back again | to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot
example_en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
example_zh: 我們週末的海濱之旅讓人十分放鬆。

zh: 在……裡面；向……裡面；在裡面；往裡面；裡面；內部
en: in or into the inner part of something | in or into an enclosed place or container | the inner part or surface of something
example_en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
example_zh: 你的鑰匙在包的小口袋裡。

en: The month after August and before October.
example_en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
example_zh: 我們今年的攝影夜課九月開課。

en: the United States of America | North and South America considered together
example_en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
example_zh: 我的表親搬到美國去學工程。

zh: 立即；馬上；緊接地；緊鄰地；一……就
en: without waiting or any delay | directly before, after, or next to something | as soon as something happens
example_en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
example_zh: 門鈴一響，我就立刻開啟了門。

zh: 價值……的；值得的；價值；作用
en: Having a particular value in money. | Deserving the time, effort, or money something requires. | The value, importance, or usefulness of something.
example_en: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
example_zh: 這輛舊腳踏車仍然值五十英鎊。

en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface. | A quality that makes someone or something more competitive. | To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.
example_en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
example_zh: 別把你的玻璃杯放在桌子邊緣。

en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind | a particular type of something
example_en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
example_zh: 我們用各種色彩鮮豔的蔬菜讓午餐更豐富。

zh: 麻煩；困難；故障；使煩惱；麻煩
en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience | to cause someone worry or ask them for help
example_en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
example_zh: 廚房的窗戶很緊，我們費了好大勁才開啟。

en: the first month of the year
example_en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
example_zh: 我們今年的游泳課從一月開始。

en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose
example_en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
example_zh: 停電時，這個小手電筒很有用。

en: to be determined or affected by something | to need or trust someone or something for support
example_en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
example_zh: 我們週末的安排取決於天氣怎麼樣。

zh: 中間；中部；中間的；居中的
en: The central part, point, or position of something | Located between other things or between the beginning and end
example_en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
example_zh: 有人把一個行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

en: the day after Saturday and before Monday
example_en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
example_zh: 我們通常在星期日一起做一頓豐盛的午餐。

zh: 酒吧；飲品吧檯；條；棒；長條塊；禁止；阻止
en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served | a long narrow piece of solid material | to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something
example_en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
example_zh: 我們在酒店的酒吧點了鮮榨橙汁。

en: in place of someone or something else
example_en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
example_zh: 咖啡館關門了，於是我們改為回家。

zh: 東西；物品；材料；塞滿；填塞
en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically. | To fill something tightly or push something into a space.
example_en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
example_zh: 請把你的東西從廚房餐桌上拿走。

zh: 完成；填寫完；完整的；齊全的；完全的；徹底的
en: to finish doing something or filling in information | having every necessary part, with nothing missing | total, without any limit or exception
example_en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
example_zh: 我剛拼好拼圖，晚飯就做好了。

en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example_en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example_zh: 有人把一把藍色雨傘落在了前門旁邊。

en: The number equal to three groups of ten.
example_en: The soup needs another thirty minutes on the stove.
example_zh: 這鍋湯還需要在爐子上再煮三十分鐘。

zh: 容易地；輕鬆地；無疑；遠遠；很可能
en: without difficulty or much effort | by a clear margin, especially in comparisons | with a strong possibility of something happening
example_en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
example_zh: 這個小行李箱輕輕鬆鬆就能放到火車座位下面。

en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things. | To put something into a bag.
example_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
example_zh: 她把蘋果放進了一個可重複使用的袋子裡。

zh: 西部的；西方的；西方國家及文化的；西部電影；西部小說
en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area. | Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures. | A film or story about the historical American West.
example_en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
example_zh: 我們的小屋位於湖的西岸，面朝湖水。

en: warmth or a high temperature | to make or become warmer | a race that decides who enters the next round
example_en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
example_zh: 我們在樹下休息，躲避酷熱。

zh: 艱難的；棘手的；堅強的；能吃苦的；堅韌的；不易破損的
en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure | Able to cope with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions | Strong and difficult to break, cut, or damage
example_en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
example_zh: 這段攀登很艱難，但沿途的風景讓付出變得值得。

en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.
example_en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
example_zh: 麵包店老闆每天早上都向我們打招呼。

zh: 在前面；向前；領先；提前；在未來；預先
en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward. | Further advanced than others or earlier than expected. | In the future, or in preparation for it.
example_en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
example_zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小橋。

zh: 地址；網址；處理；設法解決；向…講話；致辭
en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found. | To give attention to a problem and try to solve it. | To speak directly to a person or group.
example_en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
example_zh: 請在我寄包裹之前把你的地址發給我。

zh: 物體；東西；反對；目的；目標
en: a thing that can be seen or touched | to express disagreement with something | the aim of an action or activity
example_en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
example_zh: 沙發下面有個閃閃發亮的東西。

zh: 教練；長途客車；訓練；輔導
en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills | a comfortable bus used for longer journeys | to train or teach someone to improve particular skills
example_en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
example_zh: 我們的教練示範瞭如何握球拍。

zh: 注意到；察覺；通知；告示；提前通知
en: to become aware of something through your senses | a written statement giving information or instructions | information given before something happens or ends
example_en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
example_zh: 你注意到窗外那隻小鳥了嗎？

en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed. | A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.
example_en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
example_zh: 我們的狗追著一個黃色的球跑過院子。

zh: 打敗；勝過；反覆敲打；跳動；節拍；有節奏的敲擊
en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest. | To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm. | A regular pulse of sound or movement.
example_en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
example_zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋贏了我。

zh: 收藏品；一批物品；收集；收取；募捐；募集的款項
en: a group of objects kept or presented together | the act of gathering or taking things away | the gathering of money from people for a purpose
example_en: My aunt keeps her shell collection in a cabinet.
example_zh: 我姑姑把她收藏的貝殼放在櫃子裡。

en: Large in amount, size, or degree.
example_en: Repairing the roof took considerable time and effort.
example_zh: 修理屋頂花了相當多的時間和精力。

zh: 手指；用手指觸控或撥弄
en: one of the long movable parts of a hand | to touch or handle something with your fingers
example_en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
example_zh: 她的中指上戴著一枚銀戒指。

zh: 合身；裝得下；適合；健康強健的；適合的；合格的
en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something. | Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise. | Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.
example_en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
example_zh: 即使穿著厚襪子，這雙靴子也非常合腳。

en: A room where food is prepared and cooked
example_en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
example_zh: 廚房裡飄著新鮮麵包和烤蔬菜的香味。

zh: 射擊；射門；投籃；照片；鏡頭；嘗試
en: an act of firing a weapon or sending a ball | a photograph or a continuous piece of filmed action | an attempt to achieve or do something
example_en: Her final shot sent the ball into the net.
example_zh: 她最後一腳射門把球踢進了球網。

zh: 安全的；無危險的；穩妥的；風險小的；保險箱
en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm. | Unlikely to fail or lead to loss. | A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.
example_en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
example_zh: 你的腳踏車放在我們鎖好的車庫裡很安全。

en: The eleventh month of the year.
example_en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
example_zh: 我們將在十一月搬進新公寓。

en: the final month of the year, following November
example_en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
example_zh: 我表親十二月要來我們家住。

en: Already present or in use at a particular time.
example_en: We kept the existing shelves and painted them blue.
example_zh: 我們保留了原有的架子，並把它們刷成藍色。

zh: 忍受；承受；承擔；熊；帶有；具有
en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility | a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur | to have or display a particular feature or mark
example_en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
example_zh: 我受不了那臺舊風扇的噪聲。

zh: 得分；分數；得分；獲得分數；配樂；樂譜
en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition | to gain points in a game, test, or competition | music written for a film or the written music itself
example_en: My score improved after a week of practice.
example_zh: 練習一週後，我的分數提高了。

en: On the day after today. | The day after today, or the future more generally.
example_en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
example_zh: 我們明天早上在游泳池見面。

en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening. | A formal social occasion at which people eat a meal.
example_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
example_zh: 晚飯做好了，請把盤子拿來。

zh: 額外的；附加的；額外地；格外地；額外專案；群眾演員
en: added to the usual or necessary amount | more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount | an additional item, or a background actor in a film
example_en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
example_zh: 我多帶了一件毛衣，因為晚上會冷。

zh: 旅行；行進；旅行；出行；傳播；傳送
en: To go from one place to another. | The activity of going to other places. | To move or spread from one place to another.
example_en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
example_zh: 我們通常坐火車去看望祖父母。

zh: 四分之一；季度；城區；街區
en: One of four equal parts of something. | A period of three months within a year. | An area of a town with a particular character.
example_en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
example_zh: 她把三明治切成四等份給孩子們吃。

zh: 一個也沒有；毫無；毫不；一點也不
en: not any of the people or things being considered | not at all, used before certain comparative expressions
example_en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
example_zh: 我看了看餅乾罐，但一塊也沒剩下。

zh: 前部；正面；前面的；正面的；鋒；天氣鋒面
en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something. | Located at or near the forward part of something. | A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.
example_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
example_zh: 請把沾滿泥的靴子放在前門旁。

en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty
example_en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
example_zh: 搜遍每個房間後，我們終於找到了丟失的鑰匙。

zh: 某次；場合；特殊活動；盛會；機會；時機
en: a particular time when something happens | an important or special event | a suitable opportunity to do something
example_en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
example_zh: 我見過你姐姐好幾次。

zh: 安排；籌備；排列；佈置；商定；協議
en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen. | The way objects are positioned or organised. | An agreement about how something will be done.
example_en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
example_zh: 我們安排了人來喂貓。

zh: 鑰匙；關鍵；秘訣；關鍵的；主要的
en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock. | Something essential for understanding or achieving something. | Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.
example_en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
example_zh: 我把家門鑰匙放在外套口袋裡了。

en: moving or happening at high speed | at high speed or within a short time | to eat no food for a period of time
example_en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
example_zh: 我們趕上了一班快車，在午飯前就到了。

zh: 獨自的；單獨的；獨自地；獨力地；僅僅；單是
en: without anyone else present | without other people or their help | only, excluding everything or everyone else
example_en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
example_zh: 水壺裡的水燒開時，廚房裡只有我一個人。

zh: 比賽；相配；匹配；比得上；火柴
en: a sports contest between two people or teams | to go well together, correspond, or equal something | a small stick that produces fire when rubbed
example_en: We watched a football match at the local park.
example_zh: 我們在附近的公園看了一場足球比賽。

en: The absence of something or not having enough of it | Not have something necessary or enough of it
example_en: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
example_zh: 睡眠不足讓我整個上午都很疲憊。

en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.
example_en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
example_zh: 我們花了一週探索這座島的南部海岸。

zh: 新鮮的；清新的；涼爽宜人的；新的；不同於以往的
en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale. | Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air. | New or different from what existed or was used before.
example_en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上我在市場買了新鮮草莓。

en: by a small amount or to a small degree
example_en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
example_zh: 請把窗戶稍微開啟一點，感覺有些熱。

en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.
example_en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
example_zh: 出門前確保手機已經充滿電。

en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.
example_en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
example_zh: 我們在河邊找到了一家安靜的餐館。

en: The time between midday and evening.
example_en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
example_zh: 我們整個下午都在廚房裡烤麵包。

en: to look at someone or something steadily for a while | a long, fixed look at someone or something
example_en: The cat stared at a bird outside the window.
example_zh: 貓盯著窗外的一隻鳥。

zh: 否則；不然；在其他方面；以其他方式；不同地
en: If this does not happen or is not done. | In all other ways apart from the one mentioned. | In a different way or with a different result.
example_en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you will get wet.
example_zh: 帶把傘吧，否則你會淋溼的。

zh: 幾乎不；幾乎沒有；剛剛；才
en: almost not, or only to a very small degree | only just, before something else happens
example_en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
example_zh: 雨聲太大，我幾乎聽不見你說話。

zh: 在……下方；低於；在下面；在下文
en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something. | In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.
example_en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
example_zh: 我們的貓睡在窗戶下方的架子上。

zh: 直接地；徑直地；立即；很快；正好；恰好
en: Without anyone or anything coming between | Immediately or after a very short time | Exactly in a particular position
example_en: Please send the photos directly to my phone.
example_zh: 請把照片直接發到我的手機上。

en: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water | dried leaves used to make tea | a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal
example_en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
example_zh: 你休息的時候，我泡了一壺茶。

zh: 完全地；絕對地；當然；完全同意
en: completely or without any doubt | used to express strong agreement with someone
example_en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
example_zh: 我們打掃後，廚房一塵不染。

en: not a single person | a person considered unimportant or unknown
example_en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
example_zh: 沒人注意到睡在沙發後面的小貓。

zh: 必不可少的；必要的；本質的；基本的；必需品；基本要點
en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation | Relating to the most important characteristics of something | A necessary item or basic fact, usually mentioned in plural
example_en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
example_zh: 這次冬日散步必須穿一件暖和的外套。

zh: 證實；確認屬實；確認安排；正式批准
en: To establish that something is true or correct. | To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.
example_en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
example_zh: 請今天給酒店打電話，確認我們的預訂。

en: the day after Friday and before Sunday
example_en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
example_zh: 我們通常星期六去市場買新鮮蔬菜。

zh: 完美的；最合適的；使完善；使精通；完成時的
en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose | to improve something until it is as good as possible | describing verb forms using have with a past participle
example_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
example_zh: 這個安靜的角落特別適合午飯後看書。

en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.
example_en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
example_zh: 在雨中走過之後，我的鞋全溼透了。

en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.
example_en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
example_zh: 等公交車時，我們友好地聊了一會兒。

en: to put your hand or another body part against something | the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact | to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion
example_en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
example_zh: 請別碰鍋，它還很燙。

en: The distance from one end of something to the other. | The amount of time something lasts.
example_en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
example_zh: 我們買椅子之前量了桌子的長度。

zh: 平衡；均衡；保持平衡；兼顧；賬戶餘額；結欠款
en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things | To keep something steady or give competing needs suitable attention | The money remaining in an account or still owed
example_en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
example_zh: 她下公交車時失去了平衡。

zh: 體育聯賽；聯賽組織；聯盟；聯合會；水平；等級
en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another. | An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose. | A level of quality, ability, or achievement.
example_en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
example_zh: 我們隊本賽季在聯賽中排名第一。

zh: 事故；意外；偶然發生的事
en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage. | Something that happens without being planned or intended.
example_en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
example_zh: 幸好，我們家外面發生的事故沒有造成人員受傷。

zh: 營地；度假營；露營；紮營；陣營；派別
en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents. | Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter. | A group sharing the same opinions or aims.
example_en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
example_zh: 我們在下雨前回到了營地。

en: The second month of the year.
example_en: My sister starts her new job in February.
example_zh: 我姐姐二月份開始新工作。

en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.
example_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
example_zh: 我們通常在週末逛農貿市場。

zh: 十二個；一打；許多；幾十個
en: a group of twelve | a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural
example_en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
example_zh: 請在回家的路上買十二個雞蛋。

zh: 通常；一般情況下；正常地
en: usually, or in most situations | in the usual, expected, or healthy way
example_en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
example_zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

en: The first part or starting point of something.
example_en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
example_zh: 我們昨天錯過了電影的開頭。

zh: 形狀；外形；塑造；影響；使成形
en: the outer form of something | to influence how something develops | to give something a particular physical form
example_en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
example_zh: 她把餅乾坯切成了星星的形狀。

zh: 迷；愛好者；風扇；扇子；扇風；煽動
en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing | a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow | to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger
example_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
example_zh: 作為一名足球迷，我幾乎不錯過任何一場比賽。

zh: 棍；枝條；手杖；貼上；粘住；插入；刺入
en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes. | To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance. | To push a pointed object into something.
example_en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
example_zh: 那隻狗把一根樹枝叼回給我。

en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground. | A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.
example_en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
example_zh: 我最喜歡的襪子上有一個小洞。

zh: 一雙；一對；一副；兩人；一組兩人；配對；使成對
en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts. | Two people who are together or work together. | To put people or things together in groups of two.
example_en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
example_zh: 我把最喜歡的那雙手套落在公交車上了。

zh: 收集；收藏；領取；接走；募集；收取
en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby | To go somewhere and bring someone or something away | To receive or gather money from people
example_en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
example_zh: 每次去海邊，我都會收集光滑的石頭。

en: At a low speed or over a long time.
example_en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
example_zh: 她慢慢地把熱湯倒進碗裡。

zh: 地點；場所；斑點；汙點；發現；認出
en: A particular place or position. | A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings. | Notice or recognise someone or something.
example_en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
example_zh: 我們在河邊找到了一處陰涼的地方。

zh: 距離；間距；疏遠；隔閡；使疏遠；撇清關係
en: The amount of space between two places or things | A lack of emotional closeness between people | To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views
example_en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
example_zh: 從我們家到學校的距離很短。

en: the eighth month of the year
example_en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
example_zh: 我們通常八月去看望住在海邊的祖父母。

zh: 速度；速率；快速移動；疾馳；超速駕駛
en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates | To move or travel very fast | To drive faster than the legal limit
example_en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
example_zh: 我們離開小鎮時，火車加快了速度。

zh: 路線；路徑；按路線傳送；安排路線
en: a way taken to get from one place to another | to send someone or something along a particular path
example_en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
example_zh: 我們換了一條路線回家，以避開擁堵。

zh: 滾動；使滾動；捲起；捲成；一卷；小麵包
en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly | To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape | Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread
example_en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
example_zh: 橙子從桌上滾下來，滾到了我的椅子底下。

zh: 隱藏；躲藏；隱瞞；掩飾；獸皮
en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight. | To prevent others from knowing or noticing something. | The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.
example_en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
example_zh: 我們把生日禮物藏在了床底下。

zh: 分開的；各自的；分開；分離
en: not joined, shared, or considered together | to divide things or move them apart
example_en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
example_zh: 我們把乾淨毛巾放在一個單獨的櫃子裡。

zh: 危險；風險；危險因素；威脅
en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed. | Someone or something that may cause harm.
example_en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
example_zh: 離邊緣遠一點，有掉下去的危險。

zh: 定期的；經常的；規則的；均勻的；常客
en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events. | Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement. | Someone who often visits the same place.
example_en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
example_zh: 我們的狗需要經常散步，才能保持快樂和健康。

zh: 到期應付的；應交的；預期的；預計到達的；應得的；應有的
en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time. | Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time. | Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.
example_en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
example_zh: 我們的房租本週末到期應付。

en: to answer someone or respond to a message | an answer given in speech or writing
example_en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
example_zh: 請在週五之前回復，好讓我預訂晚餐。

en: Pay no attention to someone or something
example_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
example_zh: 請別忽視發動機發出的那種怪聲。

zh: 迅速的；敏捷的；短暫的；用時少的
en: moving or acting fast, without much delay | taking only a short time
example_en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
example_zh: 她反應敏捷，及時接住了差點掉落的玻璃杯。

en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes
example_en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
example_zh: 這家餐館在這款蘑菇醬里加了少量葡萄酒。

zh: 戒指；環狀物；響鈴；使響鈴；打電話給
en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger | to make a bell sound or cause one to sound | to contact someone by telephone
example_en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
example_zh: 她把那枚銀戒指戴在了手指上。

zh: 明亮的；鮮豔的；聰明的；機靈的；充滿希望的；愉快的
en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour | quick to learn and understand things | promising success or showing happiness
example_en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，明亮的陽光從廚房窗戶照了進來。

en: Added to what already exists or is available.
example_en: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
example_zh: 今晚有客人來，我們需要再加一把椅子。

zh: 客人；受邀嘉賓；旅館住客
en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event. | Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.
example_en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
example_zh: 每位客人都帶了一道菜，在晚餐時與大家分享。

en: Extremely small in size or amount.
example_en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
example_zh: 一隻小小的青蛙從花盆裡跳了出來。

en: items worn to cover the body
example_en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
example_zh: 你洗乾淨的衣服正在外面曬太陽。

zh: 餵養；進食；動物飼料；資訊流
en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food. | Food given to farm animals. | A regularly updated stream of online content.
example_en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
example_zh: 請在上學前喂一下貓。

en: mostly or to a great extent
example_en: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
example_zh: 我們到達時，海灘上幾乎沒什麼人。

en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen. | Put things in a particular order or position.
example_en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
example_zh: 我約好和表親在電影院外見面。

en: mainly, or for the largest part
example_en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
example_zh: 我的週末大部分時間都用來做飯和看書了。

en: A picture made using a camera.
example_en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
example_zh: 我們在那座老橋旁拍了張照片。

zh: 活著的；有生命的；生計；謀生收入；生活；生活方式
en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life. | Money earned to pay for everyday needs. | The way people live and meet their everyday needs.
example_en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
example_zh: 池塘裡滿是微小的生物。

zh: 數；計數；重要；有價值；計數；總數
en: to find how many things there are | to matter or have an important effect | the act of counting, or the total found
example_en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
example_zh: 請在客人到來之前數一下盤子。

zh: 包裹；包裝盒；一整套方案或服務；包裝
en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together. | A set of services or measures offered together. | To put something into a container for sale or transport.
example_en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，一個小包裹送到了我們家門口。

en: To move someone or something to a higher position. | A machine carrying people or goods between floors. | A ride in someone else's vehicle.
example_en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
example_zh: 你能幫我把這個箱子抬到架子上嗎？

en: mostly, or more than anything else
example_en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
example_zh: 這家小店主要賣新鮮麵包和蛋糕。

zh: 跳；跳過；猛增；驟升；跳躍；猛增
en: To push yourself off the ground into the air. | To increase suddenly by a large amount. | An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.
example_en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
example_zh: 狗跳過了大門旁的一攤積水。

zh: 收集；蒐集；聚集；召集；推斷；理解
en: to collect things from different places or sources | to come together or bring people together | to understand something from what you hear or observe
example_en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
example_zh: 午飯前，我們把掉落的蘋果收進了籃子。

en: the number equal to four times ten
example_en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
example_zh: 我們等了四十分鐘，公交車才終於到。

zh: 穿過；橫渡；交叉；十字形；十字架；生氣的；惱怒的
en: to go from one side to another, or intersect | a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol | annoyed or slightly angry
example_en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
example_zh: 我們等車輛停下後才過馬路。

zh: 溫暖的；暖和的；熱情的；友好的；使暖和；變暖
en: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot | showing kindness, friendliness, or affection | to become warmer or make something warmer
example_en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example_zh: 這條厚毯子讓我在涼颼颼的夜晚保持暖和。

en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.
example_en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
example_zh: 一位訪客把她的傘落在了我們前門旁。

zh: 加；加上；優點；有利因素；正的；零以上的
en: With something added to an amount or group. | An advantage or positive feature. | Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.
example_en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
example_zh: 房間每晚六十英鎊，早餐另收費。

en: in or to a place that is not specified | approximately, when used before an amount or range
example_en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
example_zh: 我把鑰匙落在沙發附近的某個地方了。

en: at the present time
example_en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
example_zh: 我們的廚房目前堆滿了搬家用的箱子。

en: Completely, with nothing left out.
example_en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
example_zh: 我把爐子上煮著的湯忘得一乾二淨。

en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases | The small, hard ball used in this sport
example_en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
example_zh: 午飯後，我們在公園打棒球。

zh: 進入；進入權；條目；記錄；參賽作品；參賽者
en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place. | An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work. | A work or person submitted for a competition.
example_en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
example_zh: 今天進入游泳池免費。

zh: 柔軟的；軟的；輕柔的；柔和的；不嚴厲的；心軟的
en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape | gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh | not strict or severe enough
example_en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example_zh: 這條柔軟的毯子讓我在寒冷的夜晚保持溫暖。

en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals | a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation
example_en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
example_zh: 她把一個雞蛋打進了熱煎鍋。

en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things | the group of senior ministers who make major government decisions
example_en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
example_zh: 乾淨杯子放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

en: At a time before now or before another event.
example_en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
example_zh: 我先前在圖書館見過我們的鄰居。

zh: 禮物；贈品；天賦；才能；贈送
en: Something given freely to another person | A natural ability to do something well | To give something to someone as a present
example_en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
example_zh: 姐姐用鮮黃色的紙把禮物包了起來。

en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.
example_en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
example_zh: 開啟之前，它看起來就是一個普通盒子。

en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.
example_en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
example_zh: 我上班出門前會喝一杯加奶咖啡。

en: To a very great degree.
example_en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
example_zh: 湯燙極了，所以我等了一會兒。

zh: 奇怪的；反常的；陌生的；不熟悉的
en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising | Not known or experienced before
example_en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
example_zh: 櫥櫃裡傳出一陣奇怪的聲音。

zh: 一排；一行；划船；爭吵；吵鬧
en: people or things arranged in a straight line | to move a boat through water using oars | a noisy argument or loud disturbance
example_en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
example_zh: 我們在前排找到了兩個空座位。

en: On two occasions. | To double the amount, degree, or size.
example_en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
example_zh: 我檢查了兩次包，卻沒找到鑰匙。

zh: 適合；合心意；使顯得好看；相配；一套西裝；套裝
en: to be convenient or right for someone | to make someone look attractive | matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt
example_en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
example_zh: 明天把預約時間提前一點會更適合你嗎？

zh: 相當；還算；公平地；公正地
en: to a moderate degree, but not very | in a way that treats people equally and reasonably
example_en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
example_zh: 走路回家的路程還算短，一路也很愜意。

zh: 吹；刮；打擊；不幸事件；重擊；擊打
en: to move air, or move because of moving air | an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss | a hard hit with a hand or object
example_en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
example_zh: 一陣冷風把樹葉吹過空蕩蕩的操場。

en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.
example_en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
example_zh: 我們長途步行回來後，爸爸做了一頓熱乎乎的飯。

en: Extremely good or of very high quality.
example_en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
example_zh: 這湯好喝極了，所以我又點了一碗。

zh: 烹調；煮；燒；做飯的人；廚師
en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating | someone who prepares and cooks food
example_en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
example_zh: 天氣變冷時，我通常會煮蔬菜湯。

zh: 遊覽；參觀；巡遊；巡迴演出；巡迴比賽；遊覽；巡迴演出
en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere. | A series of performances or matches held in different places. | To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.
example_en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
example_zh: 我們在導遊帶領下參觀了那座古堡。

zh: 燃燒；燒燬；燒傷；燙傷；燒傷；燙傷
en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire. | To damage skin or other material through heat. | An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.
example_en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
example_zh: 壁爐裡，一小團火靜靜地燃燒著。

en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.
example_en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
example_zh: 我的鞋裡有一顆小石子。

zh: 足球；足球運動；美式橄欖球運動
en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals | an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball
example_en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
example_zh: 我們每週六早上都在公園踢足球。

en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.
example_en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
example_zh: 喂，你把傘落在門邊了！

en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed. | A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.
example_en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
example_zh: 我在床墊上鋪了一條幹淨的床單。

zh: 安靜的；輕聲的；平靜的；不繁忙的；安靜；寧靜
en: making little or no noise | having little activity or excitement | a state with little or no noise
example_en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
example_zh: 孩子們睡著後，屋子裡安靜了下來。

zh: 連衣裙；穿衣；給……穿衣；服裝；衣著
en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt | to put clothes on yourself or someone else | clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion
example_en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
example_zh: 她穿了一條藍色連衣裙去參加姐姐的聚會。

en: the number after eleven and before thirteen
example_en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
example_zh: 這個蛋盒裡有十二枚新鮮雞蛋。

zh: 結合；使聯合；聯合收割機
en: To bring things together or join to form a whole. | A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.
example_en: Combine the flour and butter in a large bowl.
example_zh: 把麵粉和黃油放在一個大碗裡混合。

zh: 涼的；涼爽的；冷靜的；沉著的；變涼；使冷卻
en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way | calm and able to think clearly under pressure | to become or make something less hot
example_en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
example_zh: 一陣涼爽的微風從敞開的廚房窗戶吹了進來。

zh: 適當的；正確的；像樣的；真正的；嚴格意義上的；本身的
en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation. | Real or satisfactory, rather than incomplete or inadequate. | Strictly understood, excluding surrounding or related things.
example_en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
example_zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合適的鞋。

en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know | Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience
example_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
example_zh: 出門前請提醒我帶傘。

en: happening or done most often in a particular situation
example_en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
example_zh: 我們平時坐的窗邊那張桌子已經有人了。

en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.
example_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
example_zh: 我打不開那個封得很緊的罐子。

zh: 抓住；猛地拿取；匆忙吃喝或獲取；吸引注意
en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly | to get food, drink, or something else quickly | to attract someone's attention strongly
example_en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
example_zh: 她抓起雨傘，朝公交車跑去。

en: Small in amount or restricted in range
example_en: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
example_zh: 我們空間有限，所以選一張小一點的沙發吧。

zh: 膠帶；磁帶；錄音帶；用膠帶貼上或固定
en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things. | A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data. | Attach or secure something using sticky tape.
example_en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
example_zh: 我用一條膠帶封好了包裹。

zh: 盤子；碟子；薄板；金屬板；給…鍍上金屬
en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food. | A flat piece of metal or another hard material. | To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.
example_en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
example_zh: 她在我的盤子裡放了一張熱乎乎的薄煎餅。

zh: 美麗的；可愛的；令人愉快的；友善的
en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way | very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind
example_en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
example_zh: 廚房窗邊有一些漂亮的黃色花朵。

zh: 系；綁；打結；領帶；聯絡；關係
en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot | a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar | a connection between people, groups, or places
example_en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
example_zh: 跑出去之前，請先繫好鞋帶。

en: In or relating to the east of an area.
example_en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
example_zh: 我們的酒店俯瞰著島上寧靜的東海岸。

zh: 圓；圓圈；圈子；交際圈；環繞；圈出
en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre. | A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests. | To move around something or draw a ring around it.
example_en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
example_zh: 孩子們在草地上圍坐成一圈。

zh: 有差異；變化；改變；使多樣化
en: To differ or change depending on circumstances. | To change something or introduce different kinds.
example_en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
example_zh: 公交車費會隨乘車距離而變化。

zh: 底部；最下端；臀部；最下面的
en: The lowest part of something. | The part of your body that you sit on. | In the lowest position.
example_en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
example_zh: 我的鑰匙在包的最底下。

zh: 選擇；挑選；可供挑選的一組物品；精選集；選出的事物
en: The process of choosing someone or something | A range of things available to choose from | A group of things chosen from a larger collection
example_en: This little bakery has a wonderful selection of fresh bread.
example_zh: 這家小麵包店有各種很棒的新鮮麵包可供挑選。

en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence
example_en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
example_zh: 如果鍋太燙，請提醒我。

zh: 乾淨的；清潔的；打掃；清洗；清潔無汙染的
en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances. | To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something. | Producing little or no pollution.
example_en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
example_zh: 你旁邊的架子上有乾淨的毛巾。

zh: 傾斜；倚靠；精瘦的；少脂肪的；精簡高效的
en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position. | Having little body fat or containing little fat. | Using few resources while avoiding waste.
example_en: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
example_zh: 她靠著牆，解開了鞋帶。

en: having greater than average height
example_en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
example_zh: 下午，一棵高大的樹為我們的花園遮陰。

zh: 最初的；開始的；姓名首字母；用姓名首字母簽署
en: Happening or existing at the beginning | The first letter of a person's name | To mark a document with the first letters of your names
example_en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
example_zh: 看到價格後，我最初的興奮消退了。

en: used to tell someone you are grateful | words or actions expressing gratitude
example_en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
example_zh: 謝謝你幫我把這些沉重的袋子搬上樓。

en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat. | Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.
example_en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
example_zh: 那些雞在我們的菜地旁刨土。

zh: 關閉；關上；停業；關閉的；不營業的
en: to close something or stop being open for business | closed or not open for business
example_en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
example_zh: 請在雨飄進來之前把窗戶關上。

en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation
example_en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
example_zh: 這雙步行鞋適合走泥濘的林間小路。

zh: 立即的；即時的；最近的；緊鄰的；直接的
en: Happening or needed now, without any delay. | Closest in space, time, or relationship. | Directly connected to something, without anything coming between.
example_en: The leaking pipe needs immediate attention before the kitchen floods.
example_zh: 這根漏水的管子需要立即處理，免得廚房被淹。

zh: 地圖；繪製地圖；標出分佈
en: A drawing showing where places or features are located | To draw or record the position of places or features
example_en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
example_zh: 出發前，我們把地圖鋪在桌上。

en: coming immediately after the third in a sequence | one of four equal parts of a whole
example_en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
example_zh: 我們的公寓在四樓，就在電梯旁邊。

zh: 分開；分配；除；除以；分歧；差距
en: to separate something into parts or share it among people | to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another | a major difference separating people or groups
example_en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
example_zh: 趁大家還沒來，我們先把蛋糕切成小塊吧。

zh: 應該；應當；應該會；按理應當
en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action. | Used with to to express what is likely or expected.
example_en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example_zh: 你應該帶把傘，那些雲看起來很陰沉。

zh: 點頭；點頭示意；點頭；點頭示意
en: to move your head down and up to communicate | a downward and upward head movement expressing a message
example_en: She nodded when I offered her another cup of tea.
example_zh: 我問她是否再來杯茶時，她點了點頭。

zh: 乾的；乾燥的；使變幹；變幹；枯燥的；乏味的
en: not wet or containing very little moisture | to remove moisture or become free from moisture | not interesting or entertaining
example_en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
example_zh: 毛巾在陽光下晾過後已經幹了。

zh: 游泳池；水塘；共同儲備；備用資源；集中共用；合夥出資
en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water | A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use | To combine resources so people can use them together
example_en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
example_zh: 我們整個下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

zh: 攀登；爬；上升；增加；攀登；上升
en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands | to increase in amount or level | an act of moving upwards or an increase in level
example_en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
example_zh: 我們爬上山坡，然後停下來野餐。

zh: 甜的；親切的；貼心的；糖果
en: Having a taste like sugar or honey. | Kind, gentle, or thoughtful. | A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.
example_en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example_zh: 這些草莓已經夠甜了，不加糖也好吃。

en: A room used mainly for sleeping.
example_en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
example_zh: 我的臥室早晨陽光很充足。

zh: 消失；不見；失蹤；不復存在；滅絕
en: To become impossible to see or find. | To stop existing.
example_en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
example_zh: 我們看著小船消失在濃霧中。

en: To suggest someone or something as a good choice. | To advise someone that a particular action would be beneficial.
example_en: Can you recommend a quiet café near the station?
example_zh: 你能推薦一家車站附近安靜的咖啡館嗎？

en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds. | To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.
example_en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
example_zh: 她出門前把水瓶裝滿了。

en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day | to eat a meal around midday
example_en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
example_zh: 我們在河邊的一棵樹下吃了午飯。

en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice. | A loud call or cry made with the voice.
example_en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
example_zh: 我們朝河對岸大喊，卻沒有人聽見。

zh: 最喜歡的；最喜愛的人或物；奪冠熱門
en: Liked or preferred more than others | A person or thing someone likes best | A competitor considered most likely to win
example_en: This blue sweater is my favorite winter item.
example_zh: 這件藍色毛衣是我冬天最喜歡的一件衣服。

zh: 轉移；調動；轉賬；轉車；轉學；轉移；調動；轉賬
en: To move someone or something from one place to another. | To change to another vehicle, school, or institution. | The act of moving something or someone to another place.
example_en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
example_zh: 請把相機裡的照片傳到我的膝上型電腦上。

en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like | Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more
example_en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
example_zh: 我們花了一下午探訪港口附近的狹窄街巷。

zh: 直的；筆直的；徑直；直接；坦誠的；直率的
en: not curved or bent | directly, without turning or stopping | honest and clear rather than hiding the truth
example_en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
example_zh: 用尺子畫一條直線。

en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.
example_en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
example_zh: 那位運動員在早上的比賽前伸展了雙腿。

en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree
example_en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
example_zh: 我完全忘了帶泳衣。

zh: 口袋；把…放入口袋；私吞；袖珍的
en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things. | To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly. | Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.
example_en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
example_zh: 我在外套口袋裡找到了丟失的鑰匙。

en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday
example_en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
example_zh: 我們通常星期五在家一起做晚飯。

zh: 薄的；細的；瘦的；使稀疏；變稀薄
en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces. | Having little body fat or flesh. | To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.
example_en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
example_zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面覺得冷。

en: At the side of someone or something.
example_en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
example_zh: 請把你的溼靴子放在門旁邊。

en: Often or many times
example_en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
example_zh: 鄰居經常給我們送來她園子裡種的蔬菜。

zh: 正確地；恰當地；充分地；徹底地
en: In the correct or suitable way. | Completely or to the degree that is needed.
example_en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
example_zh: 冬天廚房的門總是關不嚴。

en: To some extent, but not completely.
example_en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
example_zh: 小路上有一部分被落葉覆蓋了。

en: in or to another place
example_en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
example_zh: 這家咖啡館坐滿了，我們去別處吃吧。

zh: 兩倍的；雙份的；加倍；使翻倍；兩倍；雙倍量
en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity | become twice as much, or make something twice as much | an amount that is twice as large as another
example_en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
example_zh: 我午飯點了雙份米飯。

zh: 空的；無人的；倒空；清空；空洞的；無誠意的
en: Containing nothing or having no people inside. | To remove everything from a container or place. | Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.
example_en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
example_zh: 我開啟餅乾盒時，裡面已經空了。

zh: 一戶；同住的一家人；家庭的；家用的
en: all the people who live together in one home | relating to a home and its everyday needs
example_en: Everyone in our household takes turns washing the dishes.
example_zh: 我們家每個人都輪流洗碗。

zh: 導遊；嚮導；指南；入門書；引導；指導
en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit | a book or resource giving useful information or instructions | to show someone the way or help them decide
example_en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
example_zh: 導遊帶我們穿過市場裡狹窄的街道。

zh: 寂靜；沉默；使安靜；壓制言論
en: a lack of sound or speech | to stop someone or something making noise or expressing opinions
example_en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
example_zh: 外面下著雪，我們靜靜地坐著。

zh: 安全的；穩固的；獲得；爭取到；固定；使安全
en: Protected from danger, or firmly fixed in place. | To successfully obtain something important. | To fasten something firmly or protect it from harm.
example_en: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing up.
example_zh: 爬上去之前，檢查梯子是否穩固。

en: the number equal to six times ten
example_en: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
example_zh: 我爺爺滿六十歲時，辦了一次野餐來慶祝。

zh: 緩慢的；耗時的；減速；使放慢；鐘錶走得慢的
en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed. | To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so. | Showing a time earlier than the correct time.
example_en: We took a slow walk along the river.
example_zh: 我們沿著河邊慢慢散步。

zh: 旅行；行程；發展歷程；旅行
en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another | a process of personal change or development over time | to travel from one place to another
example_en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
example_zh: 這趟火車旅程帶我們穿過了白雪覆蓋的群山。

zh: 黃色的；黃色；變黃；使變黃
en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | to become yellow or make something yellow
example_en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
example_zh: 她挑了一把黃色雨傘，準備在雨中散步。

zh: 影子；陰影；跟隨觀察；跟崗學習
en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light. | To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.
example_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
example_zh: 貓在陽光照著的廚房地板上追逐自己的影子。

zh: 艱難地做；努力爭取；掙扎；搏鬥；艱難的努力；鬥爭
en: To try very hard to do something difficult. | To fight or move forcefully against someone or something. | A difficult effort to achieve something or overcome opposition.
example_en: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
example_zh: 我費力地把那些沉重的袋子提上樓梯。

en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday
example_en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
example_zh: 我們通常在星期一去市場買新鮮水果。

zh: 隊長；船長；機長；擔任隊長；率領；陸軍上尉；海軍上校
en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel. | To lead a team or command a ship. | An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.
example_en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
example_zh: 決賽前，我們的隊長把全隊召集到一起。

en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.
example_en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
example_zh: 我不再坐公交車上學了。

zh: 逃跑；逃脫；避開；免遭；逃脫；解脫
en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation | to avoid something unpleasant or harmful | the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions
example_en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
example_zh: 我們的兔子從圍欄的一處小縫隙逃走了。

zh: 舒適的；舒服的；自在的；安心的；生活寬裕的
en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort | feeling relaxed and confident in a situation | having enough money to live well without financial worry
example_en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
example_zh: 這把柔軟的椅子很舒服，足以讓人午睡一會兒。

zh: 兩者中無一的；兩者都不；也不
en: not one or the other of two | not either of two people or things | used to add another negative statement
example_en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
example_zh: 兩件夾克都不合身，所以我會繼續挑選。

zh: 厚的；粗的；濃密的；濃重的；黏稠的
en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces | having many things close together or being difficult to see through | flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream
example_en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
example_zh: 她把一條厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

zh: 狹窄的；有限的；勉強的；縮小；變窄
en: having little distance from one side to the other | limited in range or achieved by only a small margin | to become or make something less wide or extensive
example_en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
example_zh: 這條狹窄的小路只容得下我們排成一列走。

en: Tell someone what you think they should do | Officially give someone information about something
example_en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
example_zh: 醫生建議我休息幾天。

zh: 結合；組合；密碼鎖的密碼
en: two or more things joined or used together | a sequence used to open a lock
example_en: This soup has a delicious combination of herbs and vegetables.
example_zh: 這道湯把香草與蔬菜搭配得十分美味。

en: to need someone's help or depend on something | to trust someone or something to act as expected
example_en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
example_zh: 我靠腳踏車通勤。

zh: 感激；欣賞；賞識；理解；意識到
en: Feel grateful for something someone has done. | Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something. | Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.
example_en: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
example_zh: 非常感謝你在我不在的時候幫忙給植物澆水。

zh: 環境；場所；背景；設定；檔位；寶石鑲座
en: The place and conditions in which something happens. | A position or option controlling how a device works. | The metal structure that holds a gemstone in jewellery.
example_en: The lakeside garden provides a peaceful setting for lunch.
example_zh: 湖邊的花園為午餐提供了寧靜的環境。

zh: 上面的；上部的；較高的；上層的
en: Located above another part or nearer the top. | Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.
example_en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
example_zh: 把備用毯子放在上層架子上。

zh: 準備好的；有準備的；願意的
en: Ready to deal with something because of previous planning. | Willing to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.
example_en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
example_zh: 備用電池已經備好，我們做好了應對停電的準備。

zh: 忙碌的；繁忙的；人來車往的；佔線的
en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied. | Full of people, traffic, or activity. | Already being used, especially a telephone line.
example_en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
example_zh: 我現在正忙著做晚餐要喝的湯。

zh: 混合；拌和；混合物；組合；交往；相處
en: To combine different substances or things. | A combination of different substances, people, or things. | To spend time socially with other people.
example_en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
example_zh: 把麵粉和雞蛋放進大碗裡拌勻。

zh: 醒來；喚醒；航跡；尾流；守靈聚會
en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping | the disturbed water left behind a moving boat | a gathering to remember someone who has recently died
example_en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
example_zh: 請在你出門上班前叫醒我。

en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers
example_en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
example_zh: 太陽還沒升起，我們就到了機場。

en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action | used to emphasize that we do something, not others
example_en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
example_zh: 我們看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

zh: 棕色的；褐色的；棕色；褐色；使變褐色；變褐色
en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood. | The colour of chocolate or dark wood. | To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.
example_en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
example_zh: 一隻棕色的小狗正在門邊睡覺。

en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons
example_en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
example_zh: 他在面試前熨好了自己的藍襯衫。

zh: 小心的；謹慎的；仔細的；細緻的
en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes | giving close attention to details
example_en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
example_zh: 小心拿那個碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

zh: 好看的；有魅力的；有吸引力的
en: Pleasant to look at | Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something
example_en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
example_zh: 玫瑰盛開時，這座花園顯得格外美麗。

zh: 滑倒；滑落；悄悄移動；迅速塞入；小紙片；小錯誤
en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position. | To move or put something somewhere quietly or quickly. | A small piece of paper, or a minor mistake.
example_en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
example_zh: 我在溼地板上滑了一下，但沒有摔倒。

en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.
example_en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
example_zh: 我們把生肉和蔬菜分開放在冰箱裡。

zh: 獲勝者；優勝者；成功的人或事物；受益者
en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation
example_en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
example_zh: 獲勝者舉起獎盃，人群歡呼起來。

en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops | the large round ball used in this game
example_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
example_zh: 放學後，我們在公園打籃球。

en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs
example_en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
example_zh: 我祖父每週日都和朋友打高爾夫球。

zh: 鏈條；鏈子；連鎖店；一連串；用鏈條拴住
en: a series of connected metal rings | connected shops, events, or other things forming a series | to fasten someone or something with a chain
example_en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
example_zh: 他用一條沉重的金屬鏈鎖好了腳踏車。

en: to hit something with your foot | an act of hitting something with your foot
example_en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
example_zh: 她輕輕地把球踢向弟弟。

en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.
example_en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
example_zh: 我們在村裡的酒館喝了蔬菜湯。

en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold. | Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.
example_en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
example_zh: 麵包在烤箱裡烤了二十分鐘後變成了金黃色。

en: an act of asking politely or formally for something | to ask politely or formally for something
example_en: The hotel agreed to my request for extra pillows.
example_zh: 酒店答應了我多要幾個枕頭的請求。

en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids | to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball
example_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example_zh: 她雙手捧著一碗湯取暖。

zh: 框；框架；骨架；給……裝框；組織表達；構思
en: a structure that surrounds or supports something | to put a picture or similar object inside a frame | to express or present something in a particular way
example_en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
example_zh: 我們為全家福選了一個木製相框。

en: Forward or out from a place.
example_en: The kitten ran back and forth across the kitchen.
example_zh: 小貓在廚房裡來回跑。

zh: 典型的；有代表性的；一貫的；特有的
en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation | showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone
example_en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
example_zh: 平常的工作日都是從吃早餐和散步開始的。

en: Not including a particular person or thing. | Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.
example_en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
example_zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。

en: During the same time or while something else is happening.
example_en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
example_zh: 湯正在慢燉；趁這會兒，我來準備甜點。

zh: 固定；繫上；附上；賦予；認為具有
en: Join or fasten something to something else | Consider something to have a particular value or importance
example_en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
example_zh: 把這個小鈴鐺裝在腳踏車的車把上。

zh: 修理；解決；固定；安裝；確定；安排
en: Make something work properly or solve a problem. | Attach something firmly in a particular place. | Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.
example_en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
example_zh: 鄰居幫我修好了廚房裡壞掉的水龍頭。

en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image. | Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.
example_en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
example_zh: 他離開前照鏡子檢查了一下頭髮。

zh: 洗；清洗；沖走；沖刷；洗滌；清洗
en: To clean something using water, often with soap. | To carry or move something through flowing water. | An act of cleaning with water.
example_en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
example_zh: 幫忙準備晚餐前，請先洗手。

zh: 聰明的；明智的；整潔時髦的；智慧的
en: intelligent or showing good judgment | neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion | using computer technology to perform tasks automatically
example_en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
example_zh: 用那個辦法修好架子真聰明。

en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
example_en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居經常抱怨交通噪聲。

zh: 撕破；扯開；眼淚；裂口；破洞
en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling. | A drop of liquid that comes from your eye. | A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.
example_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
example_zh: 小心別把紙袋撕破了。

zh: 秘密的；保密的；秘密；秘訣；訣竅
en: Kept hidden from people who should not know. | Information known only to a limited group of people. | An important way of achieving a particular result.
example_en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
example_zh: 我們悄悄為祖父母策劃了一次野餐。

zh: 外部的；外面的；來自外部的
en: Located on the outside of something. | Coming from outside a particular organisation, system, or situation.
example_en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
example_zh: 建築工人把外牆刷成了淡黃色。

zh: 錦標賽；冠軍稱號；冠軍地位
en: a competition to decide the best player or team | the position or title of being a champion
example_en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
example_zh: 我們校隊打進了錦標賽的決賽。

en: A large container for holding liquids or gases. | A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.
example_en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
example_zh: 魚游到了水族箱裡的一塊石頭後面。

en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body. | A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes. | To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.
example_en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
example_zh: 這些舊鐵門太重，抬不起來。

zh: 到一旁；在旁邊；暫且不論；留著備用；旁白；低聲插話；題外話
en: to or at one side, away from the main position | away from current consideration or use | a quiet remark or comment outside the main conversation
example_en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
example_zh: 她走到一旁，讓騎腳踏車的人過去。

zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方；在某處；在任何一處
en: in or to any place | in any place, used in questions and negative statements
example_en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
example_zh: 在這個房間裡，你想坐哪兒都行。

en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young. | Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.
example_en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
example_zh: 我往麥片上倒了些冷牛奶。

zh: 樂趣；快樂；有趣的；令人愉快的
en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience. | Enjoyable and entertaining.
example_en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們一起堆沙堡，玩得特別開心。

zh: 在……下面；有失身份；不值得；在下方
en: In or to a position directly below something. | Considered too low in status or value for someone. | In or to a lower position.
example_en: Our cat slept beneath the table during dinner.
example_zh: 我們吃晚飯時，貓在桌子下面睡覺。

zh: 倒；灌；傾注；下傾盆大雨；湧入；湧出
en: To make liquid flow from a container. | To rain very heavily. | To move or arrive continuously in large quantities.
example_en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
example_zh: 她把溫牛奶倒進一個藍色的大杯子裡。

zh: 灰色的；灰白的；灰色；頭髮變灰白
en: Having a colour between black and white. | The colour between black and white. | Develop grey hair as you get older.
example_en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
example_zh: 一隻灰貓正在窗臺上睡覺。

zh: 攪拌；激起；喚起；轟動；騷動
en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around. | To cause a strong feeling or reaction. | Excitement or surprise caused by an event or action.
example_en: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
example_zh: 輕輕攪拌湯，免得粘鍋。

zh: 陪同；陪伴；伴隨；與……同時發生；為……伴奏
en: Go somewhere with someone. | Exist or happen together with something else. | Play music to support a singer or another musician.
example_en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
example_zh: 明天姐姐會陪我去診所。

en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky
example_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
example_zh: 遺憾的是，麵包店的新鮮麵包已經賣完了。

zh: 警告；提醒；預兆；警示訊號
en: Something said or done to alert someone to danger or problems. | A sign that something harmful or unpleasant may happen.
example_en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
example_zh: 聽到嚮導提醒岩石溼滑後，我們折返了。

zh: 較小的；次要的；輕微的；未成年人；小調的
en: Not very serious, important, or large. | A person younger than the legal age of adulthood. | Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.
example_en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
example_zh: 這輛腳踏車只需要稍作修理。

zh: 高度；身高；離地高度；海拔；頂峰；最盛時期
en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is | the distance of something above the ground or sea | the time when something is strongest or most successful
example_en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
example_zh: 她調節了椅子的高度，讓雙腳能夠踩到地面。

zh: 理想的；最合適的；理想；理想標準
en: perfect or the best possible for a particular purpose | a belief or standard of perfection someone aims to achieve
example_en: This quiet corner is ideal for reading after lunch.
example_zh: 這個安靜的角落最適合午飯後看書。

zh: 胡椒粉；胡椒；甜椒；辣椒；使佈滿；大量加入
en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour. | A hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or hot. | To cover or fill something with many small things.
example_en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
example_zh: 能把胡椒粉遞給我，讓我加到湯裡嗎？

zh: 糟糕的；令人不快的；可怕的；嚴重的
en: Very bad or unpleasant. | Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.
example_en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
example_zh: 湯很難喝，於是我做了個三明治。

zh: 實用建議；竅門；尖端；末端；小費
en: a useful piece of advice | the narrow or pointed end of something | extra money given to someone for providing a service
example_en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
example_zh: 鄰居分享了一個種番茄的實用竅門。

zh: 盤；碟；一道菜；菜餚；餐具（複數）
en: A container used for serving or cooking food. | Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal. | Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.
example_en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
example_zh: 請把草莓放進那個藍色盤子裡。

zh: 冠軍；擁護者；捍衛者；支援；捍衛
en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone who strongly supports a cause or group | to actively support or defend a cause or person
example_en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
example_zh: 新冠軍雙手舉起了獎盃。

en: in, at, or to all places
example_en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
example_zh: 我們到處找，結果小貓就在沙發底下。

zh: 灰色的；灰白的；灰色；陰沉的；陰鬱的
en: having a colour between black and white | the colour between black and white | dark and cloudy, or lacking cheerfulness
example_en: My grandfather wears a gray coat every winter.
example_zh: 我祖父每年冬天都穿一件灰色外套。

en: At a later time, following an event.
example_en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
example_zh: 我們看了一部電影，之後吃了晚飯。

zh: 開關；轉換；改變；轉換；改變
en: A device used to turn equipment on or off. | To change from one thing to another. | A change from one thing to another.
example_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
example_zh: 電燈開關就在廚房門後。

zh: 趕緊；匆忙做；匆忙；繁忙時段；一陣強烈感受
en: to move or do something very quickly, often without care | a state of hurry or a period of intense activity | a sudden strong feeling or flow of something
example_en: I rushed downstairs when I heard the doorbell.
example_zh: 聽到門鈴聲，我趕緊跑下了樓。

zh: 敲；敲擊；碰撞；撞倒；敲擊聲；撞擊
en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound | to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall | a sound or blow caused by hitting something
example_en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
example_zh: 進來之前請先敲門。

zh: 專門地；特意地；明確地；具體而言
en: for one particular purpose, person, or group | in a clear and exact way | used to introduce more precise details
example_en: I bought this small brush specifically for cleaning bottles.
example_zh: 我買這把小刷子是專門用來清洗瓶子的。

en: At a fast speed or within a short time.
example_en: Dark clouds spread rapidly across the sky before lunch.
example_zh: 午飯前，烏雲迅速佈滿天空。

zh: 相隔；分開；成碎片；散開；除外
en: separated by distance or time; not together | into separate pieces | except for something being considered
example_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
example_zh: 我們把這些小樹間隔兩米種下。

en: Only just; almost not | No more than a small amount or a particular limit
example_en: I could barely hear her above the heavy rain.
example_zh: 雨聲太大，我幾乎聽不清她說話。

zh: 大量；充足；很；足夠地；富足；豐裕
en: Enough or more than enough of something. | To a sufficient degree or a large extent. | A state in which resources are abundant.
example_en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
example_zh: 剩下的湯足夠大家喝。

en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday
example_en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
example_zh: 我們每週三在圖書館附近一起吃午飯。

zh: 永久的；長期不變的；長期僱用的；正式的
en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time. | Employed without a fixed end date.
example_en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
example_zh: 滾燙的鍋在桌上留下了無法去除的印痕。

en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example_en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
example_zh: 一個巨大的南瓜佔滿了廚房桌上的籃子。

zh: 巨大的；厚重的；大量的；程度極大的
en: Extremely large, heavy, or solid. | Extremely great in amount, extent, or degree.
example_en: A massive oak tree shades our entire garden.
example_zh: 一棵巨大的橡樹為我們整個花園遮陰。

zh: 奇怪的；不尋常的；奇數的；偶爾的；零星的
en: Strange or different from what is expected. | Not divisible by two without a remainder. | Occasional rather than regular or frequent.
example_en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱裡傳出一股怪味。

en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere | using a particular method, system, or person
example_en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
example_zh: 我們途經一個山間小村莊，前往海岸。

zh: 奶油；乳脂；護膚霜；藥膏；奶油色的；淡黃色的
