en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food. | A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment. | Having a pale yellowish-white colour.
example_en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
example_zh: 她把新鮮奶油澆在一碗草莓上。

zh: 通常；一般；典型地；具有代表性地
en: In most cases or on most occasions. | In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.
example_en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居通常在早餐前遛狗。

en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration
example_en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
example_zh: 走到陽光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

en: the meal you eat at the start of the day
example_en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
example_zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交車。

zh: 味道；味覺；品嚐；嚐起來；品味；喜好
en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it. | To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour. | Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.
example_en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
example_zh: 這湯有濃郁的烤番茄味。

zh: 幾乎；實際上；以虛擬方式；線上地
en: Almost completely, or in every important practical way. | Using computers rather than being physically present.
example_en: The fridge was virtually empty when we got home.
example_zh: 我們到家時，冰箱裡幾乎空了。

zh: 鋒利的；尖的；急劇的；顯著的；敏銳的；機敏的
en: Having an edge or point that cuts or pierces easily. | Sudden and large in degree or amount. | Quick to notice, understand, or respond to things.
example_en: This knife is sharp enough to slice tomatoes easily.
example_zh: 這把刀足夠鋒利，切番茄很輕鬆。

zh: 完美地；毫無差錯地；完全；十分
en: In a way that has no faults or mistakes. | Completely; used to emphasize a description.
example_en: The new curtains match our sofa perfectly.
example_zh: 新窗簾和我們的沙發非常相配。

en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.
example_en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
example_zh: 這根胡蘿蔔的形狀很特別，像一隻小手。

zh: 住處；住宿；和解；遷就性安排
en: a place where someone can live or stay | an arrangement that meets different needs or settles a disagreement
example_en: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
example_zh: 去年夏天，我們在海灘附近找到了便宜的住處。

zh: 新增；增加；加法；新增事物
en: the act of putting something extra into something | the process of finding the total of quantities | something extra that joins an existing group or collection
example_en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
example_zh: 加入新鮮檸檬後，湯變得十分美味。

zh: 較低的；較下方的；降低；放下
en: below something else in position, level, or amount | to move something down or reduce its level
example_en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
example_zh: 把重碗放在下面那層架子上。

zh: 缺陷；故障；過錯；責任；斷層
en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character | Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened | A break in rock where sections have moved apart
example_en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天一個小小的電路故障讓洗衣機停止了運轉。

zh: 差勁地；糟糕地；嚴重地；非常；迫切地
en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable | To a serious or harmful degree | Very much, especially when wanting or needing something
example_en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
example_zh: 房間太熱，我睡得很不好。

en: for all future time | very often, especially in an annoying way
example_en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
example_zh: 我希望這些陽光明媚的午後能永遠持續下去。

zh: 包裹；纏繞；披肩；圍巾；捲餅
en: to cover something by folding material around it | a loose piece of clothing worn around the shoulders | a thin flat bread rolled around a filling
example_en: She wrapped the birthday present in bright yellow paper.
example_zh: 她用鮮黃色的紙包好了生日禮物。

en: The work done to get ready for something.
example_en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
example_zh: 孩子們幫忙時，準備晚飯反而要花更長時間。

en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.
example_en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
example_zh: 我在熱乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些乳酪。

en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked
example_en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
example_zh: 剛出爐的麵包放在廚房窗邊晾涼。

en: To change, or make something different. | To change clothing so that it fits better.
example_en: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
example_zh: 你能改一下這條褲子，讓它更合身嗎？

en: Not often; on very few occasions.
example_en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
example_zh: 天氣轉冷時，我們很少在戶外吃飯。

zh: 拖；拉；緩慢進行；拖沓；阻力；拖累
en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort. | To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring. | A force or influence that slows movement or progress.
example_en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
example_zh: 我們拖著沉重的地毯穿過房間。

en: to own or have something | to have a particular quality, ability, or characteristic
example_en: My uncle possesses a remarkable collection of antique clocks.
example_zh: 我叔叔擁有一批令人驚歎的古董鍾藏品。

zh: 打擾；使煩惱；費心；花工夫；麻煩；煩擾
en: to interrupt, annoy, or worry someone | to make the effort to do something | trouble or effort that causes inconvenience
example_en: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
example_zh: 你姐姐學習時，請不要打擾她。

zh: 外套；大衣；覆蓋層；塗層；給…塗上一層
en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection | a layer of paint or another covering substance | cover a surface with a layer of something
example_en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
example_zh: 把你的溼外套掛在廚房門邊。

zh: 大量地；很大程度上；沉重地；猛烈地
en: To a great degree or in large amounts. | With great weight, force, or effort.
example_en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
example_zh: 我們等公交車時，雨下得很大。

en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres | to move very slowly over a short distance
example_en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
example_zh: 這個架子比櫥櫃寬一英寸。

zh: 沉默的；不說話的；無聲的；寂靜的；不發音的
en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak. | Making no sound or containing no noise. | Written in a word but not pronounced.
example_en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
example_zh: 妹妹解釋問題時，他一直沒有說話。

en: an amount of material covering a surface or another amount | to arrange things in sheets or levels over each other
example_en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
example_zh: 架子上覆蓋著薄薄的一層灰塵。

zh: 遞送；交付；分娩；演講方式；表達方式
en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone | the process of giving birth to a baby | the way someone speaks or performs in public
example_en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
example_zh: 我們訂購的食品雜貨在開始做飯前剛好送到了。

zh: 細繩；線；琴絃；一串；一連串
en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things. | A stretched wire or thread that produces musical sounds. | A series of connected things or events.
example_en: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
example_zh: 我用一根細繩把包裹綁好了。

zh: 輕聲地；安靜地；悄悄地；不張揚地
en: with little or no noise | without attracting attention or making something widely known
example_en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
example_zh: 請輕輕關門，寶寶正在睡覺。

zh: 滑動；使滑行；幻燈片；滑梯
en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting | a single image or page shown during a presentation | a sloping structure that children slide down
example_en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
example_zh: 她把盤子沿著桌面推滑到我面前。

zh: 靴子；汽車後備箱；啟動電腦
en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg | the enclosed storage space at the back of a car | to start a computer and load its operating system
example_en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
example_zh: 我的靴子讓雙腳在雨中保持乾爽。

zh: 一部分；一份食物；分配；把食物分份
en: A part or share of something larger. | An amount of food served to one person. | To divide food into amounts for different people.
example_en: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
example_zh: 我們花園裡有很大一部分處於陰涼處。

zh: 瞥一眼；匆匆看；一瞥；匆匆一看
en: To look at someone or something very briefly. | A quick, brief look at someone or something.
example_en: She glanced out of the window before opening the door.
example_zh: 她開門前往窗外瞥了一眼。

zh: 彎曲；使彎曲；彎腰；彎身；彎道；轉彎處
en: To become curved or make something curved. | To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist. | A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.
example_en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
example_zh: 輕輕彎曲鐵絲，做成一個小鉤子。

zh: 與……不同；不像；非……一貫的表現
en: different from someone or something | not typical of someone's usual behaviour
example_en: Unlike her brother, Lina enjoys getting up early.
example_zh: 莉娜和她哥哥不同，她喜歡早起。

en: sometimes, but not often or regularly
example_en: We occasionally buy fresh bread from the market.
example_zh: 我們偶爾會在市場買新鮮麵包。

zh: 輕柔地；溫和地；平緩地；緩緩地
en: In a soft, careful, or kind way. | With a gradual slope or a small, smooth movement.
example_en: She gently lifted the kitten out of the basket.
example_zh: 她輕輕地把小貓從籃子裡抱了出來。

en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed | a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly | a small section of someone's hair
example_en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
example_zh: 上樓前請把後門鎖好。

zh: 相反的；對面的；在…對面；相反的人或事物
en: completely different, or on the other side | facing someone or something from the other side | someone or something completely different from another
example_en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
example_zh: 我們離開車站，朝相反的方向走去。

en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.
example_en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
example_zh: 我們把沉重的行李箱沿著狹窄的樓梯搬了上去。

en: A small house, usually in the countryside.
example_en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
example_zh: 他們的鄉間小屋有一個種滿玫瑰的小花園。

zh: 鍋；盆；罐；壺；把植物栽入盆中
en: A deep container used for cooking food. | A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks. | To put a plant into a container with soil.
example_en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
example_zh: 湯在一口大鍋裡咕嘟咕嘟地輕輕翻滾。

zh: 輕微的；少量的；纖瘦的；怠慢；輕視
en: small in amount, degree, or importance | thin and delicately built | to insult someone by ignoring them or showing little respect
example_en: There is a slight scratch on my new phone.
example_zh: 我的新手機上有一道輕微的劃痕。

en: used to greet someone or begin a phone conversation | a greeting spoken when meeting someone
example_en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
example_zh: 你好，你願意坐在我旁邊嗎？

zh: 經常；定期地；均勻地；有規律地
en: often or at repeated intervals | with equal spaces or a consistent pattern
example_en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
example_zh: 我們經常晚飯後沿著河邊散步。

en: something you do regularly, often without thinking
example_en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
example_zh: 早餐前檢視手機已經成了我的習慣。

en: a tool with a handle and blade used for cutting
example_en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
example_zh: 用一把鋒利的刀把麵包切成片。

en: in or to a foreign country
example_en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
example_zh: 我姐姐移居國外，現在住在海邊。

en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins. | Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver. | A medal awarded for second place in a competition.
example_en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
example_zh: 這把小勺子是純銀做的。

en: Something said or done to make people laugh. | To say something funny or not seriously meant.
example_en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
example_zh: 我哥哥講了個笑話，把大家都逗笑了。

en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly
example_en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
example_zh: 一陣突如其來的風把我的帽子吹進了池塘。

en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.
example_en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
example_zh: 我烤了一個土豆，並在裡面填上乳酪。

en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday
example_en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
example_zh: 我們通常週四在家一起吃午飯。

zh: 灰塵；塵土；擦去灰塵；撣灰；撒上少量粉末
en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float. | To remove dust from a surface. | To cover something lightly with a powder.
example_en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
example_zh: 那架舊鋼琴上積了厚厚一層灰。

zh: 夾克；短外套；書籍護封；保護套
en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms. | An outer cover that protects a book or object.
example_en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
example_zh: 我抓起外套，才走進寒冷的室外。

en: Existing in large numbers.
example_en: Numerous birds gathered around the crumbs on our balcony.
example_zh: 許多鳥聚在我們陽臺上的麵包屑周圍。

zh: 不久；馬上；不耐煩地；生硬地
en: After a short amount of time. | In a brief, unfriendly or impatient way.
example_en: The bus will arrive shortly, so get your bag ready.
example_zh: 公交車馬上就到，把你的包準備好。

zh: 到達；到來；新來的人；新到的事物
en: The act of reaching a place. | A person or thing that has recently reached a place.
example_en: Our arrival at the campsite was delayed by heavy rain.
example_zh: 大雨耽誤了我們抵達營地的時間。

en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.
example_en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
example_zh: 這種番茄醬汁配新鮮意麵很好吃。

en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband
example_en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
example_zh: 我叔叔教過我怎樣修腳踏車。

en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately | an affectionate touch made with the lips
example_en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
example_zh: 她上班前輕輕親了親女兒。

en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.
example_en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
example_zh: 新書桌送來之前，先用這張臨時桌子就行。

zh: 看得見的；明顯的；顯而易見的
en: Able to be seen. | Clear enough to be noticed or recognised.
example_en: The mountains were barely visible through the morning mist.
example_zh: 晨霧中，群山依稀可見。

zh: 便帽；鴨舌帽；瓶蓋；保護蓋；限制上限
en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part | a cover fitted over the end or opening of something | to set a maximum amount or level for something
example_en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
example_zh: 他戴上帽子後出門去訓練。

en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat. | To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.
example_en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
example_zh: 午飯後，我們分著吃了一片檸檬蛋糕。

en: liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables
example_en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
example_zh: 她把鮮橙汁擠進了玻璃杯裡。

zh: 每當；每次；無論何時；隨時；究竟什麼時候
en: Every time that something happens. | At any time that something happens or is convenient. | Used in questions to express surprise about when something happened.
example_en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
example_zh: 每當我煮湯時，我的貓就守在爐子旁邊。

zh: 蒼白的；淺色的；暗淡的；微弱的；變蒼白；相形見絀
en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual. | Giving only a weak light. | To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.
example_en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
example_zh: 你臉色蒼白，坐下來喝點水吧。

zh: 欠錢；負債；應給予；欠人情；把……歸功於
en: To have to pay money back to someone. | To have a duty to give someone something. | To have something because of someone's help or another cause.
example_en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
example_zh: 我還欠姐姐買票的錢。

en: slowly over time, rather than all at once
example_en: The sky gradually grew darker as we walked home.
example_zh: 我們走回家時，天色漸漸暗了下來。

zh: 溼的；潮溼的；多雨的；下雨的；弄溼
en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid | Having rain or frequent rainfall | To put water or another liquid onto something
example_en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
example_zh: 我踩進水坑，把襪子弄溼了。

en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday
example_en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
example_zh: 我們通常在星期二晚上一起吃飯。

en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.
example_en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
example_zh: 我在蔬菜湯里加了些豆子。

en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.
example_en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
example_zh: 我們安排了從機場到酒店的接送。

zh: 氣味；嗅覺；聞到；嗅；有……氣味
en: a quality sensed through the nose, or that sensing ability | notice or examine something using your nose | have or give off a particular scent
example_en: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
example_zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫在我們的廚房裡。

en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work
example_en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
example_zh: 一位遊客問我怎麼去城堡。

zh: 輕拋；扔；翻動；拌勻；拋；投擲
en: To throw something lightly or without much care. | To turn food over gently to mix or coat it. | An act of throwing something lightly.
example_en: Could you toss me that cushion from the sofa?
example_zh: 你能把沙發上的那個靠墊扔給我嗎？

en: enough or good enough for a particular purpose
example_en: This small heater provides adequate warmth for my bedroom.
example_zh: 這臺小取暖器足以讓我的臥室保持暖和。

zh: 埋；埋葬；掩藏；使埋在下面
en: to put something in the ground and cover it | to hide or cover something beneath other things
example_en: Our dog buried its favourite toy beside the fence.
example_zh: 我們的狗把最喜歡的玩具埋在了籬笆旁。

en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable
example_en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
example_zh: 她切了一個熟番茄，放進乳酪三明治裡。

en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food | to spread butter on food
example_en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
example_zh: 她在一片溫熱的麵包上抹了些黃油。

zh: 迅速的；快速的；急流；險灘
en: Happening or moving very quickly. | A fast, turbulent stretch of river, usually called rapids.
example_en: Her rapid recovery surprised everyone in the family.
example_zh: 她恢復得如此迅速，讓全家人都感到驚訝。

zh: 浴室；衛生間；洗手間；廁所
en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet. | A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.
example_en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
example_zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁掛了一條幹淨毛巾。

en: Something made by combining two or more different things.
example_en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
example_zh: 攪拌混合物，直到它變得順滑綿密。

zh: 玩具；擺弄；漫不經心地考慮
en: An object that children use for play. | To handle casually or consider without serious commitment.
example_en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
example_zh: 寶寶把她的玩具掉到了沙發後面。

zh: 慣例；日常安排；例行的；常規的；一套表演動作
en: A regular way of doing things in a particular order. | Done regularly as part of the usual process. | A planned sequence of movements in a performance.
example_en: A short walk is part of my morning routine.
example_zh: 短距離散步是我每天早晨的固定安排之一。

zh: 粗糙的；不平的；粗略的；大致的；艱難的；動盪的；猛烈的
en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth. | Not exact, detailed, or completely finished. | Difficult to experience, or involving strong, uncontrolled movement or force.
example_en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
example_zh: 粗糙的木長凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。

zh: 光滑的；平整的；順利的；平穩的；使平整；撫平
en: having an even surface without rough areas or bumps | happening without problems, interruptions, or sudden movements | to make a surface even or remove its wrinkles
example_en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
example_zh: 這塊石頭握在手裡又光滑又涼。

en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.
example_en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
example_zh: 我們挪開傢俱，騰出地方跳舞。

zh: 極好的；精彩的；才華出眾的；聰穎的；明亮的；燦爛的
en: Extremely good, impressive, or enjoyable. | Exceptionally intelligent or skilled. | Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.
example_en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
example_zh: 你的絕妙主意為我們省下了好幾個小時的工作。

zh: 腰帶；皮帶；帶狀區域；地帶；傳動帶；輸送帶
en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes | a long area with a particular feature | a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects
example_en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
example_zh: 這條腰帶能防止我的褲子往下滑。

en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.
example_en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
example_zh: 姐姐為我的生日烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。

en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin
example_en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
example_zh: 我裝了一個蘋果和一個三明治當午餐。

zh: 低語；耳語；低語聲；耳語；私下傳聞
en: To speak very quietly without using your full voice | Very quiet speech made without a full voice | A quietly circulated rumour or suggestion
example_en: Please whisper while the baby sleeps in the next room.
example_zh: 寶寶在隔壁睡覺，請小聲說話。

en: made of wood | showing little natural feeling or movement
example_en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
example_zh: 她用木勺慢慢攪拌湯。

zh: 擺動；搖擺；鞦韆；明顯變化；轉變
en: To move backwards and forwards or in a curved path. | A hanging seat that moves backwards and forwards. | A noticeable change in an opinion, mood, or situation.
example_en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
example_zh: 她走在街上，包隨著步伐輕輕擺動。

en: either side of the face below the eyes | rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect
example_en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
example_zh: 在外面，一滴冰涼的雨水落在了我的臉頰上。

zh: 挖；掘；探究；深入搜尋；考古發掘
en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something | Search carefully for hidden information | An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground
example_en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
example_zh: 我們為這棵蘋果樹苗挖了一個深坑。

zh: 速度；節奏；一步；步幅；來回踱步
en: The speed at which someone moves or something happens | A single step taken when walking | To walk repeatedly back and forth, often when worried
example_en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
example_zh: 我們放慢腳步，好讓奶奶跟上。

zh: 預訂；保留；儲備；儲備量；自然保護區
en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose. | A supply kept for use when needed. | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.
example_en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
example_zh: 你能幫我們預訂今晚的餐桌嗎？

zh: 平底鍋；烤盤；嚴厲批評；搖攝；轉動鏡頭
en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food | to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly | to turn a camera slowly across a scene
example_en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
example_zh: 先把鍋裡的油燒熱，再放入洋蔥。

en: A thick woven covering for a floor.
example_en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
example_zh: 我們坐在地毯上打牌。

en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service | to send a letter or parcel through a postal service
example_en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
example_zh: 我們剛吃完早飯，郵件就到了。

en: having a pale red colour | a colour made by mixing red with white
example_en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
example_zh: 我們窗外的樹開著粉紅色的花。

en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space | a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage
example_en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
example_zh: 她把窗簾拉到一邊，看著外面的雨。

zh: 美元；塊錢；雄鹿；雄兔；尥蹶子；弓背跳躍
en: An informal word for a dollar. | A male deer, rabbit, or certain other animals. | For a horse to jump with its back arched.
example_en: I bought this warm scarf for just five bucks.
example_zh: 我只花了五美元就買到了這條暖和的圍巾。

en: The mother of your father or mother.
example_en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
example_zh: 我的祖母在廚房窗臺上種新鮮的香草。

en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets. | A jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.
example_en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
example_zh: 午飯後，我們在公園裡打板球。

en: All the time, or repeatedly with very little interruption.
example_en: My phone constantly buzzes while I am cooking dinner.
example_zh: 我做晚飯時，手機不停地振動。

zh: 幫忙；恩惠；支援；贊同；喜愛；偏愛；支援；有利於
en: something helpful you do for someone | approval, support, or liking for someone or something | to prefer, support, or give an advantage to
example_en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
example_zh: 你能幫我個忙，給我的植物澆水嗎？

zh: 稱……的重量；重量為；權衡；仔細考慮
en: to measure how heavy someone or something is | to have a particular weight | to consider something carefully before making a decision
example_en: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
example_zh: 請先稱一下這些蘋果，再裝進袋子。

en: a line or shape that bends smoothly | to bend smoothly, or make something bend smoothly
example_en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
example_zh: 我們接近一個急彎時，司機放慢了車速。

en: the absence of light
example_en: We searched for the torch in complete darkness.
example_zh: 我們在一片漆黑中尋找手電筒。

zh: 食譜；烹飪方法；促成某結果的方法或因素
en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish | a method or situation likely to produce a particular result
example_en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
example_zh: 這個湯的食譜只需要幾種簡單的食材。

zh: 管；管子；軟管容器；倫敦地鐵
en: a long, hollow object that carries liquids or gases | a soft container squeezed to release paste or cream | the underground railway system in London
example_en: Water flowed through a clear tube into the tank.
example_zh: 水透過一根透明管子流進了水箱。

en: To a large degree or by a large amount.
example_en: Your clear directions greatly helped us find the cottage.
example_zh: 你清楚的指路說明幫了大忙，讓我們找到了那間小屋。

zh: 最喜歡的；最喜愛的人或物；最有望獲勝者
en: liked more than any other of the same kind | a person or thing someone likes best | the competitor considered most likely to win
example_en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
example_zh: 這家小麵包店賣我最喜歡的那種麵包。

zh: 推遲；使耽擱；延誤；耽擱的時間
en: To make something happen later than expected or planned. | A period of waiting before something happens or continues.
example_en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
example_zh: 大雪使我們的航班延誤到第二天早上。

en: Someone's benefit or the purpose behind an action.
example_en: We kept our voices down for the baby's sake.
example_zh: 為了不打擾寶寶，我們壓低了聲音。

zh: 巨大的；巨人；大企業；傑出人物
en: Much larger than usual | An imaginary person of enormous size | A very large company or an exceptionally important person
example_en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
example_zh: 一個巨大的南瓜幾乎佔滿了整輛園藝推車。

zh: 時鐘；測定速度；記錄用時
en: a device that shows the time | to measure or record the time or speed of something
example_en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
example_zh: 我們做午飯時，廚房的時鐘停了。

en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water. | A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.
example_en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
example_zh: 徒步之後，泡個溫水澡讓我放鬆了下來。

zh: 擊敗；戰勝；失敗；失利；挫敗；使落空
en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict | an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict | to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding
example_en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
example_zh: 我們隊在一場激動人心的決賽中擊敗了冠軍隊。

en: to stop briefly before continuing | a short break in an activity or speech
example_en: She paused at the door to check her bag.
example_zh: 她在門口停下來檢查了一下包。

en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell
example_en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
example_zh: 切這個洋蔥又讓我流眼淚了。

en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.
example_en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
example_zh: 我姨媽教會了我如何烤麵包。

zh: 分開；劈開；分擔；裂縫；分裂；分歧
en: To divide something into parts, or separate into groups | A crack, division, or serious disagreement
example_en: We split the cake and shared it with our neighbours.
example_zh: 我們把蛋糕切開，分給了鄰居。

zh: 完全；全然；總共；總的來說
en: completely or entirely | when everything or everyone is counted | when considering everything
example_en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
example_zh: 我們徹底不再去那家擁擠的咖啡館了。

zh: 有幫助的；有用的；樂於助人的
en: Making something easier to do or understand. | Willing to help other people.
example_en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
example_zh: 我們遊覽村莊時，你的地圖幫了大忙。

zh: 下沉；使沉沒；洗滌槽；水槽；下降；減弱
en: To move below a surface, or make something do this. | A fixed basin with taps and a drain for washing. | To fall to a lower level or become weaker.
example_en: The little toy boat sank beneath the bathwater.
example_zh: 那隻小玩具船沉到了洗澡水下面。

en: one of the foods used to prepare a dish | one of the things needed to achieve a particular result
example_en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
example_zh: 鮮姜是這道湯的主要食材。

zh: 啪地折斷；繃斷；厲聲說；沒好氣地說；拍照；抓拍
en: To break suddenly with a short, sharp sound. | To speak suddenly in an angry or impatient way. | To take a photograph quickly.
example_en: The dry twig snapped when I stepped on it.
example_zh: 我踩到那根幹樹枝時，它啪的一聲斷了。

zh: 裝備；用具；齒輪；擋位；使適合；使面向
en: equipment or clothing needed for a particular activity | a toothed wheel, or a setting controlling vehicle speed | to design or organise something for a particular purpose
example_en: We packed our camping gear into the car.
example_zh: 我們把露營裝備裝進了車裡。

zh: 標籤；標牌；貼標籤於；標註；給…定性；將…歸類
en: a small attached piece giving information about something | to attach information to something for identification | to describe someone or something in a particular way
example_en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
example_zh: 洗新毛衣之前，先看看標籤。

en: time away from work or study for rest or travel | to spend a holiday somewhere away from home
example_en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
example_zh: 我們暑假在湖邊露營。

zh: 非凡的；出色的；異乎尋常的；奇特的
en: Much better or more impressive than usual. | Very unusual or surprising.
example_en: My grandmother has an extraordinary memory for people's birthdays.
example_zh: 我奶奶記別人生日的本領特別出眾。

en: to shout loudly, often from excitement, anger, or fear | a loud shout
example_en: We yelled with excitement when our team finally scored.
example_zh: 我們的球隊終於得分時，我們興奮地大喊起來。

en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar. | An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.
example_en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
example_zh: 他和妹妹分享了一塊巧克力。

en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom | to move quickly and powerfully across an area
example_en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
example_zh: 請在客人到來前把廚房地板掃乾淨。

en: unlikely to change suddenly, fall, or become worse | a building where horses are kept
example_en: The table feels stable now that we tightened its legs.
example_zh: 我們把桌腿擰緊後，桌子現在感覺穩固了。

en: To take and use something with permission, then return it. | To use an idea or word from another source.
example_en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
example_zh: 我能借用一下你的傘，明天早上還嗎？

zh: 相當；還算；通情達理地；合理地；價格公道地
en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree | in a sensible, fair, or logical way | at a fair and affordable price
example_en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
example_zh: 廚房還算乾淨，不過地板需要掃一掃。

zh: 旋轉；使旋轉；紡紗；吐絲；旋轉；帶傾向性的解讀
en: turn quickly around a central point | make thread from fibres or produce silk | a turning movement, or a deliberately favourable interpretation
example_en: The wheel kept spinning after I lifted the bicycle.
example_zh: 我把腳踏車抬起來後，車輪還在轉。

en: A small control you press to operate something | A small object that fastens clothing through a hole | Fasten clothing using buttons
example_en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
example_zh: 按綠色按鈕啟動洗衣機。

en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck | the ringing sound made by a bell
example_en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
example_zh: 一位騎車人靠近時，腳踏車鈴響了。

en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.
example_en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
example_zh: 為我們週末的露營之旅帶些保暖衣物。

zh: 極好的；棒極了的；非常；特別
en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally. | Very or extremely, used informally before adjectives or adverbs.
example_en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
example_zh: 我們在花園裡玩遊戲，度過了一個特別愉快的下午。

zh: 運動場；球場；音高；推介；推銷
en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports. | How high or low a sound is. | Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.
example_en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
example_zh: 儘管下著雨，球員們還是跑進了球場。

zh: 柵欄；圍欄；用柵欄圍住；擊劍
en: A barrier enclosing land or separating areas. | To surround or divide an area with a fence. | To fight with special swords as a sport.
example_en: Our dog watched the neighbours through the wooden fence.
example_zh: 我們的狗透過木柵欄看著鄰居。

zh: 大約；粗略地；粗暴地；粗糙地
en: approximately, rather than exactly | in a forceful, careless, or uneven manner
example_en: The walk to the lake takes roughly twenty minutes.
example_zh: 步行到湖邊大約需要二十分鐘。

zh: 束；串；一群；一幫；聚攏；使聚成一團
en: a group of similar things held or growing together | a group of people, described informally | to gather closely together, or make things gather together
example_en: He brought a bunch of flowers for the kitchen table.
example_zh: 他帶來一束花，準備放在廚房的餐桌上。

en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
example_en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
example_zh: 這湯太難喝了，所以我做了個三明治。

zh: 作出反應；回應；發生化學反應
en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens. | Change chemically when combined with another substance.
example_en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
example_zh: 你姐姐對這場驚喜派對有什麼反應？

zh: 迷路的；丟失的；困惑的；不知所措的；丟失；失去；輸掉
en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found. | Unable to understand something or decide what to do. | Past tense and past participle of lose.
example_en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
example_zh: 我們在老城區步行時迷路了。

zh: 偏遠的；遙遠的；遠端的；極小的；不大可能的
en: Far away from towns, cities, or other people. | Done or controlled from a different location. | Very unlikely to happen.
example_en: They live in a remote village surrounded by mountains.
example_zh: 他們住在一個群山環繞的偏遠村莊。

zh: 度假勝地；訴諸；求助於；應急手段；最後辦法
en: a place people visit for holidays and leisure | to use something undesirable because other options have failed | an option used when other choices are unavailable
example_en: We stayed at a quiet resort beside the lake.
example_zh: 我們住在湖邊一處安靜的度假村。

en: A period or distance between events or objects. | A short break between parts of a performance.
example_en: There was a short interval between the two calls.
example_zh: 兩通電話之間隔了一小會兒。

en: The number after seventeen and before nineteen.
example_en: We baked eighteen muffins for the picnic this morning.
example_zh: 我們今天早上為野餐烤了十八個鬆餅。

zh: 破碎的；斷裂的；壞掉的；失靈的；不流利的；斷續的
en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces. | Not working properly because of damage. | Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.
example_en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
example_zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃掃進簸箕裡。

zh: 打賭；押注；敢肯定；確信；賭注；打賭
en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event | to say confidently that something is true or will happen | an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result
example_en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
example_zh: 我敢說你把鑰匙落在廚房了。

en: Rub a surface to remove dirt, liquid, or marks. | An act of rubbing a surface to clean or dry it. | A small damp cloth used for cleaning, usually thrown away afterwards.
example_en: Please wipe the table before you put the plates down.
example_zh: 請先擦一下桌子，再擺盤子。

en: The activity of looking for and buying things. | The things you have bought during a shopping trip.
example_en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
example_zh: 我們通常在星期六一早去購物。

en: Beside someone or something, or together with them. | In a position beside someone or something.
example_en: I cycled alongside my sister by the river.
example_zh: 我沿著河邊騎車，與姐姐並排而行。

en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean | Loose earth, especially on the ground
example_en: Please wipe the dirt off your shoes before entering.
example_zh: 進來之前，請把鞋上的泥汙擦掉。

en: A small metal projectile fired from a gun. | A symbol introducing an item in a list.
example_en: The museum displays a bullet beside an old rifle.
example_zh: 博物館在一支舊步槍旁陳列著一顆子彈。

en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return. | Give support or add a particular quality to something.
example_en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
example_zh: 你能把雨傘借給我用到明天嗎？

en: A cereal plant whose grains are cooked and eaten.
example_en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
example_zh: 我們晚餐吃了米飯和清蒸魚。

en: by a large amount or to a large degree
example_en: Our new flat is considerably warmer than the old one.
example_zh: 我們的新公寓比舊公寓暖和多了。

zh: 緊的；緊身的；緊張的；餘地很小的；緊緊地；牢牢地
en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move. | Leaving very little extra time, money, or space. | Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.
example_en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
example_zh: 這雙鞋的鞋頭太緊，擠著我的腳趾。

zh: 替代者；替換物；替換；更換
en: A person or thing that takes another's place. | The act of putting someone or something in another's place.
example_en: The shop sent a replacement for my broken kettle.
example_zh: 商店寄來了一個新水壺，替換我壞掉的那個。

en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.
example_en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
example_zh: 她把大部分閒暇時間都花在花園裡。

zh: 條；帶狀物；剝去；除去；剝奪
en: A long, narrow piece or area of something. | To remove a covering or layer from something. | To take away someone's rights, possessions, or position.
example_en: Cut the paper into strips for our craft project.
example_zh: 把紙剪成條，用於我們的手工製作。

en: a competition involving several games between different players or teams
example_en: Our school tennis tournament starts next Saturday morning.
example_zh: 我們學校的網球錦標賽下週六早上開始。

zh: 樸素的；無裝飾的；清楚的；明顯的；平原
en: simple, without decoration or a pattern | easy to see or understand | a large area of flat land
example_en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
example_zh: 她選了一件樸素的白襯衫去參加面試。

zh: 巨大的；極大的；極好的；精彩的
en: Very great in amount, strength, or degree. | Extremely good or enjoyable.
example_en: Moving that heavy sofa upstairs took a tremendous effort.
example_zh: 把那張沉重的沙發搬上樓費了極大的力氣。

en: A passage built underground or through a hill. | To dig a passage underground or through something.
example_en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
example_zh: 火車駛入了山下的一條漆黑隧道。

en: material made by weaving or knitting fibres | the connected parts that form a society or organisation
example_en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
example_zh: 這種柔軟的布料做夏季連衣裙會很舒服。

en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients
example_en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
example_zh: 我往沙拉里加了黃瓜和番茄。

zh: 使滿意；使滿足；符合；滿足要求；使確信
en: to give someone what they want or need | to meet a condition, standard, or requirement | to convince someone that something is true or acceptable
example_en: A bowl of soup was enough to satisfy my hunger.
example_zh: 一碗湯就足以讓我不再飢餓。

zh: 溫柔的；溫和的；輕柔的；不強烈的；坡度平緩的
en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force. | Mild in strength, movement, or effect. | Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.
example_en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
example_zh: 抱起那隻小貓時，動作要輕柔。

zh: 幫忙；善意的舉動；贊同；偏愛；偏愛；支援；有利於
en: Something helpful you do for someone. | Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something. | To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.
example_en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
example_zh: 你能幫我一個忙，給我的植物澆澆水嗎？

zh: 生的；未煮熟的；未加工的；未經處理的；擦痛的；紅腫疼痛的
en: not cooked | in its original state before processing or analysis | sore because the skin is damaged or irritated
example_en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
example_zh: 我更喜歡生胡蘿蔔，因為吃起來很脆。

zh: 愚蠢的；不明智的；滑稽的；逗趣的
en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought | Playfully funny in a way that is not serious
example_en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
example_zh: 把傘留在家裡真是不明智。

en: Recently, especially when describing something just done or begun.
example_en: We ate lunch in the newly opened corner café.
example_zh: 我們在街角新開的咖啡館吃了午飯。

en: A team sport involving carrying, passing, and kicking an oval ball
example_en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
example_zh: 我哥哥每週六都和朋友們打英式橄欖球。

zh: 結冰；冷凍；凍結；暫停；突然僵住
en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid. | To stop something changing or being used temporarily. | To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.
example_en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
example_zh: 把剩下的湯冷凍起來，下週再喝。

en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.
example_en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
example_zh: 孩子們擺餐具時，我烤了些麵包。

zh: 櫃檯；操作檯；反駁；抵制；抵消；相反地；對立地
en: A raised flat surface for serving customers or preparing food | Act or speak against something to reduce its effect | In a direction opposed to something
example_en: I left my shopping bag on the kitchen counter.
example_zh: 我把購物袋放在廚房操作檯上了。

zh: 直到……為止；直到……才；直到；收銀機；現金抽屜
en: up to a particular time | up to the time when something happens | a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash
example_en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
example_zh: 這家小麵包店每天晚上營業到六點。

zh: 水龍頭；輕敲；輕拍；開發利用
en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe | to touch or hit something lightly | to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources
example_en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
example_zh: 刷牙時請關上水龍頭。

en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets
example_en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
example_zh: 我們每逢週日都在公園打網球。

zh: 容易地；輕易地；欣然地；樂意地
en: Easily and without difficulty or delay. | Willingly and without hesitation.
example_en: My sister readily agreed to water the plants.
example_zh: 姐姐欣然答應幫忙給植物澆水。

en: To move through water using your body. | An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.
example_en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
example_zh: 我們每週六早上都在室內泳池游泳。

zh: 使疲倦；感到疲倦；厭倦；失去興趣；輪胎（美式拼寫）
en: To become tired or make someone feel tired | To lose interest in someone or something | A rubber covering fitted around a vehicle's wheel
example_en: Long walks tire my grandfather, so we stop often.
example_zh: 長時間走路會讓爺爺疲倦，所以我們經常停下來。

zh: 鬆動的；未固定的；寬鬆的；不嚴密的；不嚴格的
en: not firmly attached or held in place | not fitting closely around the body | not exact or strictly controlled
example_en: One loose screw made the whole chair feel shaky.
example_zh: 一顆鬆動的螺絲讓整把椅子都搖晃起來。

en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger | Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations
example_en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
example_zh: 天黑後，我們的露營之旅變成了一次冒險。

en: To raise your shoulders to show uncertainty or indifference | A shoulder movement expressing uncertainty or lack of concern
example_en: He shrugged when I asked where the keys were.
example_zh: 我問鑰匙在哪兒時，他聳了聳肩。

zh: 髒的；卑鄙的；不公平的；弄髒；變髒
en: Covered with dirt or other unwanted substances. | Dishonest or unfair, especially when trying to gain an advantage. | To make something dirty or become dirty.
example_en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
example_zh: 請把你的髒靴子放在廚房門外。

en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing
example_en: We finally got rid of the broken garden chairs.
example_zh: 我們終於處理掉了那些壞掉的花園椅子。

en: Move against a surface with pressure, often repeatedly. | An act of pressing and moving against a surface.
example_en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
example_zh: 她在暖氣旁搓著冰冷的雙手。

zh: 令人愉快的；舒適的；友善的；和藹的
en: Enjoyable or comfortable to experience. | Friendly and polite towards other people.
example_en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
example_zh: 我們在河邊愉快地散了步。

zh: 褪色；使褪色；逐漸減弱；逐漸消失
en: to lose colour or make something lose colour gradually | to become weaker, less clear, or less noticeable over time
example_en: The curtains have faded after years of bright sunlight.
example_zh: 窗簾經過多年強烈日曬，已經褪色了。

zh: 假裝；佯裝；假想的；模擬的
en: to act as though something untrue is true | imaginary or artificial, especially as part of children's play
example_en: The children pretended the sofa was a pirate ship.
example_zh: 孩子們把沙發想象成一艘海盜船。

en: the number after fifteen and before seventeen
example_en: We baked sixteen small cakes for the family picnic.
example_zh: 我們為家庭野餐烤了十六個小蛋糕。

en: The act of leaving a place. | A change from what is usual or expected.
example_en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
example_zh: 我們在出發前一晚收拾好了行李。

zh: 穩定的；持續平穩的；穩固的；沉著的；使穩定；穩住
en: Continuing regularly without sudden changes. | Firmly controlled, balanced, or calm. | Make something stable or bring it under control.
example_en: Keep a steady pace as you climb the hill.
example_zh: 上山時保持平穩的步速。

en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food
example_en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
example_zh: 麵包剛出烤箱，還熱乎著。

en: not in or to any place
example_en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
example_zh: 擁擠的火車上沒有地方可坐。

en: happening sometimes, but not often or regularly
example_en: We enjoy an occasional picnic beside the river.
example_zh: 我們喜歡偶爾到河邊野餐。

zh: 接待處；服務檯；招待會；歡迎會；接收效果；反響
en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information | a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone | how well signals are received, or how people respond
example_en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
example_zh: 請在早餐前把房間鑰匙留在前臺。

zh: 擱板；架子；陸架；岩石凸臺
en: A flat board used to support or store things. | A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.
example_en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
example_zh: 把乾淨杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。

en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees
example_en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
example_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，攪拌均勻。

en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings. | A book used to record appointments and future plans.
example_en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
example_zh: 我睡前會寫日記。

en: Continuing without a break or interruption.
example_en: Continuous rain kept us indoors for the whole weekend.
example_zh: 雨一直下，整個週末我們都待在室內。

zh: 修理；修復；修理；維修；補救；修復關係
en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again | Work done to restore something damaged or broken | To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right
example_en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
example_zh: 你能修好我夾克上壞掉的拉鍊嗎？

en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods
example_en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
example_zh: 她的舊皮包摸起來仍然柔軟光滑。

en: The activity of eating a meal
example_en: We moved the dining table closer to the window.
example_zh: 我們把餐桌挪到了更靠近窗戶的地方。

en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.
example_en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
example_zh: 先把大蒜壓碎，再放進湯裡。

en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents. | A soft, silver-coloured metal used to coat other metals.
example_en: There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
example_zh: 櫥櫃裡有一罐豆子。

en: to the degree needed for a particular purpose
example_en: The soup had cooled sufficiently for us to eat.
example_zh: 湯已經涼到我們可以喝的程度了。

en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.
example_en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
example_zh: 這條褲子太長了，我需要把它改短。

en: often or among many people or in many places
example_en: This spice is commonly used in soups and stews.
example_zh: 這種香料常用於湯和燉菜。

zh: 在海外；到國外；海外的；國外的
en: in or to a foreign country | located in, coming from, or relating to foreign countries
example_en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
example_zh: 我表親搬到了國外，每個週末都給我們打電話。

en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.
example_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example_zh: 她雙手捧著一碗湯取暖。

en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another. | To put things together in a heap.
example_en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
example_zh: 一堆髒餐具塞滿了水槽。

zh: 警報；警報器；鬧鐘；驚慌；擔憂；使驚慌；使擔憂
en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you. | A sudden feeling of fear or worry. | To make someone frightened or worried.
example_en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
example_zh: 我的鬧鐘在日出前響了，把全家人都吵醒了。

zh: 裂縫；裂紋；裂開；使破裂；清脆的爆裂聲
en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object | Break or cause something to break without completely separating | A sudden sharp sound, like something breaking
example_en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
example_zh: 我最喜歡的藍色杯子上有一道細細的裂紋。

en: In addition to someone or something. | Used to add another fact or supporting reason.
example_en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
example_zh: 除了蘋果，我們還需要一些麵包和鮮奶。

zh: 筆；鋼筆；動物圍欄；圈；撰寫
en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw. | A small enclosed area where animals are kept. | To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.
example_en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example_zh: 你能借我一支筆填這張表嗎？

zh: 戰士；搏擊選手；奮鬥者；鬥士；戰鬥機
en: a person who fights in battle or combat sports | someone who persists despite difficulties or strongly supports a cause | a fast military aircraft designed to attack other aircraft
example_en: The young fighter practises footwork with her coach every morning.
example_zh: 這位年輕的搏擊選手每天早上都跟教練練習步法。

en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet | a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow
example_en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
example_zh: 我們在一處平緩的雪坡上學會了滑雪。

en: A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.
example_en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
example_zh: 我們把沾滿泥的靴子放在門廊上過了一夜。

zh: 預約；預訂；疑慮；保留意見
en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available. | A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.
example_en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
example_zh: 我預訂了一個靠窗的位置吃晚飯。

en: To look like or be similar to someone or something
example_en: These clouds resemble small boats floating across the sky.
example_zh: 這些雲朵像小船一樣飄過天空。

en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so. | A need to act quickly because time is limited.
example_en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
example_zh: 我們趕在下雨前匆忙回家了。

en: On or towards a higher floor of a building. | Located on a higher floor of a building.
example_en: I left my glasses upstairs beside the bed.
example_zh: 我把眼鏡落在樓上的床邊了。

zh: 詭計；惡作劇；竅門；戲法；欺騙；哄騙
en: an action intended to deceive someone or make them look foolish | a clever technique or an act that seems magical | to deceive someone into believing or doing something
example_en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
example_zh: 有人用一隻塑膠蜘蛛捉弄了我。

en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes
example_en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
example_zh: 我們在一個寧靜的湖邊搭起帳篷。

en: in a quiet voice or with little noise | in a gentle way without force or harshness
example_en: She spoke softly so the sleeping baby would not wake.
example_zh: 她輕聲說話，以免吵醒熟睡的嬰兒。

zh: 大圓桶；一桶的量；槍管；炮管；飛奔；高速行駛
en: A large round container with flat ends, or its contents. | The tube of a gun through which a bullet travels. | To move very fast, often with little control.
example_en: We collect rainwater in a wooden barrel behind the shed.
example_zh: 我們用棚屋後面的一個木桶收集雨水。

zh: 選單；計算機選單；選項列表
en: A list of food and drinks available to order | A list of choices available on a computer or device
example_en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
example_zh: 選單上有幾道素菜。

zh: 減輕；緩解；輕鬆；自在；小心緩慢地移動
en: To make pain, difficulty, or worry less severe. | Freedom from difficulty, effort, or worry. | To move something slowly and carefully into a position.
example_en: A warm bath helped ease the pain in my shoulders.
example_zh: 洗個熱水澡幫助緩解了我的肩痛。

en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard. | With a strong sound that is easily heard.
example_en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
example_zh: 一聲巨響驚醒了屋裡的所有人。

zh: 苦的；憤憤不平的；怨恨的；激烈的；充滿敵意的
en: having a sharp taste like strong unsweetened coffee | angry and resentful because of unfair treatment or disappointment | involving strong anger and hostility
example_en: The coffee tasted too bitter without milk or sugar.
example_zh: 這咖啡不加奶或糖，喝起來太苦了。

en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.
example_en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
example_zh: 我在廚房椅子下面找到了丟失的那隻手套。

zh: 謙虛的；不自誇的；適度的；不大的；穿著端莊的
en: not boasting about your abilities or achievements | not large in size, amount, or cost | wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body
example_en: Despite winning the race, she remained modest about her success.
example_zh: 儘管贏了比賽，她談起自己的成功時仍很謙虛。

zh: 景點；吸引人的事物；吸引力；吸引
en: A place or feature that people want to visit or experience. | The power to interest someone or draw them towards something.
example_en: The old castle is the town's most popular attraction.
example_zh: 那座古堡是鎮上最受歡迎的景點。

zh: 頻繁的；經常發生的；常去；常到訪
en: Happening often or at short intervals | Visit a particular place regularly
example_en: Frequent buses make getting to the market easy.
example_zh: 公交車班次密集，去市場很方便。

zh: 一把；一手之量；少數；少量；難管的人；棘手的事物
en: An amount that can be held in one hand. | A small number of people or things. | Someone or something that is difficult to manage.
example_en: He sprinkled a handful of nuts over his breakfast.
example_zh: 他在早餐上撒了一把堅果。

en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles. | A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.
example_en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
example_zh: 我們把汽車和腳踏車停在車庫裡。

en: A small change made to improve something. | The process of becoming comfortable with a new situation.
example_en: A small adjustment to the seat made cycling easier.
example_zh: 稍微調整座椅後，騎車變得更輕鬆了。

zh: 澳大利亞的；澳大利亞人的；澳大利亞人
en: Relating to Australia or its people. | A person from Australia.
example_en: We spotted several Australian animals at the wildlife park.
example_zh: 我們在野生動物園看到了幾種澳大利亞動物。

en: in a way that is not the same
example_en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
example_zh: 我和姐姐佈置書桌的方式不同。

zh: 登記；註冊；掛號；登記證；註冊證明
en: The process of officially recording details or joining something. | An official document showing that something has been registered.
example_en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
example_zh: 游泳課程將於週一開始報名。

en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric. | Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.
example_en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
example_zh: 這件棉襯衫洗了很多次後摸起來仍然很柔軟。

en: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy flesh. | Having a colour between red and yellow. | The colour between red and yellow.
example_en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
example_zh: 我剝了一個橙子，和妹妹分著吃。

zh: 刀片；刀身；槳葉；葉片；草葉
en: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool. | A flat part that rotates to move air or water. | A long narrow leaf of grass.
example_en: The knife's blade was too blunt to slice tomatoes.
example_zh: 這把刀的刀刃太鈍，切不動番茄。

en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts | An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food
example_en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
example_zh: 她咬了一口蘋果，被甜得笑了起來。

en: against an opponent, or compared with another option
example_en: Tonight's match is our school versus the local college.
example_zh: 今晚的比賽是我們學校對陣本地學院。

zh: 逆轉；撤銷；倒車；相反的；反向的；相反情況；背面
en: to change something to its opposite, or move backwards | going in the opposite direction or order | the opposite of something, or its back surface
example_en: He reversed the car slowly into the garage.
example_zh: 他慢慢地把車倒進車庫。

zh: 檸檬；淺黃色的；檸檬色的
en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice | having a pale yellow colour
example_en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
example_zh: 我把半個檸檬的汁擠在烤魚上。

en: Feeling the need or desire to eat. | Having a strong desire for something.
example_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
example_zh: 在河邊走了很久之後，我覺得餓了。

zh: 藉口；辯解理由；原諒；寬恕；准許免做；准許離開
en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault | forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour | allow someone to avoid a duty or leave
example_en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
example_zh: 他為晚餐遲到找了個藉口。

en: To decide that something planned will not happen. | To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.
example_en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
example_zh: 由於下大雨，我們不得不取消野餐。

zh: 每週的；每週一次的；每週一次地；週刊；週報
en: Happening once a week or relating to one week | Once every week | A newspaper or magazine published once a week
example_en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
example_zh: 我們每週的購物之行通常以去麵包店收尾。

en: A hard-shelled fruit with an edible seed inside. | A small metal piece screwed onto a bolt to fasten things.
example_en: She cracked a nut and shared the kernel with me.
example_zh: 她敲開一顆堅果，把果仁分給我吃。

zh: 無論哪裡；在任何地方；究竟在哪裡
en: in or to any place, regardless of where | used in questions to express surprise about a place
example_en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
example_zh: 你覺得哪裡最舒服，就可以坐在哪裡。

en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this | A short period of rain | Wash your body under water falling from a shower
example_en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
example_zh: 我騎車回家後總會洗個溫水澡。

zh: 有效的；正式認可的；有根據的；合理的
en: officially acceptable and able to be used | based on sound reasons or evidence
example_en: Your ticket is still valid for the return journey.
example_zh: 你的票在返程時仍然有效。

zh: 刷子；畫筆；刷；刷淨；輕擦；掠過
en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair | to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush | to touch something lightly while moving past it
example_en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
example_zh: 用軟毛刷清理你沾滿泥的鞋子。

en: Many times, often with little time between occasions.
example_en: He knocked repeatedly, but nobody came to the door.
example_zh: 他敲了好幾次門，但沒人來開門。

zh: 跑步；管理；運作；流動的；運轉中的
en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot | the work of managing or operating something | flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped
example_en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
example_zh: 沿著海灘跑步總能讓我頭腦清醒。

en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials | The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it
example_en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
example_zh: 我提著一籃新鮮蘋果走進廚房。

zh: 凝視；注視；凝視；注視的目光
en: To look steadily at something for a long time. | A steady look directed at someone or something.
example_en: Lina gazed at the moon through her bedroom window.
example_zh: 莉娜透過臥室窗戶凝望著月亮。

en: A dry substance consisting of very small loose particles. | To put a layer of powder on something.
example_en: Stir the cocoa powder into a little warm milk.
example_zh: 把可可粉攪入少量溫牛奶中。

zh: 醜陋的；難看的；令人不快的；險惡的
en: Unpleasant to look at. | Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.
example_en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
example_zh: 我們用木製屏風遮住了那些難看的管道。

en: Needing immediate attention or action
example_en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
example_zh: 漏水急需處理，所以水管工很快就趕來了。

zh: 曲奇餅；小甜餅；網站存於裝置的小型資料
en: A small, flat, sweet baked food | A small piece of data a website stores on your device
example_en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
example_zh: 罐子裡還剩一塊巧克力曲奇。

en: The activity of preparing food by heating it. | Intended for use in preparing food.
example_en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
example_zh: 我哥哥做飯，我洗碗。

en: Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently
example_en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
example_zh: 我們的舊車在寒冷天氣裡依然很可靠。

zh: 打擾；妨礙；使不安；弄亂；擾動
en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace | to make someone feel worried or upset | to move or change something from its usual position
example_en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
example_zh: 請輕輕關門，別打擾爸爸。

en: exactly the same in every relevant detail
example_en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
example_zh: 我們在不知道對方選擇的情況下，買了完全一樣的夾克。

zh: 唯一的；獨自的；腳底；鞋底；鰨魚
en: Being the only one, with nobody or nothing else involved. | The bottom surface of a foot or shoe. | A flat sea fish commonly eaten as food.
example_en: She is the sole owner of this little bakery.
example_zh: 她是這家小麵包店的唯一所有者。

zh: 成套工具；裝備；組裝套件
en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity | A set of parts used to build something
example_en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
example_zh: 我們在車裡備有一個急救包。

en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure. | To gently touch an animal with your hand.
example_en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
example_zh: 我們的寵物兔喜歡躲在廚房桌子下面。

en: Good enough to meet a particular need or standard
example_en: The mechanic confirmed that the brakes were satisfactory.
example_zh: 修理工確認剎車狀況合格。

zh: 吞下；嚥下；輕信；勉強接受；燕子
en: make food or liquid pass from your mouth into your stomach | believe something too easily or accept something unpleasant | a small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail
example_en: Please swallow your food before you start talking again.
example_zh: 請先把食物嚥下去再說話。

en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural. | A shop selling food and basic household supplies.
example_en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
example_zh: 我把兩袋食品雜貨提進了廚房。

zh: 迎接；問候；映入眼簾；傳入耳鼻
en: to welcome someone or say hello | to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks
example_en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
example_zh: 我們搬來時，鄰居們熱情地向我們打招呼。

zh: 移除；清除；免職；撤職；搬家；搬遷
en: The act of taking something away from a place. | The act of dismissing someone from an official position. | The process of moving belongings to a new home.
example_en: Stain removal is easier if you act quickly.
example_zh: 汙漬如果及時處理，就更容易去除。

zh: 毯子；覆蓋層；全面的；一概而論的；覆蓋；籠罩
en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something. | Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences. | To cover something completely with a layer.
example_en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
example_zh: 她用一條柔軟的毯子裹住冰涼的肩膀。

en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres. | A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.
example_en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
example_zh: 她選了柔軟的棉布來做嬰兒毯。

en: a thick, strong cord made from twisted fibres | to tie or secure something with rope
example_en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
example_zh: 我們用繩子把船系在一根柱子上。

zh: 追逐；追趕；努力爭取；追求；追逐；追捕
en: to run or move after someone to catch them | to try hard to obtain something you want | an attempt to catch someone by following them
example_en: Our puppy chased a leaf across the garden.
example_zh: 我們的小狗追著一片葉子跑過花園。

en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.
example_en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後，我們分著吃了一個熱蘋果派。

zh: 發光；照耀；擦亮；光澤；光亮
en: To give out or reflect light. | To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth. | Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.
example_en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，陽光透過我臥室的窗戶照了進來。

zh: 薄片；一片；切成薄片；一部分；份額
en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger | to cut something into thin, flat pieces | a share or portion of something
example_en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
example_zh: 她在我的茶裡放了一片檸檬。

en: A device that produces light, often on a table.
example_en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
example_zh: 她開啟了床邊的燈。

zh: 編織；針織；使緊密結合；癒合
en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles | to join closely together or heal into one piece
example_en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
example_zh: 我爺爺給我織了一條暖和的圍巾。

en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.
example_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
example_zh: 我們每週六早上都在公園踢足球。

en: an object used to hold or store things | a large metal box used to transport goods
example_en: Keep the leftover rice in a container with a lid.
example_zh: 把剩米飯放在有蓋的容器裡。

zh: 低聲說；喃喃道；低語聲；輕柔持續的聲音；低聲抱怨
en: To speak in a quiet, gentle voice. | A quiet, continuous sound or softly spoken words. | A quiet expression of dissatisfaction or disagreement.
example_en: She murmured a quiet thank you and smiled.
example_zh: 她輕聲道了謝，露出微笑。

en: products applied to the face to change or improve appearance | the parts or qualities that together form something
example_en: She removed her makeup before going to bed.
example_zh: 她睡覺前卸了妝。

en: Happening without being expected or predicted.
example_en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
example_zh: 我們剛吃完午飯，一位意想不到的客人就來了。

zh: 大部分；主要部分；龐大體積；大塊
en: the largest part of something | the large size or mass of something
example_en: The bulk of my clothes fit in this suitcase.
example_zh: 我的大部分衣服都能裝進這個行李箱。

zh: 捕捉器；陷阱；困住；使無法逃脫；圈套；困境
en: A device or concealed danger designed to catch someone or something | To catch or keep someone somewhere they cannot escape | A situation that deceives people or is difficult to escape
example_en: We found a mouse inside the humane trap this morning.
example_zh: 今天早上，我們在活捕鼠籠裡發現了一隻老鼠。

en: A date marking another year since an important event.
example_en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
example_zh: 我們為結婚紀念日做了一頓特別的飯菜。

en: the need for something or for something to happen | something essential for everyday life
example_en: Living far from town makes a car a necessity.
example_zh: 住得離城鎮很遠，汽車就成了必需品。

en: A comfortable seat for two or more people. | To express something in a particular way.
example_en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後，我們蜷坐在沙發上。

zh: 緊握；抓牢；緊握；抓握力；控制；支配
en: to hold something firmly | a firm hold on something | power or control over someone or something
example_en: She gripped the railing as the boat rocked gently.
example_zh: 船輕輕搖晃時，她緊緊抓住欄杆。

zh: 髒亂；雜亂；困境；混亂局面；弄亂；弄糟
en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things. | A situation full of problems or confusion. | To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.
example_en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
example_zh: 我們烤完餅乾後，廚房一片狼藉。

en: Extremely good in quality or performance.
example_en: We enjoyed a superb meal overlooking the quiet harbour.
example_zh: 我們一邊俯瞰寧靜的港灣，一邊享用了一頓極棒的飯菜。

zh: 打斷；插話；打擾；使中斷；使暫停
en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something | to stop an activity or process for a time
example_en: Please don't interrupt me while I explain the rules.
example_zh: 我講解規則時，請不要打斷我。

zh: 等待；期待；即將發生於；等待著
en: To wait for someone or something | To be ready or likely to happen to someone
example_en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
example_zh: 我們熱切地等待著新來的小狗到家。

zh: 輕輕地；輕柔地；少量地；輕微地；輕率地；不嚴肅地
en: With little force, pressure, or weight. | To a small degree or in a small amount. | Without treating something as serious or important.
example_en: He tapped lightly on the door before coming inside.
example_zh: 他輕輕敲了敲門才進來。

zh: 西北方；西北部；西北部的；來自西北的；向西北；在西北
en: The direction between north and west, or an area's northwestern part. | Located in the northwest, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the direction between north and west.
example_en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
example_zh: 我們的小木屋位於島的西北部。

en: Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.
example_en: A balcony makes this small flat much more desirable.
example_zh: 陽臺讓這套小公寓更令人嚮往。

en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.
example_en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
example_zh: 這條牛仔褲洗後還沒幹。

en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking | to cover a surface or food lightly with flour
example_en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
example_zh: 慢慢加入麵粉，攪拌至順滑。

zh: 一人份；一份食物；現任的；現役的
en: An amount of food or drink intended for one person. | Currently holding an official position or working in the armed forces.
example_en: Would you like another serving of soup before dessert?
example_zh: 吃甜點前，你還想再來一份湯嗎？

en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar
example_en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
example_zh: 她給每位客人遞了一小塊糖果。

en: A metal award given for achievement, service, or bravery.
example_en: She proudly showed us her first swimming medal.
example_zh: 她自豪地向我們展示了她的第一枚游泳獎牌。

zh: 砰地關上；用力摔放；猛烈抨擊；砰的一聲；猛烈撞擊
en: to shut or put something down with force and noise | to criticize someone or something very strongly | a loud noise caused by something closing or hitting hard
example_en: The wind slammed the window shut during breakfast.
example_zh: 吃早飯時，風把窗戶砰地吹關了。

en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.
example_en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
example_zh: 我們一直醒著看雪，直到午夜。

zh: 壁櫥；儲藏間；隱藏身份或興趣的
en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings | Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret
example_en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
example_zh: 我把冬季外套掛進了走廊的壁櫥裡。

en: for a particular purpose or person
example_en: I made this cushion specially for your chair.
example_zh: 這個靠墊是我特意為你的椅子做的。

zh: 關著的；閉合的；停止營業的；不接受新思想的
en: not open | not available for business or public use | unwilling to consider different ideas
example_en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
example_zh: 開著暖氣時，請把窗戶關好。

zh: 暗示；提示；暗示；少許；微量
en: An indirect suggestion or clue that helps someone understand | To suggest something without stating it directly | A very small amount or slight sign of something
example_en: Give me a hint about where you hid the gift.
example_zh: 給我一點提示吧，你把禮物藏在哪裡了？

zh: 摺疊；對摺；褶；摺痕；倒閉；停業
en: to bend something so one part lies over another | a bend or crease in paper, cloth, or skin | to close because a business cannot continue operating
example_en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
example_zh: 請把這些毛巾疊好，放到架子上。

zh: 方便的；合適的；附近的；便於到達的
en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans. | Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.
example_en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
example_zh: 你週六上午來方便嗎？

zh: 混合的；各類的；好壞參半的；矛盾的
en: containing different types of things or people | including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results
example_en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
example_zh: 我買了一袋混合堅果，準備野餐時吃。

zh: 找不到的；失蹤的；缺少的；缺失的
en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown | not present where something should be
example_en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
example_zh: 我們發現那隻找不到的小貓正在沙發後面睡覺。

en: meat from cattle, eaten as food
example_en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
example_zh: 我們把牛肉和胡蘿蔔、土豆一起慢燉。

en: The system or process that keeps a building warm. | The process of making something warmer.
example_en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
example_zh: 傍晚天涼起來時，我們開啟了暖氣。

zh: 每月的；每月一次的；每月；每月一次；月刊
en: Happening, produced, or paid once every month. | Once every month. | A magazine published once every month.
example_en: My monthly bus pass fits neatly inside my wallet.
example_zh: 我的公交月票正好能放進錢包裡。

en: A comfortable level of heat. | Friendly affection shown in someone's behaviour or manner.
example_en: We enjoyed the warmth of the fire after our walk.
example_zh: 散步回來後，我們享受著爐火的溫暖。

en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them. | To place or squeeze something between two other things.
example_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
example_zh: 我帶了一個乳酪三明治和一個蘋果當午餐。

en: The act of reaching the ground or shore. | A flat area at the top of or between stairs.
example_en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
example_zh: 儘管有風，飛機還是平穩著陸了。

zh: 重大勝利；巨大成功；勝利的喜悅；獲勝；戰勝
en: An important victory or impressive achievement. | Great happiness and pride after achieving success. | To achieve victory or overcome a difficulty.
example_en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
example_zh: 贏得當地國際象棋錦標賽對阿米爾來說是一次重大勝利。

en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste | a room containing a toilet
example_en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
example_zh: 樓上的馬桶一直髮出奇怪的滴水聲。

zh: 指甲；趾甲；釘子；用釘子釘牢
en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe. | A thin pointed metal piece used to fasten materials together. | To attach something using nails.
example_en: I cut my nails before my piano lesson.
example_zh: 我在上鋼琴課前剪了指甲。

zh: 實用的；重功能的；能正常運作的；功能上的
en: designed to be useful rather than decorative | working correctly and ready for use | relating to the purpose or operation of something
example_en: The kitchen is small but functional, with plenty of storage.
example_zh: 這個廚房雖小卻很實用，有充足的儲物空間。

zh: 西南方；西南部；西南的；來自西南的；向西南；在西南
en: the direction between south and west, or an area's southwestern part | in the southwest, or coming from that direction | towards or in the direction between south and west
example_en: Our village lies southwest of the nearest town.
example_zh: 我們的村莊位於最近那座城鎮的西南方。

en: To tear something quickly or forcefully, or become torn. | A long hole caused by tearing material.
example_en: I ripped my sleeve on a sharp branch yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我的袖子被一根尖樹枝扯破了。

zh: 裙子；沿邊緣走；繞過；迴避
en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs. | To move around the edge of something. | To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.
example_en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
example_zh: 她上樓時，藍色裙子輕輕擺動。

en: happening, used, or located outside a building
example_en: We bought comfortable chairs for our outdoor dining area.
example_zh: 我們給戶外用餐區買了舒適的椅子。

zh: 備用的；空閒的；抽出；分出；使免遭；饒恕
en: extra and available to use when needed | to give time or resources that you can make available | to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty
example_en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
example_zh: 我在車裡放了一把備用傘。

en: Having a particular colour or colours rather than being plain.
example_en: Sunlight streamed through the coloured glass onto the floor.
example_zh: 陽光透過彩色玻璃灑在地板上。

zh: 吸；吮吸；吸入；吸走；很糟糕；令人討厭
en: To draw liquid or air in using the mouth | To pull something inward through suction | To be very bad or unpleasant, in informal speech
example_en: The baby sucked her thumb and slowly fell asleep.
example_zh: 寶寶吮著拇指，慢慢睡著了。

zh: 收據；小票；收到；接收；收入；進款
en: a document showing that something has been paid for | the act of receiving something | money received by a business or organisation
example_en: Keep your receipt in case the shoes don't fit.
example_zh: 留好收據，以防鞋子不合腳。

en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.
example_en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
example_zh: 帶一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就沒必要了。

zh: 身體不舒服的；不舒適的；不自在的；不安的
en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort. | Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.
example_en: These new shoes feel uncomfortable after a long walk.
example_zh: 走了很久以後，這雙新鞋穿著很不舒服。

zh: 令人不快的；難聞的；惡意的；不友善的；嚴重的；疼痛的
en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see. | Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person. | Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.
example_en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
example_zh: 廚房垃圾桶裡散發出一股難聞的氣味。

zh: 寧靜的；安詳的；和平的；非暴力的
en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry | not involving war, violence, or fighting
example_en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
example_zh: 晨光中的湖泊顯得格外寧靜。

zh: 灑出；溢位；使散落；灑出物；洩漏
en: To accidentally let liquid or loose material escape its container. | An amount of liquid spilled, or an incident involving spilling.
example_en: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
example_zh: 我把橙汁灑得乾淨襯衫上到處都是。

en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.
example_en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
example_zh: 她把生日賀卡放進了一個藍色信封。

zh: 擰；扭；扭轉；意外轉折；歪曲；曲解
en: turn something so its parts rotate in different directions | an unexpected change in a story or situation | change the meaning of something to mislead people
example_en: She twisted the wet towel over the sink.
example_zh: 她在水槽上方擰乾溼毛巾。

zh: 尚好的；像樣的；正派的；得體的
en: of a satisfactory or reasonably good standard | honest, kind, or socially acceptable
example_en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
example_zh: 我們終於在車站附近找到了一套像樣的公寓。

en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things | to dry someone or something with a towel
example_en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
example_zh: 他把一條溫暖的毛巾裹在溼漉漉的肩膀上。

zh: 去取來；去接來；售得；賣得
en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back. | To be sold for a particular amount of money.
example_en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
example_zh: 你能去臥室把我的夾克拿來嗎？

en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things
example_en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
example_zh: 乾淨的碗放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

zh: 微弱的；隱約的；頭暈欲倒的；昏倒；暈厥
en: not strong, clear or easy to notice | feeling weak and close to losing consciousness | to suddenly lose consciousness for a short time
example_en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
example_zh: 一絲微弱的光透過臥室窗簾照了進來。

zh: 東南；東南部；東南的；來自東南的；向東南；在東南
en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part. | Located in the southeast, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the southeast.
example_en: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
example_zh: 我們廚房的窗戶朝東南，早晨能照到陽光。

en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and aged in barrels.
example_en: The guide showed us barrels used for ageing whisky.
example_zh: 導遊向我們展示了用於陳釀威士忌的木桶。

en: Having no end, or seeming to continue forever.
example_en: The queue outside the swimming pool seemed endless today.
example_zh: 今天游泳池外的隊伍似乎怎麼也排不到頭。

zh: 光束；射束；梁；橫樑；笑容滿面
en: a narrow stream of light or other energy | a long, strong piece supporting a roof or floor | to smile with obvious happiness
example_en: A beam of sunlight fell across the kitchen table.
example_zh: 一束陽光灑在廚房的桌子上。

en: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand. | To turn pages quickly without reading everything carefully.
example_en: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
example_zh: 掛畫時，我不小心砸到了拇指。

zh: 餐叉；叉子；岔路口；分叉處；分叉
en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food | A place where a road or path divides | Divide into separate branches or directions
example_en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
example_zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一塊胡蘿蔔。

en: An international sporting competition with summer and winter editions.
example_en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
example_zh: 我們全家晚飯後一起觀看了奧運會。

en: Apart from others, or individually rather than together.
example_en: We paid separately, then walked home together after lunch.
example_zh: 我們午飯後分別付了賬，然後一起走回家。

zh: 簽名；署名；標誌性的；招牌的
en: Your name written in your own distinctive way | Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place
example_en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
example_zh: 送貨司機在門口請我簽名。

zh: 易碎的；嬌弱的；微妙的；需謹慎處理的；精巧的；柔和的
en: Easily damaged or harmed. | Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence. | Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.
example_en: Please wrap these delicate glass bowls in soft paper.
example_zh: 請用柔軟的紙包好這些易碎的玻璃碗。

zh: 結冰的；凍硬的；冷凍儲存的；凍僵的；冷極了的
en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold. | Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness. | Feeling extremely cold.
example_en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，一處結冰的水窪被我的靴子踩裂了。

zh: 休閒的；非正式的；臨時的；不定期的；不經意的；隨意的
en: relaxed and not formal | done occasionally rather than regularly or permanently | done without much attention or serious thought
example_en: You can wear casual clothes to dinner tonight.
example_zh: 今晚吃飯你可以穿休閒服。

en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.
example_en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
example_zh: 我妹妹十七歲，喜歡打排球。

en: A curved object used for hanging, holding or catching things. | To attach or catch something with a hook.
example_en: Hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
example_zh: 把你的溼外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.
example_en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
example_zh: 這條羊毛圍巾讓我的脖子在颳風的早晨保持溫暖。

zh: 彈起；使彈跳；彈跳；反彈；支票遭退票
en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this | a movement back up after hitting a surface | be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient
example_en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
example_zh: 球彈過籬笆，落進了鄰居的花園。

en: a person who travels from one place to another
example_en: A tired traveler asked me where the station was.
example_zh: 一位疲憊的旅客問我車站在哪裡。

zh: 枯燥的；無趣的；暗淡的；陰沉的；鈍的；不鋒利的
en: Not interesting or exciting. | Not bright or sunny. | Having an edge that does not cut easily.
example_en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
example_zh: 這部電影太無聊了，我差點睡著。

zh: 向後；朝後；倒序地；逆向地
en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards. | In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.
example_en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
example_zh: 她向後退了一步，讓騎車的人過去。

en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something. | A small unit of data transmitted across a network.
example_en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
