en: A room where people eat meals.
example_en: We put fresh flowers on the dining-room table.
example_zh: 我們在飯廳的餐桌上擺了鮮花。

en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers. | Without paying certain taxes on goods.
example_en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
example_zh: 登機前，她買了一些免稅香水。

en: the body parts at the ends of the legs | units of length, each equal to twelve inches
example_en: My feet felt cold against the kitchen tiles.
example_zh: 我的腳踩在廚房瓷磚上，感覺冰涼。

en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight. | Containers made of glass, usually used for drinking.
example_en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
example_zh: 我昨晚把眼鏡落在床邊了。

zh: 成年人；大人；成年的；成熟的
en: An adult, especially when described by or to children. | Adult, or behaving in a sensible and responsible way.
example_en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
example_zh: 請一位大人幫你切面包。

en: A delay that prevents something from continuing as planned | A robbery involving threats with a weapon
example_en: A hold-up on the bridge made us miss lunch.
example_zh: 橋上的堵塞讓我們錯過了午飯。

en: A stay in a local family's home while visiting another place
example_en: During my homestay, I cooked dinner with the family.
example_zh: 寄宿期間，我和寄宿家庭一起做晚飯。

en: Before a planned event or a particular time.
example_en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
example_zh: 我們提前兩週訂好了火車票。

en: Riding a board across water while pulled by a kite.
example_en: My cousin tried kitesurfing at the beach yesterday.
example_zh: 我表親昨天在海灘嘗試了風箏衝浪。

zh: 最新的；最近的；最新訊息；最新事物
en: Most recent or newest. | The most recent news, developments, or products.
example_en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
example_zh: 你聽說關於我們鄰居的最新訊息了嗎？

en: Located on the left side.
example_en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
example_zh: 把票放在夾克左側的口袋裡。

en: Rooms or buildings where people live
example_en: Our living quarters were small but warm and comfortable.
example_zh: 我們的住處雖小，卻溫暖舒適。

en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance. | The parts or qualities that together form something.
example_en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
example_zh: 她把化妝品放在一個藍色小包裡。

en: neither large nor small in size
example_en: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
example_zh: 一箇中等大小的行李箱應該能裝下週末所需的所有東西。

en: The middle of the day, around twelve o'clock.
example_en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
example_zh: 中午，我們在河邊停下來吃午飯。

en: Not eligible for money to be returned after payment.
example_en: We chose cheaper tickets, but they were non-refundable.
example_zh: 我們選了更便宜的票，但這些票不能退款。

zh: 老式的；不時興的；守舊的；傳統的
en: Belonging to a style that was common in the past. | Following beliefs or customs associated with earlier times.
example_en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
example_zh: 我祖父仍然用著一座帶鐘擺的老式時鐘。

en: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time
example_en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
example_zh: 游泳池今天晚上八點關門。

zh: 乒乓球運動；來回移動；反覆往返
en: A game hitting a light ball across a table with bats | To move or pass repeatedly back and forth
example_en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
example_zh: 等晚飯時，我們一起打了乒乓球。

en: An exercise raising and lowering your body using your arms.
example_en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
example_zh: 我做了一個俯臥撐，胳膊就開始發抖了。

zh: 二手的；用過的；間接獲得的；以二手方式；間接地
en: previously owned or used by someone else | learned from others rather than through direct experience | from a previous owner, or through another person's account
example_en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
example_zh: 我的二手腳踏車用了多年，騎起來仍很順暢。

en: protecting yourself from attack or physical harm
example_en: My sister attends a self-defence class every Saturday.
example_zh: 我姐姐每週六都上自衛術課。

en: Requiring customers to serve themselves rather than wait for staff | A system in which customers serve themselves
example_en: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
example_zh: 我們端著托盤穿過了自助餐廳。

en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface
example_en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
example_zh: 我最喜歡的襯衫正面有藍色條紋。

en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.
example_en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
example_zh: 我為野餐帶了一件乾淨的T恤衫。

zh: 買走食用；外帶；拿走；移除
en: to buy prepared food and eat it somewhere else | to remove something from a place or person
example_en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
example_zh: 請給我一個蔬菜三明治打包帶走，好嗎？

en: Positioned with the usual top at the bottom
example_en: An upside-down bowl covered the last slice of cake.
example_zh: 一個倒扣的碗蓋住了最後一塊蛋糕。

en: Travelling over water on skis while pulled by a boat.
example_en: We tried waterskiing on the lake last summer.
example_zh: 去年夏天，我們在湖上嘗試了滑水。

zh: 穿著得體的；衣著考究的
en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.
example_en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
example_zh: 一位衣著考究的客人穿著熨燙平整的西裝到來。

en: A code identifying a postal delivery area in the United States.
example_en: Please include your ZIP code when entering your address.
example_zh: 填寫地址時，請附上你的美國郵政編碼。

en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general. | A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.
example_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
example_zh: 今天早晨，有幾個人在麵包店外等候。

zh: 成年男子；男人；人類；為…配備人員；值守
en: An adult male human | Human beings considered collectively | To provide people to operate or guard something
example_en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example_zh: 一位穿藍色外套的男子扶著門，讓別人透過。

en: An adult female person.
example_en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
example_zh: 隔壁那位女士在陽臺上種了漂亮的花。

en: a young person who has not yet become an adult | someone's son or daughter, regardless of age
example_en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
example_zh: 那個孩子小心翼翼地端著一碗水走到外面。

en: The earth and all the people and things on it. | A particular area of activity and the people involved.
example_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
example_zh: 她夢想乘火車環遊世界。

zh: 狀態；狀況；國家；州；政府；陳述；明確說明
en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time | a country, its government, or a region within a country | to express something clearly in speech or writing
example_en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後，廚房一片狼藉。

en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature. | Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.
example_en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
example_zh: 一群騎行者在村裡的麵包店外停了下來。

zh: 反對；與……對抗；靠著；緊貼；防備；抵禦
en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them. | Touching or supported by a surface. | For protection from something harmful or unwanted.
example_en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
example_zh: 今天下午我們隊要和鄰居們比賽。

zh: 聚會；派對；政黨；一方；當事人
en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves. | An organised group seeking political power through shared policies. | A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.
example_en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在花園裡辦了一場小聚會。

en: To give someone something they need or make it available. | To support someone financially by supplying what they need.
example_en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
example_zh: 營地為每位客人提供乾淨的毛巾和毯子。

zh: 美國的；美國人的；美國人
en: relating to the United States, its people, or its culture | a person from the United States
example_en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
example_zh: 我的美國鄰居邀請我們去他家吃南瓜派。

en: a person who belongs to a group or organisation
example_en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
example_zh: 每位俱樂部成員都帶了一道菜與大家分享。

zh: 社會的；社交的；交際的；群居的
en: relating to society and how people live together | relating to meeting people and spending time with them | living naturally in organised groups rather than alone
example_en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
example_zh: 我的新工作讓我幾乎沒時間參加社交活動。

en: the number equal to a thousand thousands
example_en: The city now has more than a million residents.
example_zh: 這座城市如今有一百多萬居民。

zh: 權力；影響力；動力；電力；為…提供動力
en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions. | Energy used to make machines and equipment work. | To supply energy that makes something work.
example_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
example_zh: 經理有權調整我們的班次。

zh: 議題；重要問題；釋出；發放；報刊的一期
en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion. | To officially announce or give something to people. | One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.
example_en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
example_zh: 我們在鄰里會議上討論了停車問題。

en: Caring about others and willing to help them. | A group of things sharing similar features.
example_en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
example_zh: 我們生病時，體貼的鄰居給我們送來了湯。

en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with
example_en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
example_zh: 我昨天在市場遇到了一位老朋友。

zh: 一起；共同；合在一起；相互連線
en: with another person or other people | joined or combined with something else
example_en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
example_zh: 我們一起做晚飯，分享各自一天的見聞。

zh: 社群；當地居民；群體；共同體
en: people living in the same area | people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background
example_en: Our community gathers every spring to clean the park.
example_zh: 我們社群的居民每年春天都會一起清理公園。

zh: 普遍的；總體的；大致的；非具體的；將軍
en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations | describing main points rather than particular details | an officer with a very high rank in the army
example_en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
example_zh: 大家普遍同意廚房需要重新刷漆。

en: an individual human being | a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others
example_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
example_zh: 只有一個人在麵包店外等候。

zh: 公眾的；公用的；公開的；政府的；公立的；公眾；民眾
en: For everyone to use, see, or know about. | Provided or controlled by the government. | Ordinary people in society considered as a group.
example_en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
example_zh: 這座公共花園每天開放到日落。

en: People living together in an organised community. | An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.
example_en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
example_zh: 每個人都能在社會中發揮作用。

zh: 父親或母親；母公司；養育；教養
en: a person's mother or father | a company that owns or controls another company | to raise and care for a child as a parent
example_en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
example_zh: 每位家長都為學校野餐帶了一份點心。

zh: 警察；警方；維持治安；監督執行
en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order. | To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.
example_en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
example_zh: 警方幫我們找到了丟失的腳踏車。

zh: 行動；措施；行為；舉動；精彩刺激的場面；劇情
en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem. | A particular thing that someone does. | Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.
example_en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
example_zh: 我們得在漏水加重之前採取行動。

en: A female child or young woman
example_en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
example_zh: 那個女孩小心翼翼地把小貓抱進屋裡。

zh: 年齡；存在年限；時代；變老；使衰老
en: The length of time someone or something has existed. | A period of history with particular features. | To become older or make someone or something seem older.
example_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
example_zh: 我奶奶七十歲時學會了游泳。

zh: 行動；表現；扮演；行為；舉動；法令；法案
en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role. | Something that someone does. | A law formally approved by a legislative body.
example_en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
example_zh: 我們必須趕快採取行動，免得廚房水槽裡的水溢位來。

zh: 主要的；重大的；主修專業；該專業學生；主修
en: very important, large, or serious | a main university subject, or a student studying that subject | to study a particular subject as your main university subject
example_en: The storm caused major damage to our roof.
example_zh: 暴風雨嚴重損壞了我們的屋頂。

zh: 教堂；禮拜活動；基督教教會；教派
en: a building where Christians gather to worship | Christian religious worship attended as a service | an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices
example_en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
example_zh: 這座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗戶和一座石塔。

zh: 人的；人類的；人；人類成員
en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines. | A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.
example_en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
example_zh: 這個機器人能識別熟悉的人聲。

en: A country considered together with its people | A people united by shared history, culture, or language
example_en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
example_zh: 全國各地的球迷都在慶祝這支球隊獲勝。

zh: 國際的；跨國的；國際比賽；國家隊選手
en: Involving two or more countries. | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
example_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐國際航班。

en: The function or responsibility someone or something has. | A character played by an actor in a performance.
example_en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
example_zh: 我的職責是在門口迎接客人。

zh: 嗓音；說話聲；發言權；影響力；表達；吐露
en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing. | The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions. | To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.
example_en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
example_zh: 她溫柔的聲音讓受驚的小狗安靜了下來。

en: a woman who is married to someone
example_en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
example_zh: 他的妻子為他們下午的散步準備了三明治。

zh: 活動；重大事件；比賽專案
en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion. | A particular contest within a sports competition.
example_en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
example_zh: 這場戶外音樂會是我們鎮上夏季最大的活動。

en: A male child in relation to his parents.
example_en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
example_zh: 他們的兒子幫他們在花園裡種花。

zh: 支援；幫助；供養；支撐；承託；支援；援助；支撐
en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone | to hold something up or bear its weight | help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up
example_en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
example_zh: 每當我嘗試新事物時，姐姐都會支援我。

zh: 人際關係；戀愛關係；關聯；聯絡
en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other. | A connection between things or the way they affect each other.
example_en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
example_zh: 她和妹妹的關係很親密。

en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.
example_en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
example_zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都會感謝上帝。

zh: 俱樂部；社團；夜總會；高爾夫球杆；棍棒
en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity | a place where people dance and socialise at night | a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something
example_en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
example_zh: 我加入了一個國際象棋俱樂部，想認識些新朋友。

zh: 加入；參加；連線；接合；與……會合；一起做
en: To become a member or take part with others. | To connect things or become connected. | To go where someone is and spend time with them.
example_en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
example_zh: 你今天願意和我們一起吃午飯嗎？

en: Every person in a group, or all people.
example_en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
example_zh: 每個人都帶了一道菜，在野餐時一起分享。

zh: 夫婦；情侶；兩個；幾個；連線；結合
en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship. | Two things or people, or a small number of them. | To join two things or consider them together.
example_en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
example_zh: 隔壁那對夫婦邀請我們去吃晚飯。

zh: 警察；警官；軍官；官員；主管人員
en: A member of the police. | A member of the armed forces with authority to command. | Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.
example_en: A police officer helped us find the station.
example_zh: 一位警察幫我們找到了車站。

zh: 移動；動作；社會運動；樂章
en: an act of changing position or moving the body | an organised effort by people seeking shared social change | one main section of a long piece of music
example_en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
example_zh: 灌木叢裡突然有動靜，引起了我的注意。

zh: 建立；創立；確立；使獲認可；查明；證實
en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement | to make a position or reputation widely accepted | to discover or prove that something is true
example_en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居去年春天成立了一個園藝俱樂部。

zh: 私人的；非公開的；私營的；私有的；私密的；保密的
en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone. | Owned or managed independently of the government. | Not intended to be known or shared with others.
example_en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
example_zh: 每位客人的臥室旁都有一間專用浴室。

zh: 組織；機構；團體；組織工作；安排
en: A group of people working together for a shared purpose. | The process of planning activities and arranging things efficiently.
example_en: She volunteers for an organization that rescues injured birds.
example_zh: 她在一家救助受傷鳥類的機構做志願者。

zh: 貧窮的；差的；不足的；可憐的
en: Having very little money or few possessions | Of low quality or lacking something necessary | Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation
example_en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
example_zh: 這戶貧困家庭幾乎買不起新鮮蔬菜。

zh: 文化；習俗；文化藝術活動；培養物
en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example_en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
example_zh: 分享傳統餐食有助於孩子瞭解自己的文化。

en: An opportunity to do something. | The likelihood that something will happen. | Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.
example_en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
example_zh: 你能再給我一次解釋的機會嗎？

zh: 分享；共用；分擔；一份；份額；股份
en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others. | One part of something divided among people or groups. | One of the equal units of ownership in a company.
example_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
example_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗邊的一張書桌。

zh: 協議；協定；同意；意見一致；語法上的一致關係
en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups | the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal | a grammatical match between related words in a sentence
example_en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
example_zh: 我們就共用廚房達成了協議。

zh: 安全；安全保障；安保人員；保安工作；穩定；保障
en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access | People or activities responsible for protecting a place | Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support
example_en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
example_zh: 我們安裝了更堅固的鎖，以加強家中的安全防護。

en: Someone's female child.
example_en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
example_zh: 他們的女兒給全家人做了薄煎餅。

en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse | to use resources carefully so they last longer
example_en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
example_zh: 她忙著上班時，丈夫給她送來了午飯。

zh: 有組織的運動；宣傳活動；開展運動；參加活動；戰役
en: A series of organised activities aimed at achieving a goal | To organise or take part in activities supporting a cause | A series of military operations with a particular objective
example_en: Our school launched a campaign to reduce food waste.
example_zh: 我們學校發起了一項減少食物浪費的活動。

en: all people living in an area, or their total number | all organisms of one species living in a particular area
example_en: The village population grows when families move here.
example_zh: 有家庭搬來時，村裡的人口就會增加。

zh: 當前的；現行的；水流；氣流；電流
en: happening, existing, or being used now | a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity
example_en: My current flat is much closer to work.
example_zh: 我現在住的公寓離上班的地方近多了。

zh: 標準；水準；標準的；通常的
en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance. | Generally accepted, regularly used, or meeting an established requirement.
example_en: The food here is always of a high standard.
example_zh: 這裡的食物品質一向很高。

zh: 好處；益處；使受益；得益於；福利金；補助金
en: a helpful or positive effect of something | to help someone or receive help or an advantage | money provided by the government to people needing support
example_en: One benefit of cycling is arriving home feeling refreshed.
example_zh: 騎車的一個好處是到家時感覺神清氣爽。

zh: 行為；舉止；執行特性；反應方式
en: the way a person or animal acts | the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions
example_en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
example_zh: 這隻小狗安靜的表現讓公園裡的每個人都很驚訝。

en: any person, without restriction | a person, used in questions and negative statements
example_en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
example_zh: 任何人都可以參加我們週末的河邊散步活動。

en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way. | To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.
example_en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
example_zh: 孩子們為輪到誰玩而爭吵。

zh: 打架；戰鬥；抗爭；努力爭取；打鬥；鬥爭
en: To use physical force against another person or group. | To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal. | An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.
example_en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
example_zh: 兩隻貓為了窗邊一個有陽光的位置打了起來。

zh: 王室的；國王或女王的；王室成員
en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family. | A member of a royal family.
example_en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
example_zh: 我們度假時參觀了王宮。

zh: 齊步行進；堅定地走；遊行；行軍；進行曲
en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group. | An organised walk by a group, often to protest. | Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.
example_en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
example_zh: 樂隊身穿鮮豔的制服，齊步走過廣場。

zh: 介紹；引見；引進；推行；使初次瞭解
en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet. | Bring something into use or a place for the first time. | Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.
example_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
example_zh: 讓我把你介紹給我的新鄰居。

zh: 擔憂；關切；令人擔憂的事；關注事項；涉及；使擔憂
en: A feeling of worry about something important | An issue that matters or causes worry | To relate to someone or something, or cause worry
example_en: Her main concern is getting home before the storm.
example_zh: 她最擔心的是能否在暴風雨前到家。

en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a person who belongs to your family
example_en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
example_zh: 這個價格似乎與質量毫無關係。

zh: 個人的；單獨的；個人；個體；獨特的；有個性的
en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group | One person or living thing considered separately from others | Having qualities that make someone or something different from others
example_en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
example_zh: 老師給每個孩子單獨發了一盒彩色蠟筆。

zh: 組織；機構；團體；組織安排；條理
en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose. | The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.
example_en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
example_zh: 他加入了一個救助受傷鳥類的當地組織。

en: to cause a change in someone or something | to cause someone to feel a strong emotion
example_en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
example_zh: 喝太多咖啡會影響你的睡眠質量。

zh: 現代的；近代的；新式的；時髦的
en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times. | Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.
example_en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
example_zh: 我們的公寓有一間新式廚房，窗戶很大。

en: a polite word for an adult woman
example_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
example_zh: 一位好心的女士幫我找到了車站。

zh: 提供；供應；條款；規定；預備；準備措施
en: The act of supplying something needed. | A condition or requirement in a law or agreement. | Arrangements made to deal with future needs or events.
example_en: The campsite fee includes the provision of clean water.
example_zh: 營地費用包含清潔用水的供應。

zh: 性格；品質；特色；角色；人物；字元；文字
en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive | a person represented in a story, play, or film | a written or printed symbol, such as a letter
example_en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example_zh: 她開朗的性格讓陰雨的早晨也顯得明朗起來。

zh: 行為；舉止；執行方式；反應特性
en: The way a person or animal acts. | The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.
example_en: The puppy's calm behaviour surprised everyone at the park.
example_zh: 小狗溫順的表現讓公園裡的每個人都感到意外。

zh: 攻擊；猛烈抨擊；攻擊；抨擊；疾病發作
en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly | An act of violence or strong criticism | A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms
example_en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
example_zh: 我走近池塘時，那隻鵝突然啄起我的包。

en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.
example_en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
example_zh: 所有人都在外面等著開門。

en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.
example_en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
example_zh: 我們的律師在我們簽字前解釋了合同內容。

zh: 維持；保持；保養；維護；堅持聲稱
en: To keep something at the same level or in existence. | To keep something working well through regular care and repairs. | To firmly state that something is true.
example_en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
example_zh: 經常散步幫助我保持健康的體重。

en: illegal activities considered as a whole | an action that breaks the law
example_en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
example_zh: 更好的街道照明幫助減少了這裡的犯罪。

zh: 責任；負責；職責；應盡的義務
en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results. | A task or duty that you are expected to handle.
example_en: Feeding the dog is your responsibility this weekend.
example_zh: 這個週末餵狗是你的責任。

zh: 表達；表露；快速的；特快的；明確的；明示的
en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion. | Providing a faster service than usual. | Clearly and directly stated.
example_en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
example_zh: 莉婭用一個溫暖的微笑表達了謝意。

en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells | a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance
example_en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
example_zh: 那支舊槍陳列在博物館的玻璃展櫃裡。

en: what is real or actually happened | a fact or principle generally accepted as true
example_en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
example_zh: 請告訴我杯子打碎的真相。

zh: 對待；看待；治療；醫治；樂事；特別款待
en: Behave towards someone or consider something in a particular way. | Use medicine or other care to help an illness improve. | Something enjoyable that you do not have very often.
example_en: Our neighbours treat their rescue dog with great kindness.
example_zh: 鄰居們對他們收養的狗十分友善。

zh: 團結的；一致的；聯合的；統一的
en: Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions. | Joined together to form a single group or whole.
example_en: Our neighbours remained united despite disagreements about the garden.
example_zh: 儘管對花園有不同意見，我們的鄰居們仍然保持團結。

en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose. | An established custom or system within a society.
example_en: My sister works at a respected institution near home.
example_zh: 我姐姐在家附近一家備受尊重的機構工作。

zh: 合適的；恰當的；擅自佔用；挪用；撥款；撥出
en: suitable for a particular situation or purpose | to take something for your own use without permission | to officially set aside money for a particular purpose
example_en: Are these shoes appropriate for a long mountain walk?
example_zh: 這雙鞋適合長時間山間徒步嗎？

en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly | to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution
example_en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
example_zh: 我承認我忘了給你的植物澆水。

zh: 情況；條件；環境；經濟狀況；境遇
en: a fact or condition that affects a situation | the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation
example_en: Under no circumstances should you leave the front door unlocked.
example_zh: 無論什麼情況下，你都不該讓前門不上鎖。

zh: 影響；作用；撞擊；衝擊；影響
en: a strong effect on someone or something | the force or action of one object hitting another | to affect someone or something, often strongly
example_en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
example_zh: 新遊樂場給我們社群帶來了積極影響。

zh: 受歡迎的；流行的；大眾的；通俗的
en: Liked or enjoyed by many people. | Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.
example_en: This small café is popular with local students.
example_zh: 這家小咖啡館很受當地學生歡迎。

en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.
example_en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
example_zh: 我們為家庭聚會做了一頓傳統飯菜。

en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm
example_en: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
example_zh: 博物館將一件古代兵器陳列在厚玻璃後。

zh: 文化的；與文化有關的；藝術的；文藝的
en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life | relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre
example_en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
example_zh: 這個節日頌揚小鎮豐富的文化傳統。

en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement | a state of quietness or freedom from worry
example_en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
example_zh: 我喜歡早餐前這座花園裡的寧靜。

en: a matter, event, or activity concerning someone | a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner
example_en: The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
example_zh: 儘管下著雨，這次家庭野餐仍然很歡樂。

zh: 成年人；成年動物；成年的；成年人的
en: A person or animal that has finished growing. | Fully grown, or relating to grown people.
example_en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
example_zh: 兒童必須由成年人陪同前往游泳池。

zh: 優勢；有利條件；好處；益處
en: Something that makes success more likely than for others. | A useful or positive feature of something.
example_en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
example_zh: 你的長手臂讓你在游泳時更有優勢。

zh: 大多數；過半數；超出對方的票數
en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members | the extra votes by which one candidate or side wins
example_en: The majority of our neighbours have dogs or cats.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居大多數都養狗或貓。

en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal. | An organised event in which people try to win.
example_en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
example_zh: 我們學校下週五要舉辦繪畫比賽。

en: a person who serves in an army
example_en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
example_zh: 那名士兵幫忙把物資運過被洪水淹沒的道路。

en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses | a successful combination of different things
example_en: Their marriage grew stronger as they learned to listen.
example_zh: 隨著他們學會傾聽，婚姻關係變得更加穩固。

zh: 獨立自主的；不受控制的；獨立的；無關聯的；互不影響的
en: able to live or act without relying on others | not controlled by another person, organisation, or country | not connected with or affected by something else
example_en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
example_zh: 獨居讓我變得更加獨立。

zh: 調查；民意調查；調查；勘測；測量
en: A study that collects information by asking people questions. | Collect information by asking people questions. | Examine and measure land or buildings in detail.
example_en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
example_zh: 我填寫了一份關於本地圖書館的簡短問卷。

zh: 德國的；德語的；德國人；德語
en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language | a person from Germany | the language spoken in Germany and some neighbouring countries
example_en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後，我們分著吃了一塊傳統德國蛋糕。

zh: 一代人；一代；產生；發電；產品的一代
en: people born and living at roughly the same time | the process of producing something, especially electricity | a stage in the development of a product or technology
example_en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們家三代人聚在一起吃晚飯。

zh: 參與的；涉及的；複雜難懂的
en: taking part in or connected with something | complicated and difficult to understand
example_en: Everyone involved in the picnic brought something to share.
example_zh: 參加野餐的每個人都帶了東西與大家分享。

zh: 交流；溝通；通訊；函件；訊息
en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings | a formal message sent to someone
example_en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
example_zh: 清晰的溝通讓我們共用廚房時不發生爭執。

zh: 公民的；民用的；民事的；有禮貌的；客氣的
en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military. | Relating to private legal disputes rather than criminal offences. | Polite and respectful, though not necessarily friendly.
example_en: The airport handles both military and civil aircraft.
example_zh: 這座機場既接待軍用飛機，也接待民用飛機。

en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves | to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development
example_en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
example_zh: 姐姐對我有很大的影響。

en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment
example_en: Neighbours brought warm blankets to the flood victims.
example_zh: 鄰居們給洪災受害者送來了溫暖的毯子。

zh: 辯論；討論；辯論；討論；仔細考慮；權衡
en: A discussion in which people express different views. | To discuss a subject by considering different views. | To think carefully about options before making a decision.
example_en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
example_zh: 我們就把寵物養在室內的問題展開了熱烈討論。

en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities. | A person who lives in a particular town or city.
example_en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
example_zh: 我姑媽在這裡生活多年後成為了公民。

zh: 交換；兌換；交換；交流；交易所
en: to give something and receive something else in return | an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas | a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded
example_en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
example_zh: 我能把這件襯衫換成小一號的嗎？

en: Brought into the world as a baby | Having a natural ability for a particular activity
example_en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
example_zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一個下雪的早晨。

zh: 援助；救助；幫助；促進；輔助工具
en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support. | To help someone or make a process easier. | An object or device that helps someone do something.
example_en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
example_zh: 志願者為村子送來了食物和醫療援助。

en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.
example_en: Each participant brought a homemade dish to the cooking workshop.
example_zh: 每位參與者都帶了一道自制菜來參加烹飪工作坊。

zh: 男性的；雄性的；男性；雄性動物
en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm. | A male person or animal.
example_en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
example_zh: 這隻公鴨有一個亮閃閃的綠色腦袋。

zh: 社會地位；身份；狀態；狀況
en: A person's social position or standing within a group. | The current condition or situation of someone or something.
example_en: Her new role gave her higher status at work.
example_zh: 新職位提高了她在工作中的地位。

zh: 表達；表示；表情；神色；詞語；說法
en: The act of showing thoughts or feelings through words or actions. | The look on someone's face that reveals feelings. | A word or phrase with a particular meaning.
example_en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
example_zh: 他送了花來表達謝意。

en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period
example_en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
example_zh: 我們一家通常在聖誕節一起享用一頓特別的飯菜。

en: The right or ability to act without unnecessary restrictions. | The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.
example_en: Living alone gives me freedom to choose my own routine.
example_zh: 獨居讓我可以自由安排自己的日常生活。

zh: 公平的；合理的；膚色白皙的；淺色的；展銷會；集市
en: treating people equally or reasonably | having pale skin or light hair | an event where people display or sell goods and services
example_en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
example_zh: 我們輪流選遊戲，以保證公平。

zh: 採用；採取；收養；正式透過；採納
en: To start using a method, idea, or approach. | To legally take someone else's child into your family. | To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.
example_en: We adopted a simpler way to organise our shopping.
example_zh: 我們採用了一種更簡單的方法來安排購物。

zh: 強有力的；動力強的；有權勢的；影響力大的
en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect. | Able to control people or strongly influence events.
example_en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
example_zh: 大風把我們的花園椅子吹到了草地上。

zh: 信任；信賴；信任；相信；信託；信託機構
en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.
example_en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
example_zh: 我信得過鄰居，放心讓他餵我們的貓。

en: a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem | a systematic study intended to increase knowledge about a subject
example_en: An investigation revealed why the kitchen ceiling was leaking.
example_zh: 一項調查查明瞭廚房天花板漏水的原因。

zh: 衝突；爭執；矛盾；牴觸；相沖突；相牴觸
en: A serious disagreement or struggle between people or groups. | A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree. | To disagree with or be incompatible with something.
example_en: Sharing a bedroom sometimes causes conflict between the brothers.
example_zh: 共用一間臥室有時會讓兄弟倆發生爭執。

zh: 英國的；英國人的；英國人（總稱）
en: Relating to the United Kingdom, its people, or their culture. | The people of the United Kingdom, considered collectively.
example_en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
example_zh: 我的英國鄰居邀請我們過去喝茶。

zh: 聯絡；接觸；聯絡；聯絡；熟人；人脈
en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things. | To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method. | Someone you know who can offer help or information.
example_en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
example_zh: 如果你丟了鑰匙，請聯絡接待員。

zh: 貢獻；促成作用；捐款；捐贈物；投稿；稿件
en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result. | Money or goods given to support a person or cause. | A piece of writing supplied for a publication.
example_en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
example_zh: 有了你的幫助，我們在日落前完成了花園的整理工作。

zh: 非洲的；非洲人的；非洲人
en: relating to Africa or its people | a person from Africa
example_en: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
example_zh: 我們在一個泥濘的水塘邊發現了幾頭非洲象。

en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action
example_en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
example_zh: 水管破裂讓家裡陷入了困境。

zh: 與……結婚；結婚；為……主持婚禮
en: To become someone's husband or wife. | To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.
example_en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
example_zh: 我表姐計劃明年春天與伴侶結婚。

zh: 中國的；漢語的；漢語；中文；中國人
en: Relating to China, its people, or its languages. | The group of languages spoken in China, especially Mandarin. | People who come from China.
example_en: We shared Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在一家小餐館一起吃了中式餃子。

zh: 在場；出席；存在；氣場；風度
en: The state of being in a particular place. | The fact that something exists in a place or situation. | A quality that makes someone noticeable and impressive.
example_en: Her presence at the concert made her daughter smile.
example_zh: 她來到音樂會現場，女兒見了露出笑容。

en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.
example_en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
example_zh: 一起包餃子是我們家的傳統。

en: Relating to a particular area within a country or world.
example_en: The market sells regional cheeses made in nearby villages.
example_zh: 這個市場出售附近村莊製作的地方特色乳酪。

en: Say that something is not true or did not happen. | Refuse to give or allow someone something.
example_en: She denied eating the last piece of cake.
example_zh: 她否認吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

en: A large group of people gathered in one place. | To gather closely together or fill a place with people.
example_en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
example_zh: 一群人聚在廣場上的樂手周圍。

zh: 基督教的；信基督教的；基督徒
en: relating to Christianity or its followers | a person who follows the religion based on Jesus Christ
example_en: Our neighbour attends a Christian church near the park.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居去公園附近的一座基督教堂做禮拜。

en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes. | The state of being kept in a prison.
example_en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
example_zh: 這座舊監獄已成為當地一處受歡迎的博物館。

zh: 提議；提出；求婚；打算；計劃
en: Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider. | Ask someone to marry you. | Intend or plan to do something.
example_en: I proposed sharing a taxi to save us money.
example_zh: 我提議合乘一輛計程車，給大家省點錢。

zh: 貢獻；捐助；促成；是原因之一；投稿；撰稿
en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose | To help cause a particular result | To write material for a publication or website
example_en: Everyone contributed a dish to our shared evening meal.
example_zh: 每個人都為我們的聚餐帶來了一道菜。

en: who a person is | qualities and beliefs distinguishing a person or group
example_en: The receptionist checked my identity before handing me the key.
example_zh: 接待員核實我的身份後，才把鑰匙交給我。

zh: 信任；信心；宗教信仰；宗教
en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something. | Belief in a god, or a particular religious system.
example_en: I have faith in your ability to fix this.
example_zh: 我相信你有能力修好這個。

zh: 促進；提倡；晉升；提拔；宣傳；推銷
en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted | to give someone a higher position at work | to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales
example_en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
example_zh: 我們當地的俱樂部透過免費的週末騎行活動推廣騎車。

zh: 人們；民間的；傳統的；民間音樂；民謠
en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group. | Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people. | Music rooted in the traditions of a community.
example_en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
example_zh: 當地人每晚都聚在這裡聊天。

zh: 堅決要求；堅持主張；堅持說；堅稱
en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement | to state firmly that something is true
example_en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
example_zh: 我的祖父母每次都堅持要付午餐錢。

zh: 方式；方法；舉止；態度；禮貌；禮儀
en: The way something is done or happens. | The way someone behaves towards other people. | Socially acceptable ways of behaving, usually expressed in the plural.
example_en: She answered my questions in a calm manner.
example_zh: 她平靜地回答了我的問題。

zh: 出身；經歷；背景；背景情況；背景；後景
en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life | Information or events needed to understand a situation | The part of a scene behind the main subject
example_en: Her background in nursing helped her care for Grandpa.
example_zh: 她的護理經歷幫助她照顧爺爺。

en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.
example_en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
example_zh: 有人知道我把藍色雨傘放在哪裡了嗎？

en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone | to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone
example_en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
example_zh: 我們看了一部講述偵探調查謀殺案的電影。

en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices
example_en: We learned about different religions at school today.
example_zh: 今天我們在學校瞭解了不同的宗教。

zh: 威脅；恐嚇；危及；可能造成
en: Say you will cause harm or trouble unless demands are met | Put something at risk or make something harmful seem likely
example_en: They threatened to cancel our booking unless we paid today.
example_zh: 他們威脅說，如果我們今天不付款，就取消我們的預訂。

zh: 犯（罪或錯誤）；承諾；使承擔義務；投入（資金或資源）
en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong. | To promise firmly to do something or support someone. | To make money, time, or resources available for a purpose.
example_en: The police arrested someone who had committed a burglary.
example_zh: 警方逮捕了一名入室盜竊者。

zh: 女性的；雌性的；雌性動物；女性
en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs. | An animal or person of the female sex.
example_en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
example_zh: 母獅和幼獅一起在陰涼處休息。

zh: 青年時期；青春；青年群體；年輕男子
en: the period of life when someone is young | young people considered as a group | a young man, especially a teenager
example_en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
example_zh: 我祖母的青年時代是在一個海邊村莊度過的。

zh: 出生地的；母語的；本土的；原生的；本地人；出生於某地者
en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life | living or growing naturally in a particular region | a person born in a particular place
example_en: After years abroad, Ravi returned to his native city.
example_zh: 在國外生活多年後，拉維回到了自己的故鄉城市。

en: the way someone or something looks | an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
example_en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
example_zh: 重新刷了一層漆，房間的面貌煥然一新。

zh: 印度的；印度人的；印度人
en: relating to India or its people | a person from India
example_en: We cooked an Indian curry for dinner last night.
example_zh: 我們昨晚做了一道印度咖哩當晚餐。

zh: 承諾；答應；承諾；諾言；潛力；前景
en: to say firmly that you will do something | a firm statement that you will do something | signs that someone or something may succeed
example_en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
example_zh: 我保證晚飯前把腳踏車還給你。

en: More and more as time passes
example_en: The bus has become increasingly crowded since last month.
example_zh: 從上個月起，這趟公交車變得越來越擁擠。

zh: 有禮貌的男士；紳士；先生；男士
en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people. | A polite or formal way to refer to a man.
example_en: A gentleman held the door open for us.
example_zh: 一位紳士為我們扶住了門。

en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people | the way something is spread across an area or group
example_en: Volunteers organised the distribution of warm blankets after the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨過後，志願者組織發放了保暖毯。

en: A place of punishment after death in some religious beliefs. | An extremely unpleasant experience, situation, or place.
example_en: The old painting showed flames rising from hell.
example_zh: 那幅舊畫描繪了從地獄升起的火焰。

zh: 道德的；合乎道德的；寓意；教訓
en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness | a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story
example_en: Returning the lost wallet was clearly the moral choice.
example_zh: 歸還丟失的錢包顯然是合乎道德的選擇。

en: Known by many people.
example_en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
example_zh: 這個村莊以美味的蘋果派聞名。

en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son. | A male ruler of a small independent state.
example_en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
example_zh: 王子在宮殿陽臺上向來訪者揮手。

zh: 代表；代理人；有代表性的；典型的
en: someone chosen to speak or act for other people | showing the usual features of a larger group
example_en: Our class representative asked for more books in the library.
example_zh: 我們班的代表請求為圖書館增添書籍。

zh: 屬於；歸某人所有；應在某處；歸入；有歸屬感
en: To be owned by someone | To have a proper place or category | To feel accepted as part of a group
example_en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
example_zh: 這把藍色雨傘是我妹妹的。

zh: 尊重；敬佩；尊重；遵守；方面
en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings. | To value someone or follow a rule or agreement. | A particular feature or aspect of something.
example_en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
example_zh: 她認真傾聽，沒有打斷同事，以此表達尊重。

zh: 吸引；引起興趣；吸引靠近
en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something | Pull something closer through a physical force
example_en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
example_zh: 鮮豔的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我們的小陽臺上。

zh: 正式的；官方的；莊重的；拘謹的；正規的；系統的
en: Following established rules or officially recognised procedures. | Suitable for serious occasions rather than relaxed situations. | Organised and structured, especially within an educational institution.
example_en: You need a formal invitation to attend the ceremony.
example_zh: 你需要正式邀請才能出席典禮。

zh: 保守的；守舊的；謹慎的；偏低的；保守派人士
en: preferring traditional ideas and avoiding major changes | deliberately low or cautious to avoid overestimating | someone who favours traditional values and limited change
example_en: My uncle is conservative and dislikes changing family traditions.
example_zh: 我叔叔很保守，不喜歡改變家裡的傳統。

en: to ask someone to attend something or do something | to request a response or make a reaction likely
example_en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
example_zh: 我們邀請新鄰居過來吃晚飯吧。

en: Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.
example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village.
example_zh: 我的祖父母住在一個安靜的鄉村。

zh: 歡迎；欣然接受；受歡迎的；令人欣喜的；歡迎；迎接
en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure | wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted | the way someone is greeted when they arrive
example_en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
example_zh: 鄰居們走到外面，歡迎我們回家。

zh: 相等的；平等的；等於；比得上；同等的人；匹敵者
en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity. | To be the same in quantity, value, or quality. | Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.
example_en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
example_zh: 我們把蛋糕切成大小相等的小塊，分給大家。

zh: 違法行為；犯規；冒犯；被冒犯的感受
en: An act that breaks a law or rule. | Hurt or anger caused by something rude or disrespectful.
example_en: Parking here is an offence, so let's move the car.
example_zh: 在這裡停車是違法的，我們把車挪走吧。

zh: 俄羅斯的；俄語的；俄羅斯人；俄語
en: Relating to Russia, its people, or its language. | A person from Russia. | The main language spoken in Russia.
example_en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
example_zh: 昨晚我們做了俄式餃子當晚餐。

zh: 愛爾蘭的；愛爾蘭人的；愛爾蘭語；愛爾蘭人（統稱）
en: relating to Ireland, its people, or their culture | a Celtic language traditionally spoken in Ireland | the people of Ireland, referred to collectively
example_en: An Irish musician played the fiddle at our festival.
example_zh: 一位愛爾蘭音樂家在我們的節慶活動上拉小提琴。

zh: 集會；集合；裝配；組裝；議會；立法機構
en: A gathering of people for a shared purpose. | The process of joining parts to make something complete. | A group elected to discuss public matters and make laws.
example_en: The whole school gathered in the hall for assembly.
example_zh: 全校師生聚在禮堂裡參加集會。

en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another. | Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.
example_en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
example_zh: 故事裡，王子和他的敵人成了朋友。

zh: 和解；解決協議；定居點；聚居地；結算；清償
en: An agreement that ends a dispute. | A place where people establish a community. | The payment of money owed.
example_en: The neighbours finally reached a settlement over the damaged fence.
example_zh: 鄰居們終於就受損圍欄的問題達成了和解。

en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body. | A person, especially when describing their character. | Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.
example_en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
example_zh: 在海邊散步似乎總能撫慰我的心靈。

zh: 專家組；評審小組；鑲板；嵌板；控制面板；儀表盤
en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise | a flat piece forming part of a surface | a surface containing controls or instruments
example_en: The panel listened carefully as each student presented an idea.
example_zh: 每位學生陳述想法時，評審小組都認真傾聽。

zh: 已婚的；婚姻的；夫妻生活的
en: Having a husband or wife. | Relating to marriage or life as a couple.
example_en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
example_zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。

zh: 認出；識別；認可；讚賞；承認；正式認可
en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before. | Public appreciation of someone's achievements or value. | Acceptance that something exists, is true, or has official status.
example_en: His face lit up with recognition when I waved.
example_zh: 我揮手時，他認出了我，臉上頓時露出喜色。

zh: 廣泛地；普遍地；差異很大地
en: Across many places or among many people | With a large difference between people, things, or situations
example_en: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
example_zh: 這種水果在當地商店裡隨處可買到。

zh: 趨勢；潮流；成為熱門話題
en: a general direction of change or development | to become widely discussed or shared online
example_en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
example_zh: 在家種菜是這裡流行的一種風尚。

zh: 日本的；日語的；日語；日本人
en: Relating to Japan, its people, or its language. | The language used by most people in Japan. | A person from Japan, or the people of Japan collectively.
example_en: We enjoyed Japanese food at a small restaurant yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們在一家小餐館吃了日本料理。

en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.
example_en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
example_zh: 在手邊備好手電筒，以防出現緊急情況。

zh: 開明的；思想開放的；自由主義的；大量的；慷慨給予的
en: Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose. | Supporting political principles that protect individual rights and freedoms. | Given or used generously, often in large amounts.
example_en: My parents are liberal about what clothes I wear.
example_zh: 父母對我的穿著很開明。

zh: 保護；保衛；辯護；捍衛；防守
en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example_en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
example_zh: 鴨媽媽張開翅膀保護小鴨。

zh: 興趣廣泛的；兼收幷蓄的；天主教的；天主教徒
en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things. | Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope. | A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.
example_en: Her catholic tastes include jazz, pottery, hiking, and opera.
example_zh: 她的興趣十分廣泛，包括爵士樂、陶藝、徒步和歌劇。

zh: 會員身份；成員資格；全體會員；會員人數
en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation | all members of a group, or the total member count
example_en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
example_zh: 我的健身房會員權益包括每個週末的免費游泳課。

zh: 說服；勸服；使相信；使信服
en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons | To make someone believe something is true
example_en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
example_zh: 我說服弟弟加入了我們的步行小組。

zh: 偷竊；盜用；偷偷移動；極便宜的東西
en: to take something without permission and keep or use it | to move quietly without attracting attention | something bought for much less than its usual price
example_en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
example_zh: 我買麵包的時候，有人偷走了我的腳踏車。

en: An event, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.
example_en: Nobody was hurt in the incident outside the station.
example_zh: 車站外的那起事件中沒有人受傷。

en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem. | Responsibility for something bad that has happened.
example_en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
example_zh: 別把廚房椅子壞了的事怪到我頭上。

en: Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally. | A grammatical class of nouns affecting related word forms.
example_en: The club welcomes everyone, regardless of age or gender.
example_zh: 這個俱樂部歡迎所有人加入，不論年齡或性別。

en: The act of speaking or acting on behalf of others. | A picture, description, or model showing someone or something.
example_en: Our club now has representation on the town committee.
example_zh: 我們俱樂部現在在鎮委員會中有代表了。

en: old, especially when describing people
example_en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
example_zh: 一位年長的鄰居教我如何種番茄。

zh: 主人；主持人；主辦；主持；招待；大量；許多
en: someone who welcomes guests or presents a programme or event | to organise an event, present a programme, or receive guests | a large number of people or things
example_en: Our host welcomed us with warm bread and tea.
example_zh: 主人用熱麵包和茶歡迎我們。

en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another
example_en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
example_zh: 我們不在家時，鄰居幫忙給植物澆了水。

en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation | the mixture of gases surrounding a planet
example_en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
example_zh: 柔和的燈光為這家小餐館營造了輕鬆的氛圍。

zh: 紐帶；親密關係；債券；建立親密關係；黏合
en: a close connection between people or groups | an investment representing a loan with promised repayment and interest | to develop a close relationship or join things firmly together
example_en: Caring for the puppy strengthened the bond between the sisters.
example_zh: 照顧小狗加深了姐妹之間的感情。

zh: 健康幸福；福祉；社會福利；救濟
en: The health, happiness, and good living conditions of people. | Public support for people who need money or care.
example_en: The shelter puts the welfare of its animals first.
example_zh: 這家收容所把動物的健康和幸福放在首位。

zh: 建立；設立；機構；營業場所；權勢集團；當權派
en: the process of starting an organisation or system | an organisation or place where business or public activities happen | the powerful people who control a society or profession
example_en: The establishment of our local club brought neighbours together.
example_zh: 我們本地俱樂部的成立讓鄰居們走到了一起。

zh: 英雄；受敬佩的人；男主角；男主人公
en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions | the main male character in a story
example_en: The firefighter became a local hero after the rescue.
example_zh: 那次救援後，這位消防員成了當地的英雄。

zh: 囚犯；被拘禁者；戰俘；俘虜
en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving. | A person captured and held by an enemy during war.
example_en: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
example_zh: 那名囚犯從監獄圖書館借了一本小說。

en: Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.
example_en: Our neighbours oppose building a road through the park.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居反對修建一條穿過公園的道路。

zh: 慣例；習俗；大會；代表大會；國際公約；協定
en: An accepted way of behaving or doing something. | A large meeting of people with shared interests or work. | A formal agreement between countries about a particular issue.
example_en: By convention, guests wait until everyone is seated before eating.
example_zh: 按照慣例，客人等所有人落座後才開始用餐。

en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime | a person who has committed a crime
example_en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
example_zh: 警方在倉庫裡發現了犯罪活動的證據。

zh: 堂區；基層行政區；堂區全體居民
en: A local church district, or a small administrative area. | The people living in a particular church district.
example_en: Our parish has a small church beside the river.
example_zh: 我們堂區有一座小教堂，就在河邊。

zh: 缺口；間隙；差距；分歧；間隔；中斷
en: An empty space between things or within something. | A difference between people, groups, or situations. | A period when something stops or does not happen.
example_en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
example_zh: 小貓從籬笆的一個缺口鑽了過去。

en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory | an illness or physical problem
example_en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
example_zh: 她投訴湯是涼的。

zh: 使接觸；使暴露於；揭露；揭發；露出；使顯露
en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence | To reveal something hidden, especially wrongdoing | To uncover something previously hidden or protected
example_en: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight without protection.
example_zh: 不要在沒有防護的情況下讓皮膚暴露在強烈陽光下。

en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need | help, especially money, given to those in need
example_en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
example_zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善機構做志願者。

en: The ability to live or act without relying on others. | A country's freedom from control by another country.
example_en: Learning to cook gave him a sense of independence.
example_zh: 學會做飯讓他有了自立的感覺。

en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable. | To praise someone or something publicly.
example_en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
example_zh: 我們做了一頓特別的晚餐來慶祝她畢業。

en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins | A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something
example_en: A low stone wall marks the boundary of our garden.
example_zh: 一道低矮的石牆標出了我們花園的邊界。

zh: 同性戀的；與同性戀者相關的
en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex. | Relating to gay people, their lives, or their culture.
example_en: My uncle is gay and lives with his husband.
example_zh: 我叔叔是同性戀者，和他的丈夫住在一起。

zh: 遺棄；拋棄；離棄；放棄；終止；放縱；無拘無束
en: To leave someone or something without intending to return. | To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished. | A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.
example_en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
example_zh: 我們不得不將車棄在雪地裡。

zh: 榮譽；敬意；尊敬；表彰；履行；兌現
en: great respect or recognition for someone's qualities or achievements | show respect or give public recognition to someone | do what a promise or agreement requires
example_en: Our neighbors held a dinner in honor of my grandmother.
example_zh: 鄰居們舉辦了一場晚宴，向我祖母致敬。

zh: 有罪的；有過錯的；內疚的
en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong. | Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.
example_en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
example_zh: 我忘了姐姐的生日，感到很內疚。

zh: 爭端；爭執；質疑；對……提出異議；爭論；爭奪
en: a serious disagreement between people or groups | to question whether something is true or correct | to argue about something or compete to control it
example_en: Our neighbours settled their dispute over the garden fence.
example_zh: 鄰居們解決了他們關於花園圍欄的爭執。

en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge | a request for information about something
example_en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
example_zh: 我詢問了丟失包裹的情況，很快就收到了回覆。

zh: 個性；性格；個人魅力；名人
en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves | lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting | a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting
example_en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
example_zh: 她開朗的性格讓每位來吃飯的人都感到受歡迎。

en: Help given to someone who needs it.
example_en: Please ask for assistance if your suitcase is too heavy.
example_zh: 如果你的行李箱太重，請尋求幫助。

zh: 緊張局勢；緊張關係；緊張；焦慮；張力；拉力
en: Strained relations between people or groups that may cause conflict | A feeling of worry that makes relaxation difficult | A force that stretches or pulls something tight
example_en: Tension grew between the neighbours over the shared driveway.
example_zh: 鄰居們因共用車道問題，關係越來越緊張。

en: the act of speaking to God or a god | words spoken to God or a god
example_en: She closed her eyes and said a quiet prayer.
example_zh: 她閉上眼睛，輕聲祈禱。

en: the period of life when someone is a child
example_en: My happiest childhood memories involve baking with my grandmother.
example_zh: 我最快樂的童年記憶都與和祖母一起烘焙有關。

zh: 逮捕；拘捕；逮捕；拘捕；阻止；使停止
en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority | the act of taking someone into police custody | to stop the progress or development of something
example_en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
example_zh: 警方昨天在車站外逮捕了嫌疑人。

zh: 暴力的；兇暴的；猛烈的；劇烈的
en: Using physical force to hurt people or damage things. | Extremely strong, sudden, or forceful.
example_en: A violent storm shook the windows throughout the night.
example_zh: 一場猛烈的暴風雨整夜震得窗戶直響。

zh: 解決；消除；決心；決定；決心；堅定信念
en: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem or disagreement. | To decide firmly to do something. | Strong determination to achieve something.
example_en: We resolved the argument by taking turns cooking dinner.
example_zh: 我們透過輪流做晚飯解決了這場爭執。

en: A ceremony in which two people get married.
example_en: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
example_zh: 他們的婚禮在一個小花園裡舉行。

en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons
example_en: You have no obligation to buy anything here.
example_zh: 你沒有義務在這裡購買任何東西。

zh: 轉變；過渡時期；轉變；過渡
en: A change from one state, stage, or situation to another. | To change from one state or situation to another.
example_en: A familiar toy eased her transition to nursery.
example_zh: 一個熟悉的玩具幫助她適應了託兒所生活。

en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
example_en: Your participation made our neighbourhood clean-up much more enjoyable.
example_zh: 有你參與，我們這次社群清掃活動開心多了。

en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.
example_en: You deserve a rest after carrying those heavy boxes.
example_zh: 搬了那些沉重的箱子後，你該休息一下了。

zh: 抗議；抗議活動；抗議；反對
en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition. | Express strong disagreement with something.
example_en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
example_zh: 居民在市政廳外舉行了一場和平抗議。

en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.
example_en: This little bakery has a reputation for excellent bread.
example_zh: 這家小麵包店以出色的麵包聞名。

en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people. | A sports match played outside an official competition.
example_en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
example_zh: 我們的新鄰居很友善，總是揮手打招呼。

en: following methods or ideas that are usual and widely accepted
example_en: We chose a conventional oven instead of a microwave.
example_zh: 我們選了普通烤箱，而不是微波爐。

zh: 親戚；親屬；相對的；比較而言的
en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage. | Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.
example_en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
example_zh: 假期裡，一位親戚給我們帶來了自制麵包。

zh: 敦促；力勸；強烈慾望；衝動
en: To strongly encourage someone to do something. | A strong desire to do something.
example_en: I resisted the urge to eat another biscuit.
example_zh: 我忍住了再吃一塊餅乾的衝動。

zh: 自願的；非強制的；志願的；無償的
en: done by choice rather than because it is required | done without payment to help people or an organisation
example_en: Joining the weekend walking group is completely voluntary.
example_zh: 參加週末步行小組完全出於自願。

zh: 組成；構成；算作；構成；正式設立
en: To be the parts that form a whole | To be considered a particular thing | To formally establish an organisation or governing body
example_en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
example_zh: 我們冰箱裡的食物大部分是蔬菜。

zh: 志願者；義工；自願做；主動提供
en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment | to freely offer to do something or give information
example_en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
example_zh: 一位志願者幫我們把箱子搬上了樓。

en: a person authorised to perform religious ceremonies
example_en: The priest welcomed everyone as they entered the church.
example_zh: 大家走進教堂時，神父向每個人表示歡迎。

en: The condition of lacking money for basic needs. | A serious lack of something needed or valued.
example_en: The charity helps local families living in poverty.
example_zh: 這家慈善機構幫助當地生活貧困的家庭。

en: Something that represents an idea, quality, or group. | A written mark used to represent information.
example_en: For my grandparents, this old house is a symbol of hope.
example_zh: 對我的祖父母來說，這座老房子是希望的象徵。

zh: 風俗；慣例；定製的；惠顧；光顧
en: a traditional or usual way of behaving | made to meet a particular customer's needs | the business customers give to a shop or company
example_en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
example_zh: 一起吃飯是我們家的一項重要慣例。

zh: 亞洲的；亞洲人的；亞洲人；亞裔人士
en: Relating to Asia or its people. | A person from Asia or with family origins there.
example_en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
example_zh: 這家博物館展出了多個亞洲國家的陶器。

zh: 依賴的；依靠的；取決於…的
en: Needing someone or something for support or survival. | Decided or affected by a particular condition or factor.
example_en: The young birds are still dependent on their parents.
example_zh: 這些幼鳥仍然依賴親鳥。

zh: 根本的；徹底的；激進的；激進分子
en: Involving major changes to the basic nature of something. | Supporting major political or social changes beyond accepted views. | A person who supports major political or social change.
example_en: Turning our garage into a kitchen was a radical change.
example_zh: 把車庫改成廚房是一次徹底的改變。

zh: 敏感的；易受影響的；體貼的；善解人意的；需謹慎處理的；敏感的
en: Easily affected by emotions, substances, or changes | Aware of and considerate towards other people's feelings | Requiring careful handling because of possible harm or offence
example_en: My skin is sensitive to this new washing powder.
example_zh: 我的皮膚對這種新洗衣粉很敏感。

en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect
example_en: Visitors remove their shoes before entering this holy place.
example_zh: 遊客進入這處聖地前會脫鞋。

zh: 雙胞胎之一；成對的；雙胞胎的
en: One of two children born to the same mother together. | Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.
example_en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
example_zh: 我的雙胞胎手足和我都喜歡游泳。

zh: 榮譽；尊敬；榮幸；尊敬；表彰；履行承諾；遵守協議
en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege. | To show deep respect or publicly recognize someone's achievements. | To do what a promise or agreement requires.
example_en: It was an honour to represent my local team.
example_zh: 能代表本地球隊出場，我感到很榮幸。

en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved
example_en: These shoes are acceptable for work, but trainers aren't.
example_zh: 這雙鞋適合上班穿，但運動鞋不行。

en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship. | To hope very strongly that something will happen.
example_en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
example_zh: 他們每天早晨靜靜地聚在一起，為和平祈禱。

zh: 面對；正視；當面對質；質問
en: To face and deal with a difficult situation or problem. | To challenge someone directly about something they have done.
example_en: She finally confronted her fear and entered the swimming pool.
example_zh: 她終於直面恐懼，走進了游泳池。

zh: 抵制；反抗；忍住；抵擋誘惑；耐受；抵禦
en: Oppose something or try to prevent it from happening | Stop yourself from doing something tempting | Remain undamaged or unaffected by something harmful
example_en: I could not resist buying another warm cinnamon bun.
example_zh: 我忍不住又買了一個熱乎乎的肉桂麵包卷。

zh: 完全的；徹底的；絕對的；不受限制的
en: complete or total | not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities
example_en: The room fell into absolute silence when she entered.
example_zh: 她一進來，房間裡就變得鴉雀無聲。

zh: 同伴的；同類的；男子；傢伙；學會會員；學院研究員
en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone | A man or boy, referred to informally | A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions
example_en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
example_zh: 我和一位同行的乘客共撐了一把傘。

zh: 同齡人；同等地位者；仔細看；費力地看；英國貴族
en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability | To look carefully, especially when something is difficult to see | A person holding a British noble title
example_en: She peered through the window to see the kitten.
example_zh: 她透過窗戶仔細看，想看清那隻小貓。

zh: 登記；註冊；登記簿；名冊；顯示；記錄測量結果
en: To put information on an official list | An official list or record of people or things | To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument
example_en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
example_zh: 你可以在泳池報名參加游泳課。

zh: 移民入境；移居；入境檢查；入境檢查處
en: The process of entering another country to live there. | The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.
example_en: We showed our passports at immigration after the flight.
example_zh: 下飛機後，我們在入境檢查處出示了護照。

en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.
example_en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
example_zh: 我十幾歲時每天騎腳踏車上學。

zh: 旗；旗幟；標記；提醒注意；衰退；減弱
en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation | to mark something as needing attention | to become weaker or less energetic
example_en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
example_zh: 一面鮮豔的旗幟在校門上方飄揚。

en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.
example_en: A friendly lad helped us carry the bags.
example_zh: 一個友善的小夥子幫我們提了袋子。

zh: 表現；舉止；守規矩；運轉；作出特定反應
en: to act in a particular way | to act politely and do what is expected | to work or react in a particular way
example_en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
example_zh: 有客人來家裡時，我們的狗表現得很平靜。

zh: 等級；軍銜；地位；排名；把……分等級；一排；一列
en: A position within an ordered system of importance or authority | To place or be placed in order of quality or importance | A line of people or things arranged side by side
example_en: After years of service, she reached the rank of captain.
example_zh: 服役多年後，她晉升為上尉。

en: agreement allowing someone to do something
example_en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
example_zh: 你得先徵得姐姐同意，才能借她的腳踏車。

en: A question or request for information. | An organised attempt to discover facts about a matter.
example_en: The receptionist answered my enquiry about the opening hours.
example_zh: 接待員回答了我關於營業時間的詢問。

zh: 欣然接受；採納；擁抱；擁抱
en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity | to hold someone closely in your arms | an act of holding someone closely in your arms
example_en: My grandparents have embraced video calls to stay connected.
example_zh: 我的祖父母欣然接受了用視訊通話保持聯絡的方式。

en: a male police officer
example_en: A policeman helped us cross the busy road.
example_zh: 一位男警察幫我們穿過了繁忙的馬路。

zh: 好鬥的；挑釁的；強勢進取的；積極有力的
en: Ready to argue, threaten, or attack. | Using forceful, determined methods to achieve a goal.
example_en: The aggressive dog growled whenever anyone approached its gate.
example_zh: 每當有人靠近大門，那隻兇悍的狗就會低吼。

en: A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial. | Put someone in jail.
example_en: The old jail now welcomes visitors as a museum.
example_zh: 這座舊監獄如今作為博物館接待遊客。

zh: 誠實的；正直的；坦率的；真誠的
en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. | Expressing what you really think or feel.
example_en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
example_zh: 那位誠實的收銀員退還了我多付的錢。

en: The presence of many different types of people or things.
example_en: Our garden attracts a surprising diversity of colourful birds.
example_zh: 我們的花園吸引了種類多得驚人的彩色鳥兒。

en: express disapproval of someone or something
example_en: Please don't criticize my cooking before you taste it.
example_zh: 請別還沒嘗就批評我的廚藝。

zh: 逐漸增加；加劇；安裝；固定；組織開展；發起
en: To increase gradually in amount, strength, or seriousness. | To attach something firmly to a surface or support. | To organize and begin an activity, campaign, or event.
example_en: Dirty dishes mounted up while our dishwasher was broken.
example_zh: 洗碗機壞了，髒碗碟越積越多。

zh: 犯罪團伙；幫派；一群夥伴；一隊工人
en: A group of people involved in crime or violence. | A group of friends or people working together.
example_en: Our whole gang meets at the park on Saturdays.
example_zh: 我們這群夥伴每週六都在公園碰面。

zh: 提倡；主張；倡導者；支持者
en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action. | Someone who publicly supports a cause or policy.
example_en: Our neighbours advocate planting more trees along the street.
example_zh: 我們的鄰居主張在街邊多種些樹。

zh: 加拿大的；加拿大人的；加拿大人
en: relating to Canada, its people, or its culture | a person from Canada
example_en: Our Canadian neighbour invited us over for dinner yesterday.
example_zh: 我們的加拿大鄰居昨天邀請我們去他家吃晚飯。

zh: 普遍的；全體適用的；通用的
en: Existing everywhere or applying to everyone in a group. | Suitable for use with many different devices or situations.
example_en: The new playground won universal approval from local families.
example_zh: 新遊樂場得到了當地家庭的一致認可。

zh: 分發；分配；使分佈；使散佈
en: to give or deliver something to several people or places | to spread something over an area
example_en: Volunteers distribute fresh fruit outside the community centre every Friday.
example_zh: 志願者每週五在社群中心外分發新鮮水果。

zh: 負擔；重擔；使負擔；使煩惱
en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry | to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry
example_en: Sharing the housework eased the burden on my father.
example_zh: 分擔家務減輕了父親的負擔。

en: the act of working together towards a shared goal | willingness to help or do what someone requests
example_en: Cleaning the shared kitchen requires cooperation from everyone.
example_zh: 清潔共用廚房需要大家的配合。

en: A formal event marking an important occasion. | Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.
example_en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
example_zh: 我們參加了湖邊一場小型婚禮。

en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.
example_en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
example_zh: 游泳池設有供殘障游泳者使用的升降裝置。

en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others | to make information or feelings known to someone
example_en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
example_zh: 我們透過一個共同的線上群組與鄰居交流。

en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.
example_en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
example_zh: 公主從馬車裡向人群揮手。

zh: 陌生人；初到某地的人；外來者
en: someone you do not know | someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community
example_en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
example_zh: 一位好心的陌生人幫我提了沉重的行李箱。

en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly | an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something
example_en: We encountered a curious fox on our evening walk.
example_zh: 我們傍晚散步時遇到了一隻好奇的狐狸。

zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
en: A child of your aunt or uncle
example_en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
example_zh: 我的表姐昨天教我騎腳踏車。

zh: 占主導地位的；支配的；顯性的
en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others. | Expressed when at least one copy of a gene is present.
example_en: Blue is the dominant colour in our living room.
example_zh: 藍色是我們客廳的主色調。

en: the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity
example_en: She keeps a Bible on the shelf beside her bed.
example_zh: 她在床邊的架子上放著一本《聖經》。

en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person. | Someone who enjoys or admires something very much.
example_en: The two lovers walked hand in hand beside the river.
example_zh: 這對戀人手牽著手沿河散步。

zh: 無辜的；無罪的；天真的；單純的；無惡意的；無害的
en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing. | Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life. | Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.
example_en: The broken vase was not his fault; he was innocent.
example_zh: 花瓶打碎不是他的錯，他是無辜的。

en: A conversation or discussion, especially to exchange views | The words spoken by characters in a story or performance
example_en: The neighbours began a friendly dialogue about their shared garden.
example_zh: 鄰居們就共用花園展開了友好的交流。

zh: 相互的；彼此的；共同的；共有的
en: Felt or done by each person towards the other. | Shared by two or more people or groups.
example_en: Our friendship grew through mutual trust and honest conversations.
example_zh: 我們的友誼透過相互信任和坦誠交流而加深。

en: Including many different kinds of people or things.
example_en: Our garden attracts a diverse range of colourful birds.
example_zh: 我們家的花園吸引了各種色彩鮮豔的鳥兒。

en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions | to change something for a different use or audience
example_en: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
example_zh: 我們的貓很快適應了新公寓裡的生活。

zh: 襲擊；侵犯人身；襲擊；毆打
en: a violent physical attack on someone | to attack someone physically
example_en: A witness reported the assault to a nearby police officer.
example_zh: 一名目擊者向附近的警察報告了這起襲擊事件。

zh: 庇護；遮蔽；避難所；遮蔽物；躲避；庇護
en: Protection from danger or bad weather. | A place that provides safety or protection. | To stay somewhere protected, or protect someone from harm.
example_en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
example_zh: 暴風雨中，我們躲到一座橋下避雨。

en: Strong public disagreement about a particular issue.
example_en: The plan to close our pool sparked local controversy.
example_zh: 關閉我們游泳池的計劃在當地引發了爭議。

zh: 慘劇；災難；不幸事件；悲劇；悲劇作品
en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss. | A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.
example_en: The whole village came together after the tragedy.
example_zh: 慘劇發生後，全村人團結起來了。

en: a ceremony held to remember and honour someone who has died
example_en: We brought white flowers to our neighbour's funeral yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我們帶著白花參加了鄰居的葬禮。

zh: 給予權利或資格；給……命名；題名
en: To give someone the right to have or do something. | To give a name to a book, film, or other work.
example_en: This ticket entitles you to a free lunch.
example_zh: 憑這張票，你可以免費享用一頓午餐。

en: Having reached a particular age. | Very old, especially when describing people.
example_en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
example_zh: 這門游泳課歡迎六歲及以上的兒童參加。

zh: 重要的；著名的；顯眼的；突出的
en: Important, well known, or influential | Easily noticed because of position, size, or shape
example_en: A prominent local artist opened the exhibition yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天，一位當地著名藝術家為展覽揭幕。

zh: 限制；使侷限於；禁閉；使無法離開
en: To keep something within particular limits | To keep someone in a place they cannot leave
example_en: Please confine your muddy boots to the porch.
example_zh: 請把沾滿泥的靴子放在門廊裡，別帶進屋。

zh: 接受；同意；接納；認可；接受現實；認同事實
en: The act of agreeing to receive or do something offered. | Willingness to welcome someone or regard something as suitable. | Recognition that a situation is real and must be faced.
example_en: Her acceptance of the invitation made us all smile.
example_zh: 她接受了邀請，我們都露出了笑容。

en: Despite difficulties, objections, or other circumstances.
example_en: Rain was forecast, but we went hiking regardless.
example_zh: 預報說會下雨，但我們還是去徒步了。

en: An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.
example_en: My only objection is that the tickets cost too much.
example_zh: 我唯一的反對理由是票價太高。

en: To leave quickly to escape danger or an unpleasant situation.
